b9ea0250.title: Solutions Consultant & Pre-sales
b9ea0250.description:
****FinBox: Where Fintech Meets Fun!****
 Welcome to FinBox, the buzzing hive of tech innovation and creativity!
   

  

 Since our inception in 2017, FinBox has built some of the most advanced technologies in the financial services space that help lenders like Banks, NBFCs and large enterprises build and launch credit products within a matter of days, not months or years. FinBox is a Series B funded company which is expanding globally with offices in India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Philippines.
   

  

 Our vision is to build the best\-in\-class infrastructure for lending products and help Banks \& Financial Services companies across the world scale and launch credit programs that set a new standard in the era of digital finance. So far, we’ve helped our customers disburse Billions of Dollars in credit across unsecured and secured credit including personal loans, working capital loans, business loans, mortgage and education loans. FinBox solutions are already being used by over 100\+ companies to deliver credit to over 5 million customers every month.
   

  

**Why Should You Be a FinBoxer**
* Innovative Environment: At FinBox, we foster a culture of creativity and experimentation, encouraging our team to push the boundaries of what's possible in fintech.
* Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly impact the lives of millions, helping to provide fair and accessible credit to individuals and businesses alike.
* Growth Opportunities: We are a Series B funded startup and have ample opportunities for growth, professional development and career advancement.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team of experts who are passionate about making a difference and supporting one another.


****Who’s a Great FinBoxer:****
 At FinBox, we’re on the lookout for exceptional folks who are all about innovation and impact. If you’re excited to shake things up in the banking \& financial services world, keep reading!
   

  

**Creative Thinkers:** 
 If your brain is always bubbling with out\-of\-the\-box ideas and wild solutions, you’re our kind of person. We love disruptors who challenge the norm and bring fresh perspectives to the table.
   

  

**Customer Heroes:** 
 Our customers are our champions, and we need heroes who can understand their needs, deliver magical experiences, and go above and beyond to keep them happy.
   

  

**Team Players:** 
 We believe in the power of “we.” If you thrive in a collaborative environment, value different viewpoints, and enjoy being part of a spirited, supportive team, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Solutions Consultant in Solutions Consulting and Pre\-Sales for International Markets, you will work in tandem with the Account team to build and deliver a winning value proposition for potential customers. The winning value proposition will include, but not be limited to, activities such as solution discovery discussions, RFX (RFP/RFI etc.) responses, crafting POVs/value propositions/solution approaches, and delivering right\-fit and contextual solution demos.
   

  

 You will partner with Account Executives to win and grow strategic accounts by translating FinBox’s credit infrastructure and risk intelligence platforms into outcome\-driven solutions for Banks, NBFCs and Fintech lenders. You will lead discovery, solution design, and buyer\-centric demos that showcase how FinBox can accelerate digital lending, embedded credit, and partnership lending programs while meeting regulatory and risk objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct deep discovery on customer journeys, tech stack, credit policies, and partnership models to identify value levers for FinBox solutions.
* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures using FinBox APIs and platforms (Prism, BRE, Risk Intelligence, Credit Infrastructure) aligned to business, risk, and compliance needs.
* Build and deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and walkthroughs that move conversations from features to measurable business outcomes (AUM growth, GNPA control, time\-to\-market, unit economics).
* Create solution decks, configuration documents, and proposal inputs (scopes, assumptions, phasing) for RFPs/RFIs and large pursuits in partnership with Account Executives.
* Act as the primary technical and product point of contact in deals, handling queries from business, risk, product, technology, InfoSec, and operations stakeholders on the customer side.
* Support commercial negotiations with solution\-level clarification, effort estimates, and rollout plans, ensuring feasibility and success metrics are clearly defined.
* Work closely with Account Executives, Sales, Product, Engineering and Delivery teams to drive opportunities forward and ensure strong alignment throughout the sales cycle.
* Document agreed architectures, configurations, and success KPIs, and ensure smooth handover to Delivery / Customer Success teams after deal closure.
* Continuously channel client and market feedback into Product and Engineering to influence roadmap for risk models, decisioning, and embedded credit capabilities.
* Develop a strong understanding of customer and market needs across international markets and translate these insights into actionable recommendations for internal teams.
* Collaborate closely with regional sales heads, account managers, Account Executives and inside sales/SDR teams to understand opportunities, prioritize pursuits and develop winning solution strategies.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of solutioning approaches, presales playbooks, demo narratives and reusable assets to improve the effectiveness and scalability of the presales function.
* Independently own and drive solutioning for strategic opportunities while collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and high\-quality outcomes.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5–10 years of overall experience, with minimum 5 years of hands\-on Pre\-Sales / Solutions Consulting experience.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical detail into simple, outcome\-focused narratives for CXO, business, and technology stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving and solutioning mindset with exposure to digital lending, LOS/LMS, bureau data, and embedded finance models.
* Exposure to international markets such as MENA, Africa and APAC.
* Ability to run discovery workshops, design solution architectures, and drive PoCs under tight timelines while collaborating closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering.
* Strong ability to independently manage multiple opportunities and work effectively with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to operate as a hands\-on individual contributor and take ownership of complex enterprise opportunities from discovery through solution design, demo/PoC and deal closure.

Keep project managers informed of activities and alert of any issues promptly. Provide inputs as part of engagement closure on project learnings and suggest improvements.

* Collaborating on cross\-team and cross\-product technical issues with a variety of resources including Product support, IT, and Professional Services.

* Minimum of 9\-12 years of relevant experience
* Well versed with deployment, administration and troubleshooting of the OpenText Content Suit Platform and surrounding components (Content Server, Archive Server, xECM, Brava, OTDS, Search\& Indexing)
* Experience with Cloud deployment of the Content Suit Platform will be an advantage.
* Knowledge on Windows, UNIX, and Application administration skills in a TCP/IP network environment.
* Experience working with relational DBMS (PostgreSQL/Postgres, Oracle, MS SQL Server, mySQL)
* Programming/scripting is helpful, (ie. SQL, .sh/.bat, Java, JavaScript)
* Familiarity with configuration and management of web/application servers (IIS, Apache, Tomcat, JBoss, etc.).

501fd64e.description:
**Solution Architect – Enterprise Platforms \& Deployments** 




**Company** 
 : i\-TEK RFID, Pune
 



**Location:** 
 Pune
 



  





**About i\-TEK**




 i\-TEK is one of India's leading AIDC and RFID technology organizations, with a strong focus on next\-generation products, platforms, intelligent edge ecosystems, and embedded device engineering.
 



 Scale and reach:
 


* Over 5 billion items tagged
* 1,000\+ enterprise customers
* 250\+ million scans processed daily
* Presence across 3,000\+ retail outlets
* Coverage across 10\+ million sq. ft. of warehouse space



 i\-TEK has established itself as a market leader across retail, manufacturing, logistics, banking, and enterprise automation sectors.
 



  





**Strategic platforms:**



* Garuda Vigil — a comprehensive RFID and AIDC management platform enabling enterprises to manage assets, inventory, workflows, and operational visibility at scale.
* Skanixa — an intelligent edgeware and embedded device ecosystem enabling seamless integration between RFID infrastructure, edge devices, sensors, and enterprise applications.



 As part of its next phase of growth, i\-TEK is building globally scalable products and platforms capable of supporting enterprise customers across industries and geographies through SaaS, dedicated deployments, and hybrid architectures.
 



  





**Role Overview:**




 The Solution Architect will serve as the technical deployment authority for i\-TEK's products and platforms.
 



 The role is responsible for defining and governing deployment architectures, infrastructure sizing, security considerations, and operational readiness for customer implementations.
 



 The Solution Architect will act as the bridge between Product Engineering, Delivery, Customer Technology Teams, Infrastructure Teams, Security Teams, and Partner Ecosystems.
 



 The successful candidate will possess deep expertise across enterprise application deployments, cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and high\-availability architectures.
 



 The individual will be the technical face of i\-TEK during customer engagements and must be capable of confidently engaging with customer CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, Security Teams, and Infrastructure Teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Solution Architecture \& Deployment Strategy** 



* Define deployment architectures for Garuda Vigil and Skanixa implementations.

* SaaS environments
* Customer\-managed environments
* Hybrid deployments
* Multi\-site deployments

**Security Architecture** 



* Design secure deployment topologies.

**Network \& Infrastructure Design** 



* Define network topologies supporting customer deployments.
* Design architectures involving Load Balancers, Reverse Proxies, Firewalls, VPN Connectivity, Edge Connectivity, and Cloud Networking.
* Validate infrastructure readiness prior to deployment.



**Cloud \& Hyperscaler Expertise** 



* Maintain deep understanding of cloud offerings across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Recommend deployment strategies leveraging cloud\-native capabilities.
* Evaluate emerging services and technologies from hyperscalers.
* Drive best practices around cloud adoption and modernization.



**Customer Engagement \& Technical Leadership** 



* Serve as the primary technical advisor during customer engagements.
* Present deployment recommendations to customer stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales and strategic customer pursuits.
* Build strong relationships with customer technology leadership teams.



**Technology Evolution** 



* Track emerging technology trends.
* Recommend deployment innovations and automation opportunities.
* Drive standardization and simplification of deployment models.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of deployment frameworks.



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 12–15\+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Infrastructure Architecture, Cloud Architecture, and Enterprise Platform Deployments.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and complex deployment environments.
* Experience supporting large\-scale technology implementations.



 Preferred exposure to:
 


* Retail Technology
* Supply Chain Platforms
* Industrial IoT
* Enterprise Automation
* RFID and AIDC ecosystems

 Strong expertise across:
 


* Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

* Load Balancing
* Firewalls
* Security Architecture
* High Availability Design
* Disaster Recovery
* Container Platforms
* Kubernetes
* API Architecture

* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong customer\-facing presence.
* Ability to engage with senior technology stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving capability.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Collaborative and execution\-oriented mindset.



**Success Metrics** 




 The success of the Solution Architect will be measured through:
 


* Deployment success rates
* Solution quality
* Customer satisfaction
* Platform performance
* Security compliance
* Deployment timelines
* Architecture standardization
* Reduction in deployment issues



**Why Join i\-TEK** 




 This is an opportunity to become the technical deployment authority behind one of India's most ambitious RFID and AIDC platform companies.

* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).

+ Veeam Certified Engineer
+ VMware certified Professional: Data Centre Virtualization
+ Zerto, pure, vxrail

76166565.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Job Specific Summary
  

ServiceNow Architect
  

Job Description
  

Work on a growing, dynamic team to guide the design and implementation of new ServiceNow features, custom enhancements to ServiceNow applications, new custom applications, and migration of legacy solutions to the latest technologies. Our current programs include a broad rollout of NowAssist and Predictive Intelligence capabilities, expansion of Configurable Workspace capabilities, and numerous modernization and automation initiatives.
  

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
  

* Develop and maintain the overall ServiceNow platform architecture, ensuring alignment with business goals and industry best practices.
* Lead the design of scalable and sustainable solutions, considering performance, security, and integration requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to a team of ServiceNow developers and administrators.
* Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to understand requirements and assist in translating them into effective ServiceNow solutions.
* Work with enterprise and business unit architects to align on strategic direction and tactical decisions while representing the needs of the ServiceNow platform
* Oversee the implementation and configuration of ServiceNow modules.
* Ensure adherence to coding and configuration standards.
* Design and implement integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems to streamline processes and data flow.
* Participate in establishing and enforcing guardrails, policies, and ensuring compliance with security standards and regulations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including IT teams, business units, and external vendors, to gather requirements and ensure successful platform implementation.
* Act as a bridge between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, facilitating effective communication.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including architectural diagrams, configuration guides, and best practice documentation.
* Provide training and mentorship to team members to enhance their ServiceNow skills.

Requirements
  

* Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214\.2(h)(4\)(iii)(A)
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree plus relevant experience
* Proven experience of 2\+ years as a ServiceNow Platform Architect, with a strong focus on platform design and implementation
* Active ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification
* ServiceNow Architect certification is highly desirable
* Proven experience leading ServiceNow implementations, including customization, integration, and development.

In\-depth understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, ServiceNow modules, scripting, integrations, and best practices.
  

* Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and AJAX, along with experience in web application development and ServiceNow platform functionalities
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to troubleshoot issues and optimize processes
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders
* Relevant certifications such as ServiceNow Certified Application Developer or Certified Implementation Specialist (HR/CSM/ITSM)
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, with the capability to mentor and guide ServiceNow developers.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience creating and maintaining an Architecture Blueprint for a ServiceNow ecosystem
* Demonstrated experience developing and supporting custom Service Portal widgets and pages, including complex CSS and user interfaces
* Practical experience with ServiceNow AI Search configuration and optimization
* Practical experience with NowAssist configuration and optimization
* Practical experience building and supporting custom Configurable Workspaces
* Practical experience with designing and building Flow Designer Flows
* Extensive experience designing and implementing custom REST integrations, including experience building reusable frameworks and transitioning to IntegrationHub spokes
* Experience configuring OAuth authentication and Single Sign\-on solutions

* Strong leadership and stakeholder management
* Deep expertise in GCP, microservices, and DevOps

fcf71284.title: Delivery Lead Manager
fcf71284.description:
**Skill required:** 
 Marketing Operations \- Digital Project Management
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Delivery Lead Manager
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 Any Graduation
   

  

**Years of Experience:** 
 13 to 18 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 699,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 Assists or leads in developing supplier/vendor/sub\-contractor strategy for service delivery operations. Awareness of LifeSciences; pharma products \& cross channels Understand and implement tools which would lead to efficiency gains Manage recruiting, staffing, pyramid mix, utilization and capacity of staff to optimize balance between cost and delivery targets. Resolve performance issues with delivery leadership. Responsible for improving delivery and both supporting and assisting in the creation of strategic initiatives for clients partnering with the different teams within Accenture. Formalize delivery plans for the service delivery operations(s) with service group delivery leadership. Ensure execution of delivery work across one or more service delivery operations. Deliver efficiencies through standard processes and synergies. Manage supply and demand, service quality and processes to meet delivery expectations, always looking for methods of improvement. Proactively improve client and customer relationships through extensive contact, while working with Client Account and Account Delivery Team leadership. Deliver agreed scope of services while achieving profitability improvements and productive gains. Manage and reduce costs on standard offerings, assets, technologies, licenses and facilities. Implement standard service level agreement (SLA) and other financial/operational metrics. Support the achievement of targets on contract controllable income (CCI) and cost\-to\-serve. Support estimate at completion (EAC) adjustments (if required). Achieve year on year efficiencies in conjunction with the delivery service providers. Designs and drives Program/Capability ownership, Stakeholder management and collaboration. Ensuring customer satisfaction by acting as the escalation point for any problems or concerns from project and delivery managers, as well as clients. Responsible for all services including incident and change management. Drive optimization of delivery of standard solutions within area(s) of expertise. Address performance issues across the service delivery operations, create operational approach and implement continuous improvement. Implement the levers to consistently achieve performance targets such as Six Sigma, operational excellence, etc. Participate in account quality review process and engage appropriately in the Accenture Quality Assurance program.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Review and validate the standard solutions/models for new deals and take responsibility for their successful execution/completion. Tracking duties and deliverables from several project managers and their respective projects. Responsible for career management of service delivery operations staff (training, engagement, mentoring, succession planning and annual performance process). Lead service delivery strategy and execution. Act as subject matter expert supporting teams and applying deep expertise and knowledge. Certified in PMP, Agile methodologies, Scrum, Six Sigma / Lean Manufacturing certification is a plus. Strong leadership and team management capabilities. Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Change management and stakeholder influencing abilities.
   

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** 
 Fluent in oral and written English skills (will have direct contact with clients). Proven leadership skills. Ability to motivate others to achieve goals and deadlines. Conflict resolution and negotiation skills to balance customer s needs and goals with company s strategies and goals. Skilled at delegating tasks to others. Generation of clear and functional reports for both supervisors and peers (both technical and non\-technical). At least 10 years of experience leading Software Development with emphasis in web / front\-end technology\-based delivery. Expertise in Digital Content Publishing. Extensive experience working with global teams and offshore/nearshore production At least 15 years of experience in Client Management and relationship\-building. The ability to lead a complex project/program in which new services/tools are used or created. Recognize issues and opportunities and initiate proper action to solve or take advantage of them. Monitor and devise methods of improvement for overall performance and services. Review and contribute to creation of financial reports and supporting documentation for funders as outlined in funding agreements by projects. Ensure operations teams are aware of expectations and business needs. Assure successful service delivery \- SLA achievement and high level of customer satisfaction. Collaborate with Sr. management to create strategies for improved client account management as well as growth and other opportunities. Working with the client and operations teams to identify and manage service improvement activities.

91a2e16a.title: [Upcoming Roles] Technical Delivery Manager
91a2e16a.description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**This job posting is part of our proactive talent pipelining efforts for future openings. While there may not be an immediate vacancy, candidates may be invited to complete assessments or interviews at this stage. By applying, you consent to being considered for relevant opportunities that may arise within the next 6 months.**
**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Delivery Manager in the Google Operations Center, you'll play a critical role in overseeing the development and delivery of our essential internal tools and applications. You'll collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders across Google to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution. If you have a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions, a deep understanding of software development lifecycles, and exceptional communication and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply!
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Organizational Leadership: Manage and develop a team of Team Leads. Provide regular coaching, mentoring, and performance management to elevate their leadership capabilities and support their career growth.
* Workflow Oversight: Serve as the focal point of contact for internal and external project queries, ensuring that the team’s actions remain in synergy with broader business goals.
* Strategic Alignment: Ensure the development teams' work aligns with the overall strategic goals and roadmap of the Google Operations Center. This includes understanding the big picture and translating it into actionable plans for the teams.
* Cross\-Team Coordination: Work with domain experts, SWE, UX, and PM to translate project requirements into technical tasks.
* Risk Management and Mitigation: Proactively identify and assess potential risks that could impact project delivery, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as needed to ensure timely resolution.
* Dependency Management: Identify and manage dependencies between different projects and teams, ensuring that roadblocks are removed and projects are delivered efficiently.
* Process Optimization: Continuously analyze and improve development processes, workflows, and tools to enhance efficiency, productivity, and overall team performance. This could involve implementing Agile best practices, refining communication channels, or introducing new technologies.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Experience: 12y\+ in technical project management, with a focus on maintenance \& core development with multiple dev models like agile / scrum / waterfall.
* People Management: 7y\+ people management experience involving performance management .
* Strong Experience in Project Planning and Scheduling, Team Coordination, Stakeholder Management, Risk Management, Resource Management, and Quality Assurance
* Excellent organizational skills to track project / scrum timelines, roadmaps, and deliverables.
* Strong Experience in end to end Software Development Life Cycle
* Experience with multiple full lifecycles from Design \& Architecture through Development, Testing, Deployment and Debugging production issues.


**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong experience in SQL, Regex, database concepts.
* 5y\+ experience using GIT based continuous integration \& delivery
* Experience with Cloud Computing platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS
* Experience in Middleware development/design (remote procedure call based, publish subscribe based, etc…)


**Benefits**
* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender\-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth\-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

 Lead end\-to\-end delivery, or a defined component of a contract to meet operational, contractual, and financial commitments. Ensure service quality and efficiency. Manage delivery outcomes and identify opportunities for follow\-on work through up\-selling or cross\-selling.

 NA

 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Security Delivery Governance.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

55e95e9e.title: [Upcoming Roles] Technical Program Manager
55e95e9e.description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!

While there may not be an immediate vacancy, candidates may be invited to complete assessments or interviews at this stage. By applying, you consent to being considered for relevant opportunities that may arise within the next 6 months.**
****Role Overview****
 As a Technical Program Manager at Google Operations Center, you will serve as a strategic operational lead, responsible for orchestrating complex, cross\-functional programs to ensure seamless execution and delivery. You will function as the primary bridge between technical teams and executive leadership, translating intricate technical challenges into high\-level business insights. The ideal candidate will possess the capability to navigate organizational ambiguity, facilitate strategic alignment across diverse stakeholders, and provide decisive leadership during high\-stakes product launches to ensure operational excellence.
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Program Orchestration \& Delivery: Define dependencies, clear operational bottlenecks, and track program velocity to ensure predictable delivery. Synthesize complex project tracks into a cohesive program roadmap.
* Support for Critical Launches: Serve as the operational lead for high\-stakes, time\-sensitive product or feature launches. Establish launch readiness criteria, run "go/no\-go" checkpoints, and create hypercare support plans for post\-launch stability. Manage real\-time risk mitigation and lead fire\-drills when unforeseen blockers threaten launch dates.
* Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary interface between working execution teams and executive leadership. Manage competing priorities across departments, aligning diverse agendas around shared program objectives. Proactively identify alignment gaps and facilitate strategic trade\-off decisions with senior stakeholders.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Translate technical complexities into clear, business\-focused updates for non\-technical teams and executives. Establish standard operating procedures for status reporting, ensuring a single, accurate source of truth for the program's health. Foster an environment of transparency, ensuring risks are flagged early and constructively.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Bridge organizational silos by facilitating cross\-functional syncs, workshops, and retro meetings. Ensure resource allocations match program priorities across engineering, product, design, and operations.


**Requirements**
****Minimum Requirements****
* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in program or project management, ideally leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives in a physical or operational setting.
* Methodology Expertise: Strong proficiency with project management tools and methodologies. PMP, Scrum Master (CSM), or equivalent certification is a strong plus.
* Technical Experience: Basic knowledge of Java, HTML, and CSS, or equivalent Technical Program Management experience.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, communicating technical work to non\-technical executive teams, with a proven ability to influence without authority and present to senior executives.
* Adaptability: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and pivoting quickly in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*
* Preferred Certifications: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or Project Management Professional (PMP) certifications are strong indicators of qualified candidates for this role.


**Benefits**
* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage

50324e01.title: Service Delivery Architect for Applications, Business Processing, and Infrastructure Services
50324e01.description:
**Req ID:** 364616
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Service Delivery Architect for Applications, Business Processing, and Infrastructure Services to join our team in Noida, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

Job Description
  
  

Position Title Service Delivery Architect for Applications, Business Processing, and Infrastructure Services
  
  

Position's Role Architect
  
  

**Skills:**  

**Primary Skill:** Yrs Exp Expert (5\+ Years Experience)
  
  

Enterprise Infrastructure Architect
  
  

**Delivery Oversight:** Strategy\-Planning\-Assessment
  
  

Skill
  
  

Solution Architect\-Solution Architecture\-Infrastructure Solution Architect\-Design and Costing of Solutions, PreSales for Enterprise Systems
  
  

**Primary Skill:** Yrs Exp Expert (5\+ Years Experience)
  
  

Solution Architecture
  
  

Position's General Duties and Tasks
  
* Work collaboratively to ensure the successful design (and delivery) of assigned projects and programs for our clients and contributing to the growth targets.
* Work closely with subject matter experts (Technical Architects, Principal Architects, Delivery resources) to ensure the end\-to\-end solution is deliverable and meets cost targets.
* Drive risk identification and management to ensure that the solutions designed meet the needs of the client and are deliverable by the practice.
* Oversee and guide review of solution and delivery architecture.
* Understand, document, and drive development of review and approval processes and tools
* Understand and use competitive financial and benefit analysis.
* Develop and document standards around IT services solutions.
* Serve as an expert consultant to senior leadership and primary and technical architectures
* Act as an "agent of change” and continuously foster the sharing of customer, architecture, and technical information between organizations.


Key Skills
  
* Strong leadership, business, technical, analytical, problem solving and verbal and written communication skills with the willingness to travel when required
* Self\-motivation and ability to work on own initiative, as well as be a strong contributor in a team environment, natural drive to learn and pick up new challenges
* Experience in developing complex solutions to business problems or customer engagements
* Familiar with technologies and processes used to support and deliver complex multi\-tower outsourcing relationships.
* Understand and interpret requirements by probing for information, facilitating consensus building, and synthesizing and translating ideas into actionable requirements.
* Familiarity with industry trends and new developments and using this knowledge in developing differentiated solutions for opportunities
* Great collaborator with strong and positive influencing/negotiating skills coupled with strategic thinking


**Basic Required Qualifications:**  

* Experience in IT outsourcing – infrastructure solutions development, modeling and costing
* An understanding of services delivery architecture or experience in leading / managing complex multi\-tower outsourcing relationships
* Fluency in English is critical.
* Flexibility to work with Global teams and stakeholders
* Understanding the impact of automation and efficiencies on solutions.
* Subject matter expert in at least one service area or technology and proficient in multiple service areas and technologies.
* In\-depth knowledge of assessing operational risk on profitability and impacts to service delivery.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience in IT Services Delivery – managing multiple delivery teams and / or PL
* Relevant Experience and/or Industry Certification (ITIL, DevSecOps, TOGAF, Agile, or Industry cloud certifications) in Service Management and/or Application Development
* Experience in Web\-based applications development and deployment
* Experience with Microsoft Office / O365 including Macro Design and Programming
* Experience in VB and/or other development languages suitable for Office and Web\-based applications development and deployment
* Experience in Infrastructure architecting and implementing solutions, while providing ongoing solutions support


About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.

8d121c52.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Solution Planner
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Analyzes client requirements and supports configuring a solution from a standard set of offerings. Liaisons with the delivery organization to ensure effective transition, shape services, and determine appropriate service delivery locations and related costs. Works with client stakeholders to receive sign\-off on the solution.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Solution Architecture
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Program Project Management
   

  

**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 Graduate or Master graduate with good grades and 10 plus years Solution Architect experience with related certifications good to have
   

  

 Summary: As a Solution Planner, you will engage in a dynamic and collaborative environment where you will analyze client requirements and support the configuration of solutions from a standard set of offerings. Your typical day will involve liaising with the delivery organization to ensure effective transitions, shaping services, and determining appropriate service delivery locations and related costs. You will also work closely with client stakeholders to secure sign\-off on the proposed solutions, ensuring that all aspects of the project align with client expectations and organizational standards. Roles \& Responsibilities: \- Expected to be a Subject Matter Expert with deep knowledge and experience. \- Should have influencing and advisory skills. \- Responsible for team decisions. \- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. \- Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams. \- Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather requirements and present solutions. \- Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure alignment and satisfaction. Professional \& Technical Skills: \- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Solution Architecture. \- Good To Have Skills: Experience with Program Project Management. \- Strong understanding of system integration and architecture frameworks. \- Ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into effective solutions. \- Experience in stakeholder management and communication. Additional Information: \- The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Solution Architecture. \- This position is open for almost all the locations in India. \- A Graduate or Master graduate with good grades and 10 plus years Solution Architect experience with related certifications is good to have

21630cd3.title: Customer Engineer, Platform, Google Cloud
21630cd3.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building the technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors).


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs\-of\-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
   

  

 You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted business motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots and workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post\-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross\-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

bc1c530e.title: Delivery manager | Banaglore, India | JPMC
bc1c530e.description:
a { text\-decoration: none; color: \#464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid \#e6e6e6; } tr th { background\-color: \#f5f5f5; }


Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced **Delivery Manager** with **10\+ years of experience** in IT Delivery, Programme Management, and Client Engagement within the **Banking, Financial Services, and Capital Markets (BFSI)** domain. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing large\-scale technology programmes, leading distributed delivery teams, driving stakeholder engagement, ensuring successful project execution, and delivering business outcomes aligned with client objectives.


The candidate should possess strong experience working with Tier\-1 financial institutions, managing complex digital transformation initiatives, application development programmes, cloud migration projects, data platforms, or enterprise modernisation programmes.


Key Responsibilities Delivery \& Programme Management
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technology programmes and strategic initiatives.
* Own project planning, delivery governance, risk management, and financial tracking.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meet quality standards.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects and cross\-functional delivery teams.
* Establish delivery metrics, KPIs, and executive reporting mechanisms.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across delivery processes.

Client \& Stakeholder Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for business and technology stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with banking and financial services clients.
* Lead steering committee meetings, governance reviews, and executive presentations.
* Manage client escalations and ensure timely resolution of delivery risks.
* Collaborate with business leaders to define strategy, scope, and priorities.

Team Leadership
* Lead and mentor project managers, architects, engineering leads, and delivery teams.
* Drive resource planning, workforce management, and capacity forecasting.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Support performance management and skill development initiatives.

Risk, Compliance \& Governance
* Identify delivery risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Ensure adherence to banking regulatory requirements and security standards.
* Manage audit compliance, operational risk controls, and governance frameworks.
* Maintain programme documentation, reporting, and change management processes.

Financial Management
* Own programme P\&L, budgeting, forecasting, and revenue tracking.
* Monitor project profitability and utilisation metrics.
* Drive account growth through proactive identification of new opportunities.
* Support contract negotiations, scope management, and resource planning.

Required Skills \& Experience Delivery Management
* 10\+ years of overall IT experience.
* 5\+ years in Delivery Manager, Programme Manager, Senior Project Manager, or Account Delivery Manager roles.
* Proven experience managing large enterprise engagements ($1M\+ programmes preferred).
* Strong expertise in Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models.
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams.

Banking \& Financial Services Domain
* Strong experience with Banking, Investment Banking, Consumer Banking, Commercial Banking, Wealth Management, Capital Markets, Payments, Treasury, Risk, or Regulatory Reporting domains.
* Understanding of banking technology ecosystems and regulatory environments.
* Experience working directly with banking clients and senior business stakeholders.

Technology Understanding
* Strong understanding of:
	+ Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
	+ Digital Transformation Programmes
	+ Enterprise Applications
	+ API \& Microservices Architecture
	+ Data Engineering \& Analytics Platforms
	+ DevOps \& CI/CD
	+ AI / GenAI Initiatives
	+ Mobile \& Digital Banking Solutions

Governance \& Reporting
* Expertise in programme governance, portfolio management, RAID management, and executive reporting.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, and Confluence.
* Strong financial planning and resource management skills.

Advanced\-Level Expectations
* Own strategic delivery engagements with global banking clients.
* Manage programmes with budgets exceeding $5M.
* Influence executive stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Drive large\-scale transformation and modernisation initiatives.
* Establish delivery excellence frameworks and governance standards.
* Create long\-term account growth strategies.
* Lead vendor management and multi\-partner delivery models.
* Ensure successful delivery across technology, operations, and business workstreams.

Preferred Qualifications
* MBA or Master's degree in Business, Technology, or Management.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe Agilist, PMI\-ACP, or Scrum certifications.
* Banking industry certifications are an advantage.
* Experience managing offshore\-onshore delivery models.
* Exposure to AI, Data, Cloud Migration, and Digital Banking Transformation programmes.

517e49b7.title: Sr Solution Architect - Consulting - WMS
517e49b7.description:
**Overview**
 Blue Yonder is currently seeking Enterprise Solution Architect to join our Consulting Services team, specific to the Blue Yonder Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Enterprise Solution Architect provides leadership and direction to the on\-site implementation team on the design and execution of the solution and definition of business process workflows that accompany the solution. The aim of this role is to take ownership of a solution within an implementation project and architect software solutions that solve the customer’s business problem, while generating maximum value for the customer..
   

  

**Scope**
 Core responsibilities to include Designing, Developing, Unit testing and Validation of New modification and provide support to any production issues related to Modification
   

  

 Be trusted advisor to customer and ability to articulate supply chain logistic business process and solution.
   

  

 Drive value for customer
   

  

**Our Current Technical Environment**
 Software: Java, Java Script, GIT, Rest API, XML/XSLT, MS SQL, PL/SQL
   

  

 Application Architecture: MOCA, PageBuilder and Integrator
   

  

 Cloud Architecture: MS Azure
   

  

 Databases – Oracle / SQL Server
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Leveraged as the Blue Yonder/RedPrairie WMS solution expert for transformational projects/programs
   

  

 Strong domain knowledge in Blue Yonder/RedPrairie WMS solution to understand how the Blue Yonder solutions can be configured and delivered to better facilitate customer business processes
   

  

 Strong domain knowledge in Blue Yonder/RedPrairie Discrete WMS solution to construct an overall architecture for current and future customer business needs
   

  

 Key contributor to the Change Management efforts for global or regional program implementations
   

  

* Ability to prepare and deliver presentations for user, management, and executive level audiences


 Provides advice to customers regarding industry best practices and process methodology
   

  

 Assists Project Manager(s) in planning efforts
   

  

 Able to ask appropriate questions to assess business needs that fall outside the standard solution, assess integration complexity, architecture constraints
   

  

 Can demonstrate and facilitate integration discussions of product functionality and product architecture (i.e. Show data and process flow from one Blue Yonder solution to another)
   

  

 Lead the project team to design and develop functional specifications for modifications, interfaces, reports and screens to ensure smooth integration between technical and functional business requirements
   

  

 Lead the project team in preparing Product Requirement Specifications, test plan for modifications
   

  

 Interact closely with Development services in modification development, quality delivery and organizing demonstrations with customers on modifications.
   

  

 Creates and modifies procedural and system documentation throughout the project
   

  

 Supports the development and execution of test scripts to ensure Blue Yonder consistently meets the customer's business objectives
   

  

 Provides level 3 non\-technical support during the "go\-live" period
   

  

 Provides level 3 user support and verifies that the system provides the required business functions and maintains data integrity
   

  

 Serves as a technical liaison and attends and contributes to key meetings between Project Manager, key customer contacts, and customer users, up to and including key executive project sponsors.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 15 – 18 years of corporate experience
   

  

 Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or Engineering or other relevant discipline.
   

  

 Expertise in technical configuration of WMS product, Solution Integration, Quality Assurance, System Testing, PLSQL, SQL Server, and Performance Tuning.
   

  

 Hands\-on Experience on Technical configuration of WMS product (preferably Blue Yonder/RedPrairie WMS), Jasper reports, Nice labels, Pagebuilder and MOCA.
   

  

 Knowledge on interfaces between WMS and ERP/Host, TMS, WLM, T\&T, Parcel, 3rd party system that integrates with WMS.
   

  

 Knowledge on integration between WMS and Voice / Material Handling / ASRS systems
   

  

 Ability to resolve complex problems with minimal guidance.
   

  

 Excellent computer skills with in\-depth knowledge of operating systems, client/server technology, ERP systems, Integration and Middleware technologies and applications
   

  

 Ability to develop and maintain strong, productive relationships with customers, partners and consultants
   

  

 Strong proactive communicator and presenter, able to influence and collaborate at all levels of an organization to maximize problem resolution while effectively presenting information and responding to highly specialized technical questions
   

  

 Highly developed analytical and problem solving skills
   

  

 Ability to effectively and proactively work independently
   

  

 Teamwork mentality
   

  

 Contributes to the growth of the technical consulting practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, best\-practice collateral.
   

  

 Ensures compliance with the following internal and external company policies and procedures: Company project methodology On\-time submission of Time, Travel and Expenses report Company procedures related to travel and expenses
   

  

 Skill set and availability requirements as per the organization's needs
   

  

 Knowledge in performance tuning techniques is added advantage.
   

  

 Knowledge on Azure fundamentals
   

  

 Provides guidance to Support Services in responding to base technical issues.
   

  

 Understanding and experience with the technical requirements for the product line assigned.
   

  

 Understanding of Database structures. Understanding of various technical platforms and infrastructures.
   

  

 Understands Blue Yonder product suite so as to convey relationships and touch\-points to the customer.
   

  

 Works with appropriate parties to ensure issues are resolved.
   

  

 Travel readiness based on business needs.
   

  

**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

062e56c1.title: Applied Solutions Architect, Google Cloud
062e56c1.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Experience designing and building AI applications.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the technical bridge between our customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer the Proof of Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. By keeping the final production end\-state in mind from day one, you will advocate for our AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape. Design comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation. Code, build, and deploy robust cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions—such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and applied foundation models—backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value. Ensure all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 Enterprise Technology Architect

 Architect complex end\-to\-end IT solutions across the enterprise. Apply the latest technology and industry expertise to create better products and experiences.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 High Tech Solutions
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA

 15 years full time education

This role involves collaborating with various teams and ecosystem partners to design and implement efficient, scalable, and secure solutions for these Hi\-Tech clients. c02eb5f0.description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Recruitment Operations / Delivery Manager** to manage our recruitment team and drive **bulk and volume hiring** requirements across multiple clients.

The role will be responsible for recruiter productivity, recruitment delivery, client coordination, hiring targets, MIS and ensuring timely closures.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of recruiters to achieve hiring targets.
* Handle **bulk and volume hiring requirements** across multiple clients.
* Drive recruitment delivery from sourcing to joining.
* Set and monitor daily, weekly and monthly recruitment targets.
* Track recruiter performance, productivity and conversion ratios.
* Manage profiles sourced, calls, interviews, selections, offers and joinings.
* Plan and execute walk\-in drives and mass hiring campaigns.
* Coordinate with clients on requirements, interview schedules, feedback and closures.
* Ensure client requirements are delivered within agreed TAT.
* Train, coach and motivate recruiters to improve performance.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly recruitment MIS reports.
* Identify gaps in the recruitment funnel and implement corrective actions.
* Manage escalations and ensure smooth recruitment operations.

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in **Recruitment, Staffing, BPO Operations, Recruitment Operations or Volume Hiring**.
* Experience managing a team of recruiters or operations team.
* Strong experience in **bulk/volume hiring and high\-volume recruitment delivery**.
* Good understanding of recruitment funnel and performance metrics.
* Strong communication and client\-management skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel and MIS reporting**.
* Strong leadership, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a target\-driven and fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates from **BPO, Healthcare BPO, Staffing, Recruitment, BGV, Customer Service or other high\-volume hiring environments** will be preferred.

**If you are a hands\-on recruitment leader who can drive team productivity and deliver bulk hiring requirements within timelines, we would like to hear from you.**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

cdc5c656.title: Cloud AI Security - Manager
cdc5c656.description:
**Cyber**


Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

**Job Title:** Manager \- Cloud AI Security

  



Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.

 **Work you’ll do**


As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross\-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high\-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management.


Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:

* Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
* Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Oversee AI security assessments for cloud\-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001\.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use.
* Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations.
* Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud\-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Oversee implementation of platform\-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service\-native logging and monitoring.
* Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining.
* Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment.
* Drive AI security posture management using cloud\-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations.
* Oversee AI\-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures.
* Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red\-team support, and remediation planning.
* Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams.
* Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery.
* Contribute to business development, proposals, solutioning, thought leadership, reusable assets, and practice development initiatives related to cloud AI security.

**The team**


Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.

 **Required:**

* 9\+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading client\-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI\-related programs.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud\-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments.
* Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables.


**Preferred:**

* Experience leading AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, remediation programs, or transformation initiatives across one or more major cloud platforms.
* Deep hands\-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud\-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, AI runtime monitoring, and agent security for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM\-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API\-driven, and agent\-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, documentation standards, and audit support.
* Experience contributing to proposals, solution development, go\-to\-market offerings, and practice\-building activities.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Azure security certifications, or comparable senior\-level cloud and security credentials.

**How you’ll grow**


At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands\-on experience in the global, fast\-changing business world. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.

**Benefits**


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Deloitte’s culture**


Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well\-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.

 **Corporate citizenship**


Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.

 **Recruiter tips**


We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared and confident. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research: know some background about the organization and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

  


**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  


Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  


At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
**Benefits to help you thrive**  


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria.
