732201cd.title: [Upcoming Roles] Senior Technical Program Manager
732201cd.description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**This job posting is part of our proactive talent pipelining efforts for future openings. While there may not be an immediate vacancy, candidates may be invited to complete assessments or interviews at this stage. By applying, you consent to being considered for relevant opportunities that may arise within the next 6 months.**
****Role Overview****
 As a Senior Technical Program Manager at Google Operations Center, you will serve as a strategic operational lead, responsible for orchestrating complex, cross\-functional programs to ensure seamless execution and delivery. You will function as the primary bridge between technical teams and executive leadership, translating intricate technical challenges into high\-level business insights. The ideal candidate will possess the capability to navigate organizational ambiguity, facilitate strategic alignment across diverse stakeholders, and provide decisive leadership during high\-stakes product launches to ensure operational excellence.
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Program Orchestration \& Delivery: Define dependencies, clear operational bottlenecks, and track program velocity to ensure predictable delivery. Synthesize complex project tracks into a cohesive program roadmap.
* Support for Critical Launches: Serve as the operational lead for high\-stakes, time\-sensitive product or feature launches. Establish launch readiness criteria, run "go/no\-go" checkpoints, and create hypercare support plans for post\-launch stability. Manage real\-time risk mitigation and lead fire\-drills when unforeseen blockers threaten launch dates.
* Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary interface between working execution teams and executive leadership. Manage competing priorities across departments, aligning diverse agendas around shared program objectives. Proactively identify alignment gaps and facilitate strategic trade\-off decisions with senior stakeholders.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Translate technical complexities into clear, business\-focused updates for non\-technical teams and executives. Establish standard operating procedures for status reporting, ensuring a single, accurate source of truth for the program's health. Foster an environment of transparency, ensuring risks are flagged early and constructively.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Bridge organizational silos by facilitating cross\-functional syncs, workshops, and retro meetings. Ensure resource allocations match program priorities across engineering, product, design, and operations.


**Requirements**
****Minimum Requirements****
* Experience: 10\+ years of experience in program or project management, ideally leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives in a physical or operational setting.
* Methodology Expertise: Strong proficiency with project management tools and methodologies. PMP, Scrum Master (CSM), or equivalent certification is a strong plus.
* Technical Experience: Basic knowledge of Java, HTML, and CSS, or equivalent Technical Program Management experience.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, communicating technical work to non\-technical executive teams, with a proven ability to influence without authority and present to senior executives.
* Adaptability: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and pivoting quickly in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*
* Preferred Certifications: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or Project Management Professional (PMP) certifications are strong indicators of qualified candidates for this role.


**Benefits**
* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender\-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth\-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences


 Information collected and processed as part of your Google Operations Center (GOC) jobs profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to GOC's Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy.
   

  

 Google Operations Center (GOC) is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
   

  

 To ensure a barrier\-free interview, please mention any required assistance or specific arrangements in your application and confirm them with your recruiter.
   

  

 To all recruitment agencies: Google Operations Center (GOC) does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, GOC employees, or any other organization location. GOC is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
   

  

*Thanks for your interest in this opportunity! Our recruitment team will contact you if your profile is a good fit for the role. If you don't hear from us within 2\-3 weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful at this time. We value your patience throughout this time. For any questions, feel free to reach out to us at goc\-candidate\-global@googleoperationscenter.com.*

d650aaa2.description:
**About The Role**
 Innovaccer is seeking a Program Manager with deep experience in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and healthcare technology implementations, including large\-scale systems such as EHRs. This role is critical to driving operational excellence and delivering complex, multi\-million\-dollar solutions to our enterprise healthcare clients. You will lead cross\-functional teams, manage Agile delivery, and ensure successful outcomes aligned with client goals and Innovaccer's strategic vision.
   

  

**Customer Success At Innovaccer**
 Our mission is to turn our customers into tech\-savvy superheroes, ensuring they achieve success using our Innovaccer is seeking a Program Manager with deep experience in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and healthcare technology implementations, including large\-scale systems such as EHRs. This role is critical to driving operational excellence and delivering complex, multi\-million\-dollar solutions to our enterprise healthcare clients. You will lead cross\-functional teams, manage Agile delivery, and ensure successful outcomes aligned with client goals and Innovaccer's strategic vision to meet their organization's business goals. If you're passionate about helping customers realize the value they seek with technology, then our customer success team is the right place for you
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
* Lead end\-to\-end project delivery across scope, planning, risk, issue, communication, and integration management
* Manage Agile delivery frameworks and scale processes across teams and stakeholders
* Own project execution against contract/service order, ensuring alignment with client expectations and business outcomes
* Translate complex healthcare and RCM requirements into actionable plans and deliverables
* Develop and maintain project artifacts: charters, Gantt charts, sprint plans, best practices, and lessons learned
* Track and report progress using tools like Smartsheet, JIRA, Confluence, and others
* Proactively manage risks and issues, driving resolution through stakeholder collaboration
* Prepare and present governance reports, OKRs, KPIs, and executive dashboards
* Coordinate across product, engineering, infrastructure, and client teams to ensure seamless delivery
* Oversee transition to production support and manage post\-go\-live activities including ticket resolution
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, demos
* Serve as a subject matter expert in project management and Agile delivery within the organization


**What You Need**
* 10\+ years of over all experience with 5\+ years of core program management experience in healthcare technology and agile frameworks
* Proven experience in RCM workflows, payer\-provider integrations, and value\-based care models
* Hands\-on experience with large system implementations, especially EHR platforms (Epic, Cerner, etc.)
* Very strong stakeholder management and customer\-facing skills
* Background in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline
* Proficiency in project management and Agile tools: JIRA (Hands\-on and must be able to write complex JQL's), Confluence, Smart sheet, Rally; AI Tools (Hands\-on)
* Experience with AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) including prompt engineering and practical application to improve workflows, processes, or team efficiency
* Experience with healthcare data formats: CCDA, HL7, FHIR
* Familiarity with APIs, SQL, BI tools, and automation concepts
* PMP or equivalent certification preferred
* Experience with government healthcare programs is a plus.


 We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.
   

  

* Generous Leaves: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days
* Parental Leave: Leverage one of industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition
* Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered
* Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most
* Care Program: Whether it's a celebration or a time of need, we've got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need
* Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we're here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most


 Innovaccer is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.
   

  

**Disclaimer:**
 Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.
   

  

**About Innovaccer**
 Innovaccer activates the flow of healthcare data, empowering providers, payers, and government organizations to deliver intelligent and connected experiences that advance health outcomes. The Healthcare Intelligence Cloud equips every stakeholder in the patient journey to turn fragmented data into proactive, coordinated actions that elevate the quality of care and drive operational performance. Leading healthcare organizations like CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health trust Innovaccer to integrate a system of intelligence into their existing infrastructure, extending the human touch in healthcare. For more information, visit www.innovaccer.com.
   

  

 Check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Instagram, and the Web.

251c6041.title: Senior Solution Engineer - Presales
251c6041.description:
\#LI\-VC1
 



**About Boomi and What Makes Us Special** 




 Are you ready to work at a fast\-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award\-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity. Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800\+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world\-class people and industry\-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
 



 Presales Solutions Engineer
 



**Why Boomi?** 




 Boomi empowers organizations to move with agility, connect systems and people, and drive business innovation. As a Leader in Gartner’s Enterprise iPaaS Magic Quadrant for 12 consecutive years, and one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces, Boomi is a global integration and automation leader with over 30,000 customers.
 



 We're now accelerating our platform’s impact by:
 



 \- Launching Boomi AgentStudio to enable AI\-powered automation and governance
 



 \- Enhancing data integration and pipeline orchestration with the Rivery acquisition
 



 \- Expanding our offering to include Managed File Transfer (MFT) via the Thru acquisition
 



 At Boomi, we’re bold thinkers who are passionate about solving big challenges. If you’re excited to be part of a company shaping the future of integration, data management, API management and AI, we’d love to hear from you.
 



**Presales Solutions Engineer Overview** 




 Our sales team of Account Executives and Account Managers rely on proactive technical support during the sales process and our expert Presales Solution Engineering team is there to assist. Our Boomi SEs follow a prescriptive technical sales cycle and engagement model, focusing on effectiveness and efficiency. Our SE team is viewed as and treated more than just a technical resource. Rather, our SEs are considered valuable partners throughout the sales journey and help to build trust with our stakeholders and prospects.
 



 As a Presales Solutions Engineer, you will help provide pre\-sales technical support to our field sales teams throughout the sales process. This includes tasks such as account and prospect research, collaborative discovery and needs analysis, formulating a technical strategy and win\-team, executing on that strategy and ultimately getting the technical win.
 



**Job Roles and Responsibilities** 




 \- Lead technical discovery and consultative pre\-sales engagements with prospective customers.
 



 \- Design solution strategies across Boomi’s portfolio of integration, data management, API management and AI.
 



 \- Deliver tailored product demonstrations and technical presentations to both technical and business audiences.
 



 \- Partner with Account Executives and Solution Architects to craft compelling proposals that highlight business value and ROI.
 



 \- Support RFIs/RFPs and Proof\-of\-Concept activities.
 



 \- Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle as well as supporting trade shows, webinars and workshops.
 



 \- Work with Boomi’s Partners to help them position the Boomi platform to their customers.
 



 \- Stay current on AI trends, LLM\-based tooling, competitive offerings, Boomi platform innovations, as well as general customer and industry trends.
 



**Required Skills and Experience** 




 Essential
 



 \- Strong business acumen, with the ability to relate technical features to business impact and value.
 



 \- Technical aptitude and problem\-solving mindset, ideally with exposure to integration, data management, API management and AI platforms.
 



 \- Exceptional presentation and communication skills; comfortable engaging executives, developers, and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 \- Self\-starter who thrives in collaborative, cross\-functional teams and dynamic environments.
 



 Preferred
 



 \- 5\-10 years in presales, solutions consulting, sales engineering, or technical sales roles—preferably in SaaS or iPaaS organizations.
 



 \- Familiarity with:
 



 \- Integration patterns, messaging queues, and middleware concepts
 



 \- APIs and API Management, including Federated API Management
 



 \- Data pipeline and orchestration tools
 



 \- Managed File Transfer (MFT) protocols and use cases
 



 \- AI and LLM\-based applications: familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG, vector search, or agent\-based automation
 



 \- Experience in value\-based selling methodologies.
 



 \- Exposure to basic scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript or Groovy).
 



**Location** 




 \- Must be located in Bangalore
 



**Why Now?** 




 At Boomi, you won’t just showcase technology, you’ll help customers accelerate AI adoption, unlock data value, and build resilient digital ecosystems. It’s an exciting time to be part of a company driving innovation at scale.
 



  





  





**Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi.** 
 We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.
 



*Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees.* 
 All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

2ad3290b.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (APAC)
2ad3290b.description:
Qdrant is an
 **open\-source vector** 
 search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real\-time recommendations.
   

  

 Trusted by global leaders like
 **Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom** 
 , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising
 **$50M in Series B** 
 funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.
   

  

 As a remote\-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.
   

  

 As we expand our presence across Asia\-Pacific, we're looking for a
 **Senior Solutions Engineer** 
 to be the technical authority in deals that determine how enterprises build AI infrastructure for the next decade, and the trusted technical owner for our most strategic accounts in the region. Most SE roles are demo cycles. This one is different.
   

  

 You'll work directly with Staff Engineers and CTOs, architect real systems, and own the technical outcome of every engagement you touch, from a first prospect call through to expansion conversations with customers you already support. We care more about time\-zone overlap with our regional accounts than a specific city, so this role is open to candidates based anywhere aligned with major APAC hubs like India, Singapore, Japan, or Australia.
   

  

****What you will own:****
* Own the technical strategy in enterprise deals from first call to production deployment, partnering with Account Executives to qualify, architect, and close for our entire Asian\-Pacific client base
* Act as a Technical Account Manager for a small portfolio of existing enterprise customers in the region alongside active prospects, identifying new use cases, expansion opportunities, and upsell paths, and looping in Account Executives and internal resources to advocate for the customer.
* Design vector search architectures for high\-scale workloads, including multi\-tenant agentic systems, hybrid search pipelines, and low\-latency retrieval at billion\-vector scale.
* Build proof\-of\-concept systems that customers take to production (not throw away), demonstrating Qdrant's performance advantages over JVM\-based or proprietary alternatives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on AI infrastructure decisions, helping customers navigate migration from legacy databases, avoid architectural lock\-in, and deploy across cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped environments.
* Contribute to the field engineering knowledge base: reference architectures, technical guides, and reusable POC frameworks that scale the team's impact.


****Who you are****
* 5\+ years of pre\-sales or solutions engineering, ideally with a background in data infrastructure or systems architecture. Hands\-on infrastructure depth alone isn't enough, we need a proven track record running technical qualification and proof\-of\-concept processes within a live sales cycle.
* Experience designing or operating distributed systems, search infrastructure, or data pipelines at production scale.
* Ideally, hands\-on experience with RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation) pipelines specifically, plus working knowledge of the broader modern AI stack (LLMs, embedding models, agentic frameworks).
* Ideally, working knowledge of a structured sales qualification framework such as MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, and the ability to apply it in real deal conversations, connecting technical decisions to business outcomes and deal strategy.
* Strong communicator across audiences: you can go deep on indexing trade\-offs with a Staff Engineer and explain infrastructure ROI to a CIO in the same afternoon.


****Nice to have****
* Experience with vector search, approximate nearest neighbor algorithms, or semantic retrieval systems.
* Background with Rust, C\+\+, or other systems languages.
* Familiarity with deployment patterns: Kubernetes, hybrid cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped environments.


****Why join us****

b0501396.title: Data Architect
b0501396.description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

 **Job Summary**

  

ExxonMobil’s **Enterprise Data and Digital Integration** have a mission to develop enterprise data sets in support of the corporate strategy to treat data as an asset to maximize business value. The Data Architect will work closely with other Data Architects, subject matter experts (SMEs), data engineers and developers to design enterprise data sets and consult with projects to ensure data architecture is aligned with enterprise data principles and standards. The position will report to the Data Architect Manager.

 **What you will do:**

  

The Data Architect will work towards building and/or providing knowledge in support of the overall Central Data Office mission and data strategy. To achieve these goals, the Data Architect will be required to analyze current state data architectures and conceive desired future state data architectures and identify activities needed to close the gap to achieve the future state. Some examples of these activities/deliverables are:

  

* Support development of conceptual and logical data models
* Ensures that aspects of an architectural design have been clearly thought out, articulated and fully aligned with business needs while addressing impacts to other underlying platforms and technology components
* Work with Data Governance teams to ensure business glossaries, data dictionaries and data catalogs are created and maintained
* Drive strategies/approaches and principles for data management (including master/reference data and identification of key data domains, data governance framework, etc.)
* Ensure data architecture of delivered solutions support proper security/access, retention and classification
* Consult with projects and ensure solutions are aligned with the CDO vision/mission and enterprise data architecture principles using established data architecture assessment methodologies
* Partner with business leads and data governance groups to support business data needs
* Lead assessments of business/data requirements for projects, products, MVPs and other efforts to validate that overall design satisfies business needs and adheres to key standards and principles
* Provide architectural leadership, guidance, consulting, mentoring, education and support to other architects, data professionals and to projects and product teams
* Provide input to Management of Change (MOC) plans to ensure enterprise data set adoption and sustainability
* Analyze business processes and identify/implement improvement opportunities

 **Preferred Qualifications/ Experience:**

  

* Master's or Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, engineering, systems analysis or a related field
* Minimum 3 years of experience in data design/architecture and strong willingness to continue learning
* Recent experience developing reference data architecture, data modeling (conceptual, logical and physical), data profiling, data quality analysis, building business data glossaries and data catalogs
* Knowledge regarding data governance and master/reference data management programs
* Experience using SQL Server, SQL query language and E/R Studio data modeling tool
* Experience working with agile delivery teams
* Effective planning, communication, collaboration and persuasion skills to drive needed change across the company
* Expert written and verbal communication skills; familiarity with SharePoint team sites to collaborate; self\-starter, takes initiative and is able to work in a fast\-paced environment

 **Preferred Skills \& Experience:**

  

* Experience with MDM tools such as Precisely EnterWorks and cataloging tools such as Collibra
* Understanding of large data store technologies (Data Lakes, Data Warehouse, Data Hubs, etc.)
* Knowledge of XML, JSON, Python; understanding of API concepts and integration architecture
* Knowledge of TOGAF Framework and DAMA DMBoK v.2 desirable
* Leadership: Strong interpersonal skills with ability to influence without direct authority; able to effectively interact with large and diverse user community
* Strong background in data, analytics, systems and tools: good working knowledge of SAP database technologies (ERP, HANA, etc.) and related data extraction tools.

**Job Group**
-------------


Data Management**Functional Skills**
---------------------


Data Modeling
Applied Software Engineering for Data
Data Architecture \& Strategy
Data Integration
Data Compliance Governance \& Security
Data Management  

Alternate Location:

  



Nothing herein is intended to override the corporate separateness of local entities. Working relationships discussed herein do not necessarily represent a reporting connection, but may reflect a functional guidance, stewardship, or service relationship.

  

Exxon Mobil Corporation has numerous affiliates, many with names that include ExxonMobil, Exxon, Esso and Mobil. For convenience and simplicity, those terms and terms like corporation, company, our, we and its are sometimes used as abbreviated references to specific affiliates or affiliate groups. Abbreviated references describing global or regional operational organizations and global or regional business lines are also sometimes used for convenience and simplicity. Similarly, ExxonMobil has business relationships with thousands of customers, suppliers, governments, and others. For convenience and simplicity, words like venture, joint venture, partnership, co\-venturer, and partner are used to indicate business relationships involving common activities and interests, and those words may not indicate precise legal relationships.

Our work spans parametric metal facades, perforated and welded modules, and premium interior cladding — specified by leading architects across India, the Middle East and Europe.
 


 Role Summary
 
 You are the first voice a prospective client hears. You will present Metaguise’s credentials, capabilities and case studies to architects, developers, PMCs and contractors over Zoom and Microsoft Teams — then run a structured discovery conversation to capture the design intent, scale, timeline and commercial context of their project. You will log this into our CRM and hand a qualified, well\-documented brief to the sales team.
 



 This is not a cold\-calling role. Leads are inbound and inbound\-referred. Your job is to represent the brand with polish and extract the intelligence that lets our sales team win.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 •     Deliver Metaguise’s credentials presentation and curated case studies to international and Indian clients over video calls
 



 •     Conduct structured discovery: design language sought, project scale and area, material and finish preferences, budget band, timeline, decision\-making structure and competitive set
 



 •     Qualify opportunities against defined criteria and prioritise accordingly
 



 •     Maintain complete, accurate CRM records — call notes, briefs, attachments, next actions and pipeline stage
 



 •     Prepare and deliver clean handover briefs to the sales and technical teams, including full project diligence
 



 •     Coordinate follow\-up scheduling and keep prospects warm until sales engagement begins
 



 •     Maintain and improve the presentation deck and case study library in coordination with marketing
 



 •     Track and report on lead quality, call\-to\-qualified\-opportunity conversion, and market\-wise trends
 


 Requirements
 
**Essential** 




 •     2–5 years in pre\-sales, client\-facing presentation, inside sales, business development or account management
 



 •     Exceptional spoken and written English with a clear, neutral accent — you will present daily to GCC, European and Indian audiences
 



 •     Strong on\-camera presence: confident, composed and articulate across a structured 30–45 minute presentation
 



 •     Demonstrated CRM proficiency (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Pipedrive or similar) with genuine discipline in data hygiene
 



 •     Excellent active listening and note\-taking; able to translate a loose client conversation into a precise written brief
 



 •     Fluent with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace and PowerPoint
 



**Preferred** 




 •     Exposure to architecture, construction, building materials, interiors or facade systems
 



 •     Experience working with Middle East or European clients
 



 •     Ability to grasp technical vocabulary quickly — finishes, substrates, fabrication methods, installation systems
 



 •     Additional language: Arabic, French or German
 



  




 What Success Looks Like
 
 •     Within 30 days: fluent, independent delivery of the Metaguise credentials presentation
 



 •     Within 60 days: running discovery calls solo with complete CRM capture
 



 •     Within 90 days: measurably improved brief quality and reduced sales\-team rework on handovers
 



  




 What We Offer
 
 •     Competitive salary with performance\-linked incentive tied to qualified pipeline
 



 •     Direct exposure to landmark international architecture projects
 



 •     Structured training on Metaguise products, processes and technical vocabulary
 



 •     Growth path into key account management or market ownership
 



  




 To Apply

We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

 F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
   

  

**The SE Job Overview:**
 The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco\-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
   

  

 The high\-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.
   

  

 Sounds interesting? Read on!

* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in\-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc
* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.
* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.
* Consistently provide world\-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.


**How you’ll do it:**
* Experience in secure Cloud architectures, Security product like WAF, ZTNA, Firewall, SSL VPN
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets, basic CI/CD understanding.
* Experience with SaaS vendor and able to articulate SaaS benefits
* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)
* Proficient in one or more programming languages will be added advantage, good understanding of routing, switching, virtualization


**What you’ll bring:**
* 10\+ years of related industry experience with FSI \& Enterprise background
* 6\+ years of experience in a similar customer facing technical role

In this role, you will impact the strategic direction of our software systems, optimizing their performance and ensuring they meet high standards of reliability and maintainability. By collaborating with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders, you will translate business requirements into effective software architectures, directly contributing to customer satisfaction and the overall success of Honeywell in the dynamic technology landscape.


  
YOU MUST HAVE


* 5\+ years of experience in software architecture and development
* Mastery level knowledge in design principles, architectural patterns, and coding standards
* Expert in multiple programming languages and technologies
* Ability to work under minimal supervision and lead indirect reports by influence

WE VALUE


* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

* Proven ability to drive successful software development projects and initiatives
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Passion for innovation and continuous learning
* Attention to detail and excellent problem\-solving capability

* Lead and oversee the design and development of advanced software solutions
* Provide technical expertise and guidance to a team of software engineers
* Collaborate with crossfunctional teams to define software architecture and requirements
* Drive innovation and ensure the scalability and performance of software systems
* Identify and mitigate risks, and make datadriven decisions to keep projects on track
* Champion best practices in software development and integration
* Present complex technical information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

f65b03b1.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results.  Master's Degree

* Testing and Quality Assurance: Experience with performing unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solution quality.
* Technical Documentation: Experience with developing and maintaining technical documentation, including configuration documents and testing scripts.
* SAP Cloud Integration Releases and Features: Experience with staying up\-to\-date with SAP Cloud Integration releases, patches, and new features, and applying this knowledge to client projects.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* SAP Cloud Integration Releases: Exposure to staying current with SAP Cloud Integration releases, patches, and new features, and applying this knowledge to client projects.
* SAP Systems Integration: Experience with integrating SAP Cloud Integration with other SAP systems, such as SAP ERP, SAP CRM, and SAP BW.
* API Management Knowledge: Exposure to configuring and implementing API Management as part of SAP Cloud Integration solutions.

61d44648.title: Service Delivery Manager – End User Services
61d44648.description:
**Role Description**
 Job Role : Service Delivery Manager, End User Services (Chennai, India) Role Overview :
   

  

 The Service Delivery Manager – End User Services (EUS) will be responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery, governance, performance, and continuous improvement of Digital Workplace and End User Computing services.
   

  

 The role will act as the primary interface between the client, delivery teams, technology teams, and third\-party providers, ensuring services are delivered in line with agreed SLAs, XLAs, security requirements, and business expectations.
   

  

 The successful candidate should have strong service delivery leadership experience combined with a solid understanding of modern endpoint management, Digital Employee Experience (DEX), device lifecycle management, and workplace technologies including Microsoft Intune, Nexthink, SysTrack, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows, Autopilot, SCCM/MECM, and related EUC platforms.
   

  

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
 Service Delivery \& Operations Management
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of End User Services, ensuring services meet agreed SLAs, KPIs, XLAs, contractual commitments, and customer expectations.
* Manage operational performance across Service Desk, Desktop Support, Endpoint Management, Digital Workplace, VDI and associated EUS services.
* Conduct daily operational reviews and regular weekly/monthly service reviews with delivery teams and client stakeholders.
* Monitor incidents, service requests, problems, changes and major incidents affecting end\-user services and drive timely resolution.
* Ensure effective Major Incident Management for high\-impact workplace issues and coordinate technical teams, vendors and business stakeholders.
* Review service performance trends and proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities.
* Own service improvement plans for areas where performance falls below agreed targets.
* Ensure appropriate operational documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles and support processes are maintained. Digital Workplace \& Endpoint Management
* Provide service delivery oversight for endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune and SCCM/MECM, including device enrolment, configuration, application deployment, patching and compliance.
* Understand and oversee Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning processes covering device build, enrolment and user onboarding.
* Support the implementation and operational governance of modern endpoint management and cloud\-based workplace strategies.
* Ensure endpoint security and compliance policies are effectively implemented and monitored in collaboration with Security and IAM teams.
* Coordinate Windows OS upgrades, application deployments, patching campaigns and endpoint remediation activities.
* Oversee device lifecycle processes covering procurement, provisioning, deployment, refresh, replacement and decommissioning. Digital Employee Experience – Nexthink \& SysTrack
* Drive adoption of Nexthink, SysTrack or similar Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms to improve visibility into endpoint health and user experience.
* Use DEX analytics to identify performance degradation, application issues, device health problems and recurring user\-impacting issues.
* Establish proactive monitoring and remediation processes to identify issues before they generate service desk incidents.
* Develop DEX dashboards and reporting to measure endpoint performance, user experience and service effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities for automated remediation and self\-healing using Nexthink, SysTrack, Intune, PowerShell or other automation platforms.
* Support the transition from traditional SLA\-based service measurement toward Experience Level Agreements (XLAs) and employee experience metrics.
* Translate technical DEX data into meaningful business insights and improvement initiatives. Service Desk \& End User Support
* Provide governance and oversight of Service Desk, Desktop Support and Field Support operations.
* Drive improvements in First Contact Resolution (FCR), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), customer satisfaction and ticket reduction.
* Analyse incident and request trends to identify opportunities for shift\-left, self\-service, automation and knowledge management.
* Ensure effective escalation management between L1, L2, L3, infrastructure, application and security teams.
* Improve self\-service capabilities through knowledge bases, automation, virtual agents and employee experience platforms.
* Work with technical teams to reduce avoidable incidents and improve overall workplace reliability. Microsoft 365 \& Modern Workplace
* Maintain a good working understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem including Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Exchange Online and Microsoft 365 Apps.
* Coordinate with Microsoft 365 engineering teams to resolve service\-impacting issues and deliver workplace improvements.
* Understand identity and access dependencies involving Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access and device compliance.
* Support adoption and operationalisation of new Microsoft 365 and Modern Workplace capabilities. Service Governance \& Client Management
* Act as the primary service delivery contact for client stakeholders and build strong relationships across business and technology teams.
* Lead monthly service reviews, governance meetings and executive\-level service discussions.
* Prepare service performance dashboards covering SLA/KPI performance, incidents, problems, changes, user experience and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain RAID registers covering key risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies.
* Manage service escalations and ensure appropriate communication and stakeholder engagement.
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, offshore/nearshore teams and third\-party suppliers.
* Ensure contractual obligations, service scope and operational responsibilities are clearly understood and maintained. Continuous Service Improvement \& Automation
* Establish and maintain a structured Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) programme for End User Services.
* Identify opportunities to reduce ticket volumes through automation, proactive remediation and self\-service.
* Drive automated endpoint remediation using Intune, Nexthink, SysTrack, PowerShell and other relevant technologies.
* Identify repetitive operational activities suitable for automation and measure the benefits achieved.
* Use service analytics and DEX telemetry to prioritise improvement initiatives based on business and user impact.
* Track improvements against measurable outcomes including ticket reduction, improved endpoint health, higher FCR, reduced MTTR and improved user satisfaction. Technical Knowledge The candidate should have strong working knowledge across several of the following technologies:
* Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, Nexthink, Lakeside SysTrack, Microsoft SCCM / MECM, Windows 10/11, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Conditional Access and MFA, Active Directory and Group Policy, VDI technologies such as Citrix or Azure Virtual Desktop, PowerShell and endpoint automation, ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, Endpoint security and compliance technologies, ITIL\-based Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* 8–12\+ years of IT experience, with at least 4–6 years in Service Delivery, End User Computing, Digital Workplace or related leadership roles.
* Experience with Intune and modern endpoint management environments is highly desirable.
* Experience with Nexthink, SysTrack or another DEX platform is strongly preferred.
* Experience managing Service Desk, Desktop Support and Endpoint Management services.
* Experience working within a Managed Services or large enterprise IT environment is preferred.
* ITIL Foundation certification is preferred; ITIL Managing Professional or equivalent would be advantageous.


**Skills**
 Microsoft 365, ITIL, Incident Management, Problem Management

7cd7eb20.title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
7cd7eb20.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**

176fb33f.title: Sr Program Manager, Retail Business Services
176fb33f.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Senior Program Manager, Purchase – Retail Business Services  

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead strategy and execution for Shopping Mission Completion, ensuring customers can seamlessly discover, evaluate, and purchase products across the Amazon store.  

  

About Amazon  

Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the widest of selection at low price that drives Amazon’s flywheel.  

  

About the Team  

The vision of Retail Business Services (RBS) Organization at Amazon is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by improving customer experience and enabling our Selling Partners (SPs) to grow their business with Amazon. RBS provides catalog augmentation and correction technologies for the Amazon selling community. Our solutions ensure information in Amazon's catalogs is both complete and comprehensive enough to give our customers a great shopping experience every time.  

  

Role Overview  

RBS is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead a Strategy for Shopping Mission Completion for Customers. Amazon Store Walk analysis uncovers critical defects across the Amazon shopping journey; spanning across product discovery, evaluation, and purchase completion. These systemic problems impact the customer shopping journey, from how customers discover and evaluate products to their ability to complete purchases. These issues are categorized into four key defect themes: Data, Search, Catalog and Customer Experience. To resolve these issues, we recommend a coordinated, cross\-functional engagement with partner teams that will improve overall customer shopping experience . This role will be at the center of collaboration between multiple world wide teams in re\-imagining the purchase experience for customers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Shopping Mission is an essential part of the consumer experience and can fundamentally influence the way customers shop on Amazon as well as shape their perception of Amazon.
  

As a Senior Program Manager \- Purchase, you will
  

* Think Big and own vision for building a Strategy that enables customers to complete their shopping journey.
* Disambiguate the problem space and size the problem and opportunity for RBS
* Be responsible for end\-to\-end business strategy, goal setting, program management, review and collaboration mechanisms.
* Break down ambiguous problems into clear abstract use cases and solution workflows for Tech and Product teams.
* Be responsible for end to end program management with multiple parallel tasks.
* Establish accountability with partner teams and influence them without authority on a common goals.
* Identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
* Be responsible for reporting and review mechanisms and communication to Leadership (Flash updates, WBR, QBR, Deep dives)

  

To be successful in this role, you should be comfortable and confident liaising with remote global teams in business, design and technology at senior leadership levels. You will solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You will be data\-driven and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships).

90ada23e.title: Solution Architect - Technology & Innovation
90ada23e.description:
The TNI Solution Architect is a versatile, highly skilled technology generalist responsible for shaping and delivering enterprise architecture across Convatec’s innovation, infrastructure, and platform portfolio.
 



  





 This role is broad and hands\-on, supporting initiatives such as:
 


* Cloud and on\-premise hosting architecture
* Server migrations, data centre transitions, and re\-platforming
* Custom\-built applications and bespoke software solutions
* Database migrations and optimisation
* Enterprise integration and middleware patterns
* Legacy system modernization
* Evaluation and POCs of emerging technologies
* R\&D, innovation pilots and rapid architectural prototyping



  





 The Solution Architect will work closely with the TNI leadership team, engineering groups, security, infrastructure, business stakeholders, and third\-party partners to ensure scalable, secure, and future\-ready architectural outcomes.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Lead solution architecture for Technology \& Innovation (R\&D) initiatives spanning custom development, infrastructure, hosting environments, cloud platforms, on\-premise systems, database transitions, and enterprise integrations.
* Design and document high\-quality solution design artefacts for a wide range of technology solutions, from infrastructure modernization to custom application builds.
* Architect cloud\-based and hybrid hosting environments (Azure preferred), including servers, networks, load balancing, security controls, and performance optimization.
* Support server moves, application re\-hosting, OS upgrades, lifecycle transitions and re\-platforming activities.
* Evaluate and design on\-premise architecture for solutions that require local hosting, regulatory compliance, or low\-latency demands.
* Lead database migration strategies, including SQL, Oracle, MySQL, NoSQL, and legacy database modernisation.
* Provide architectural guidance on integration patterns such as API\-led connectivity, microservices, ESB, event\-driven architectures, middleware, and GraphQL.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure solutions are delivered according to architectural standards and security\-by\-design principles.
* Identify technology gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities across existing environments.
* Lead or support technology pilots, hackathons, emerging\-technology experiments, and rapid prototyping for the Technology \& Innovation (R\&D) organisation.
* Act as Technical Design Authority (TDA) for assigned Technology \& Innovation (R\&D) projects.
* Ensure alignment with Convatec’s privacy, security, regulatory, and operational frameworks.
* Work with platform providers, hosting partners, and system integrators to understand product roadmaps, patterns, and best practices.
* Contribute to the future\-state architecture vision for Technology \& Innovation (R\&D) and broader enterprise technology domains.



  





**Note: Role based in Hyderabad, India** 




  





**Key Requirements** 



* Min 5 year's experience in related field of Technology \& Innovation; background in similar industry is highly preferred
* Broad solution architecture experience covering infrastructure, platforms, cloud, integration, and custom software development.
* Regulations and standards like HIPPA, etc.,
* Experience with on\-premise hosting, data centre operations, server migration planning, load balancing, failover, backup/DR and hybrid environments.
* Strong background in custom\-built software, including solution design, application architecture, and modern development frameworks.
* Experience with database migrations, optimizations, and cross\-platform transitions (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, etc.).
* Knowledge of enterprise integration including REST APIs, SOAP, GraphQL, messaging queues, ESB, middleware, event streaming.
* Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and application modernization patterns.
* Experience writing HLA/HLD documentation that guides engineering teams through delivery.
* Strong communicator comfortable working with PMs, BAs, engineering leads, infrastructure
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and conducting POCs.



  





**Technical competencies** 



* Strong understanding of architecture modelling standards such as C4, ArchiMate, and system context modelling.
* Knowledge of Windows Server, Linux, containerisation, virtualisation (VMware, Hyper\-V, Azure VM), and networking fundamentals.
* Familiarity with scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python) to support automation and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of IT governance, compliance, security frameworks and operational standards.
* Good understanding of SDLC practices (Agile, DevOps, Waterfall) and the ability to work across them.



  





 At Convatec, we’re pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch. If you’re ready to make a real impact, apply today and help us bring our Forever Caring promise to life.

 A formal recruitment process is required for all our opportunities prior to any offer of employment. This will include an interview confirmed by an official Convatec email address.
 



 If you receive a suspicious approach over social media, text message, email or phone call about recruitment at Convatec, do not disclose any personal information or pay any fees whatsoever. If you’re unsure, please contact us at careers@Convatec.com.

 Convatec provides equal employment opportunities for all current employees and applicants for employment. This policy means that no one will be discriminated against because of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, nationality, citizenship, ancestry, sex, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, genetic predisposing characteristics or any other basis prohibited by law.

 Convatec is not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting. Resumes submitted to any Convatec employee by a third party agency and/or search firm without a valid written and signed search agreement, will become the sole property of Convatec. **UPTO ₹10 LAKH IN BONUSES** 




**Location \- Nashik, Maharashtra** 




**Years of Experience \- 7\-10 years (5\-6\+ in architecture or solutioning)** 




**Salary Range (Annual) \- 14\-20LPA** 




**Manages \- Tech Team** 




  





**About the Role** 




 You own the architecture of the multi\-tenant SaaS platform serving multiple verticals AND
 



 the AI agent layer (orchestration, tool execution, HITL approval architecture) AND the
 



 media\-engine infrastructure. You report to the Operations Manager. You lead a team of 3
 



 junior full\-stack developers and partner with the existing senior engineering talent on the
 



 team.
 



**What You'll Do** 




 • Set the architecture for the multi\-tenant SaaS platform (tenant isolation as a security boundary, not a filter)
 



 • Design the AI agent layer: orchestration, tool calling, context management, evaluation, HITL approval
 



 • Design the media\-engine infrastructure: multi\-agent pipelines, prompt versioning, automation workflows
 



 • Ship code yourself 30\-40% of the time (you set the bar by shipping, not by reviewing)
 



 • Run code review for 100% of the junior dev PRs
 



 • Hire, mentor, and develop the junior full\-stack developers
 



 • Set the engineering bar: AI\-native coding (Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot), shipping cadence, code review standards
 



 • Hold the production reliability bar: CI/CD, deploy reliability, platform uptime
 



**What We're Looking For (Must\-Have)** 




 • 5\-6\+ years of architecture or solutioning experience owning the technical direction of a product
 



 • Demonstrated depth in shipping production\-grade systems
 



 • Has shipped AI agent systems to production and knows where they fail (orchestration, tool calling, context management, evaluation)
 



 • Multi\-tenant SaaS expertise: tenant isolation as a security boundary
 



 • AI\-native coding: uses Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot daily
 



 • Cloud infrastructure at production scale (AWS: containers, managed databases, cost control)
 



 • Has led engineers and made them better
 



 • Ships first, refactors on the way
 



**What We're Looking For (Preferred)** 




 • Compliance\-constrained environments (HIPAA, PCI) and BYOC / on\-prem deployment
 



 • LLM evaluation and observability
 



 • Early\-stage startup experience (first engineering hire or founding engineer)
 



 • Productive in Node.js, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Prisma in week one (or transferable expertise in Python, Go, or Java)
 



**Who Excels in This Role** 




 • Takes ownership — treats the role as their own operation; ships the work end\-to\-end
 



 • Proactive — sees the next move before being asked; ships the fix and reports
 



 • Domain expert — has real, hands\-on depth in the discipline this role covers
 



 • Out\-of\-the\-box thinker — when the obvious move stops working, finds the non\-obvious one quickly
 



 • Performs under stress — triages and ships in real\-time when things break
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 The team ships production code daily with high quality. The architecture scales to the next 10x without a rewrite. Junior developers ramp to owning features independently within 4\-6 months. The Operations Manager trusts your architectural decisions enough to step back from day\-to\-day

In MS we are also ambitious, seeking to more than double our success in the future.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Global Managed Services at EY is entering a phase of accelerated growth, with increasing demand for integrated, multi\-tower managed services across Technology, Finance, Risk, and Data.
   

  

 As a
 **Technology Managed Services Solution Architect** 
 , you will play a central role in shaping and articulating differentiated managed services solutions. Beyond designing the solution, you will be responsible for ensuring the solution is
 **clearly understood, commercially compelling, and operationally credible** 
 to clients.
   

  

 You will work across global pursuit teams, collaborating with Sales, Delivery, Pricing, and domain solution leaders to bring together complex service offerings into a
 **cohesive, client\-ready narrative** 
 .
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Solution strategy and narrative development
+ Translate client requirements, business context, and evaluation criteria into a clear and structured solution storyline
+ Define the solution spine across technology managed services, ensuring alignment with client priorities such as stability, cost, transformation, and risk reduction
+ Develop compelling value propositions that connect service design to measurable business outcomes
+ Convert complex delivery constructs into simple, intuitive messaging for executive stakeholders

* End\-to\-end Tech Managed Services solution design
+ Design integrated Technology Managed Services solutions across applications, cloud, data, platforms, and service operations
+ Define scope, service catalogue, operating model, delivery model, governance, and continuous improvement approach
+ Incorporate automation, AI/GenAI, and platform\-led efficiencies into the solution
+ Ensure solution decisions are grounded in delivery feasibility, available data, and market competitiveness

* Articulation and client engagement
+ Actively participate in the Articulate phase of pursuits, contributing to proposal development, solution documentation, and oral presentations
+ Structure and communicate the solution across five dimensions: Client context, Design intent, Service operating model, Transition and stabilization approach and Value realization
+ Support or lead solution walkthroughs, workshops, and client discussions, ensuring clarity and confidence in the proposed model
+ Partner with Sales and deal leadership to ensure the client narrative and solution design remain aligned

* Transition, stabilization, and delivery model design
+ Design transition and onboarding strategies, including knowledge transfer, phased migration, and stabilization
+ Define early\-stage risk mitigation levers such as SWAT teams, command centre, and backlog reduction
+ Ensure transition plans are practical, sequenced, and aligned to client readiness
+ Support delivery teams in mobilization and early lifecycle stages

* Estimation and commercial input
+ Translate solution design into effort drivers, staffing models, and productivity assumptions
+ Work closely with Pricing teams to ensure commercial models reflect solution realities
+ Validate alignment between service commitments, SLAs, and cost structures
+ Highlight risks, contingencies, and dependencies that impact commercial viability

* Solution assurance and risk management
+ Identify and address risks across scope, delivery, transition, tooling, and governance
+ Ensure solution integrity across proposal content, pricing assumptions, and client messaging
+ Participate in solution reviews, challenge sessions, and leadership governance forums
+ Maintain clarity on assumptions, exclusions, and dependencies to avoid downstream risk


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Ability to translate complex managed services solutions into clear, client\-relevant narratives
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Managed Services lifecycle (pursuit to steady state)
* Experience aligning delivery reality with client\-facing messaging
* Structured thinking with the ability to connect business outcomes, service design, and commercial models
* Confidence to engage and influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Delivery, and domain teams
* Strong collaboration skills to work across global, multi\-disciplinary pursuit teams
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, multi\-owner environments and driving alignment


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 10\+ years of experience in Technology Managed Services, Application Management, or TechOps
* Proven experience in solutioning and/or leading complex managed services pursuits
* Hands\-on experience in one or more areas:
+ Enterprise applications (SAP, ServiceNow, MS Dynamics, Guidewire, etc.)
+ Cloud and platform operations
+ Data and analytics platforms
+ Service management and ITSM environments (e.g., ServiceNow)

* Experience working across multi\-tower or integrated managed services deals
* Strong exposure to transition, service delivery, and operating model design


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience participating in or leading solution articulation, proposals, or orals
* Understanding of integrated business and technology managed services models
* Familiarity with commercial constructs and pricing drivers in managed services
* Exposure to design thinking, structured problem solving, or agile ways of working
* Architecture or service management certifications (e.g., TOGAF, ITIL)


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the you may aspire to become.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
