a9f18af6.title: Senior Digital Solutions Consultant (Solution Architect)
a9f18af6.description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**Purpose :**

Worley is seeking an experienced Solution Architect to define and deliver integrated digital, OT, IT, data, application, infrastructure, integration, and security architectures for major industrial programs. The role will translate business and operational objectives into practical solution designs, architecture artefacts, integration models, and implementation\-ready guidance supporting procurement, vendor assessment, FEED delivery, and project execution. The ideal candidate will bring strong architecture capability, practical IT/OT integration experience, cybersecurity\-by\-design awareness, and the ability to align client, engineering, vendor, and delivery stakeholders around secure, scalable, and operationally maintainable outcomes.


**The Role*****As a Senior Digital Solutions Consultant with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


* Develop solution architectures across technology, application, data, integration, infrastructure, OT, IT, and security domains, ensuring alignment with client reference models and delivery\-phase requirements.
* Translate enterprise architecture, business objectives, and operational requirements into actionable solution designs that guide procurement, vendor assessment, implementation planning, and project execution.
* Produce implementation\-focused architecture artefacts, including system context diagrams, logical and physical architecture views, integration models, infrastructure deployment views, network segmentation concepts, platform deployment views, application interface definitions, and architecture decision records.
* Define integration and interoperability models across industrial levels 1\-4, including OT/IT convergence, edge/cloud hybrid deployments, data exchange patterns, secure connectivity, and segmented network architectures.
* Apply architecture governance to ensure solutions meet client standards, engineering requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable industrial frameworks such as IEC 62443, ISA\-95, OPC UA, MQTT, and other relevant integration patterns.
* Collaborate with internal and client\-side stakeholders, including OT, IT, cybersecurity, telecommunications, control systems, digital, operations, project delivery, vendors, and system integrators, to gather requirements, validate assumptions, and coordinate architecture inputs.
* Support traceability of business, operational, functional, non\-functional, and technical requirements through architecture artefacts and requirements management tools.
* Assess vendor and system integrator solutions for functional alignment, technical feasibility, interoperability, cybersecurity, maintainability, scalability, and lifecycle suitability.
* Contribute to risk assessments, cost\-benefit analysis, project option selection, transition planning, and FEED\-to\-delivery handover.
* Support design reviews, workshops, procurement packages, tender responses, implementation planning, and executive\-level technical briefings.

**Additional Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to multidisciplinary teams while maintaining alignment with project governance, quality, safety, and delivery assurance processes.
* Identify architecture risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and decisions, and support their resolution through structured engagement with stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of emerging industrial digital, OT networking, cybersecurity, cloud, edge, data, and automation technologies and apply them pragmatically where they provide measurable client value.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* Deep experience in solution architecture across technology, application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains.
* Strong understanding of OT and IT networking technologies, including segmented networks, SDN, SD\-WAN, MPLS, hosting services, cloud networks, secure remote access, and IT/OT convergence strategies.
* Knowledge of industrial automation and control systems architectures, including fixed and wireless networks, telemetry, SCADA, PLCs, DCS, historians, edge systems, and the transport of critical production data.
* Experience developing high\-fidelity architecture artefacts that support system procurement, design validation, implementation planning, and stakeholder decision\-making.
* Practical understanding of IT/OT system interoperability in mining, resources, utilities, oil and gas, or other large\-scale industrial programs.
* Knowledge of integration patterns and protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, API gateways, message brokers, industrial data platforms, and secure data exchange across OT and enterprise environments.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity\-by\-design principles, including network segmentation, Zero Trust concepts, defence\-in\-depth, access control, secure interfaces, and industrial cybersecurity standards.
* Ability to align diverse technical stakeholders through structured architecture methods, workshops, design reviews, decision records, and clear visual communication.
* Experience in hybrid cloud\-edge deployments, remote operations concepts, platform orchestration, digital integration, and secure connectivity for operational environments.
* Ability to support cost, risk, schedule, procurement, vendor, and delivery decisions with architecture\-led evidence and traceability.

**Other Qualifications:**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Control Systems, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10\-15 years of relevant experience in solution architecture, systems architecture, digital architecture, OT/IT architecture, or industrial technology architecture within mining, resources, energy, utilities, oil and gas, or large\-scale industrial environments.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business, operational, and engineering requirements into practical, implementable architecture solutions.
* Experience producing architecture artefacts, architecture decisions, technical assessments, solution options, system interface definitions, and implementation\-supporting documentation.
* Experience collaborating with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, OT, IT, telecommunications, control systems, digital, operations, vendor, and project delivery teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architecture concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of project delivery lifecycles from concept and FEED through detailed design, implementation support, commissioning, and handover.
* Architecture certifications such as TOGAF, SABSA, ArchiMate, Azure/AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent practical credentials.
* Network, cybersecurity, or OT credentials such as CCNP, IEC 62443 Foundation/Practitioner, CISSP, GICSP, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with architecture modelling, requirements traceability, and portfolio tools such as Orbus Infinity, ArchiMate\-based tooling, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with industrial digital platforms, data platforms, edge computing, cloud integration, remote operations, autonomous systems, and critical communications environments.
* Experience supporting procurement, vendor assessment, RFP/RFQ development, technical bid evaluation, and implementation transition planning.
* Structured, pragmatic, and outcome\-focused, with the ability to navigate technical ambiguity and convert complex requirements into clear architecture direction.
* Able to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail in complex, multidisciplinary delivery environments.
* Strong relationship\-building skills with clients, vendors, peers, senior management, executives, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Able to protect sensitive, proprietary, security\-related, and commercially confidential information.
* Proactive, service\-minded, collaborative, and willing to challenge assumptions constructively to improve client and project outcomes.
* Committed to quality, safety, operational reliability, sustainability, and Worley values.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

17f01026.title: Solution Architect
17f01026.description:
**Entity**
 Technology
   

  

**Job Family Group**
 IT\&S Group
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a hands\-on System Architect (10–12\+ years) who can design, build, and deliver scalable enterprise solutions. This role goes beyond governance, requiring deep involvement in implementation, integration, and problem\-solving across SaaS, non\-SaaS, AI, and web service ecosystems, working closely with engineering teams to deliver secure, high\-performance solutions.
   

  

 As the lead Architect for a number of areas including People \& Culture, this role will define and drive the technology architecture strategy for the HR domain, ensuring alignment with business priorities, enterprise architecture standards, and future workforce transformation needs. The individual will bring deep expertise in HR applications, HR processes, and employee lifecycle technologies, combining strategic architectural leadership with hands\-on technical delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Architecture Strategy \& Leadership
* Act as the lead Architect for the People \& Culture technology landscape, defining the long\-term architecture vision, standards, patterns, and integration strategy.
* Own the architecture roadmap across HR platforms and technologies, including Workday, talent acquisition, learning, skills, performance, workforce planning, employee experience, and related enterprise systems.
* Develop and maintain architecture principles, reference architectures, integration patterns, and technology standards for the HR domain.
* Partner with business, product, security, data, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure solutions align with strategic outcomes and enterprise capabilities.
* Guide technology investment decisions and evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled HR capabilities.
* Hands\-On Architecture \& Development
* Design and implement end\-to\-end solutions (not just diagrams)
* Contribute to code, POCs, APIs, integrations, and services
* Build reusable frameworks and integration patterns
* Solve complex production issues with root\-cause fixes
* Provide architectural leadership throughout the delivery lifecycle, ensuring designs are translated into robust, scalable implementations.
* Integration Engineering (Core Focus)
* Build integrations across SaaS (Workday, Salesforce), legacy systems, and AI/data platforms
* Develop REST/SOAP APIs, microservices, and event\-driven systems (Kafka, queues)
* Work with MuleSoft/Boomi or build custom integration layers
* Define and govern the enterprise integration strategy for the P\&C ecosystem, ensuring consistent, secure, and scalable connectivity across HR platforms, corporate systems, and external providers.
* Establish reusable API, event, and integration patterns that accelerate delivery and reduce technical debt.
* Cloud\-Native Development
* Architect solutions on AWS/Azure/GCP
* Build serverless, containerized, and microservices\-based systems
* Manage CI/CD, IaC, deployment automation, and optimize performance, scalability, and cost
* AI \& Modern Tech Enablement
* Integrate AI/ML (NLP, GenAI, recommendation systems) into applications
* Build real\-time and batch data pipelines
* Apply responsible AI practices (privacy, security, bias mitigation)
* Exposure to MLOps (model lifecycle, monitoring, versioning)
* Identify practical AI use cases and expose via APIs
* Lead the architectural adoption of AI capabilities across the People \& Culture technology portfolio, ensuring solutions comply with responsible AI, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Engineering Excellence
* Enforce coding standards and perform code reviews
* Ensure observability (logging, monitoring, tracing)
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineering and solution architecture teams, promoting engineering best practices and architectural consistency.
* Collaboration \& Delivery
* Translate business needs into working solutions
* Partner with Dev, QA, DevOps teams
* Act as SME during critical releases
* Work closely with HR stakeholders and product teams to translate People \& Culture business requirements into scalable technology solutions.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10–12\+ years in software engineering with strong hands\-on coding
* Experience integrating SaaS/non\-SaaS systems, APIs, microservices
* Proficiency in Java / Python / Node.js
* Experience with MuleSoft/Boomi, Kafka/RabbitMQ, AWS/Azure/GCP
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP, OAuth2/JWT, JSON/XML, system design
* Extensive experience architecting and delivering enterprise HR technology solutions, including platforms such as Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Cornerstone, Eightfold, HiredScore, or equivalent HR ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of HR business processes and data domains, including hire\-to\-retire, talent acquisition, onboarding, learning, performance, compensation, skills, succession, workforce planning, and employee experience.
* Demonstrated experience acting as a lead or chief architect, defining architecture strategy, integration standards, and technology roadmaps for a business domain.


 Preferred Certifications: TOGAF, Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), MuleSoft/Boomi. TOGAF certification or equivalent architecture qualification strongly preferred.
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

  

* Strong coder who enjoys solving real problems
* Comfortable debugging and building POCs
* Balances architecture with execution
* Challenges poor design decisions with solid reasoning
* Deep HR technology expertise combined with the ability to shape strategic direction and personally drive implementation.
* A leader who can establish architecture vision, influence senior stakeholders, and remain hands\-on when solving complex technical challenges.
* A trusted advisor for P\&C technology strategy, integration architecture, and future\-state platform evolution.


**About Bp**
 Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 Even though the job is advertised as full time, please contact the hiring manager or the recruiter as flexible working arrangements may be considered.
   

  

**What you can expect from us!**
**Our Commitment To Diversity, Equity And Inclusion**
 At bp, you could be part of Business Resource Groups (BRGs) which belief in the power of inclusion, deeper connections, and shared experiences. They provide a place for employees to learn and share knowledge, to connect, and to improve. The BRGs focus on and encourage talent engagement, development, and retention while creating a broadened sense of community and inclusion for bp employees. The groups cultivate leadership growth by involving employees in developmental opportunities they would not otherwise have access to. Formal and informal mentoring also helps employees develop their professional goals and connect with colleagues. The BRGs’ dedication to growth at all levels helps employees feel more engaged and energized. The BRGs break down barriers, so we can all do better together. We do not discriminate on the basis of protected characteristics like race, religion, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to bp’s recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.). **Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. You will work closely with clients, project managers, and other team members to understand business needs and develop solutions that meet client requirements.

We are seeking a high\-energy, technically adept **Presales Consultant** with 3–5 years of experience in the SaaS or IT Services domain. In this role, you will act as the crucial bridge between our technical capabilities and client requirements, driving technical discovery, solution design, high\-converting demo presentations, and strategic pitch sessions for enterprise prospects.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of software architectures and cloud solutions, paired with exceptional storyboarding and presentation skills.

**Strategic Collaboration**

n **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.

l Proficiency in creating clean, visual, and narrative\-driven pitch decks (PowerPoint, Google Slides).

34a4d457.title: Azure Cloud Infrastructure

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Azure Infrastructure \& DevOps Engineer** to design, deploy, automate, and maintain enterprise\-scale Azure cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Azure platform services, Kubernetes (AKS), CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), monitoring, security, and disaster recovery. The role requires close collaboration with development, operations, and project teams to ensure the reliability, scalability, security, and performance of cloud infrastructure.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Azure Infrastructure Management**

* Design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure components including:
	+ Virtual Machines (VMs)
	+ Virtual Networks (VNet)
	+ Azure Active Directory (Azure AD)
	+ Storage Accounts
	+ Azure Blob Storage
* Ensure high availability, scalability, and security of Azure environments.

### **DevOps \& Automation**

* Deploy infrastructure and application components using CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning and management using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.
* Support release management and DevOps best practices.

### **Azure Services Administration**

* Implement, configure, and manage:
	+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
	+ Azure Application Gateway
	+ Azure PostgreSQL Database
	+ Azure Event Hub
	+ Azure Key Vault
	+ Azure Container Registry (ACR)
	+ Azure Container Instances (ACI)
	+ Azure Storage Services

### **Monitoring \& Reliability**

* Monitor Azure resources for performance, availability, and cost optimization.
* Proactively identify and resolve infrastructure issues.
* Implement performance tuning and capacity planning strategies.
* Ensure platform reliability with minimal infrastructure downtime.

### **Security \& Disaster Recovery**

* Implement backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Manage security controls, access management, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure business continuity through robust cloud governance practices.

### **Technical Support \& Collaboration**

* Provide infrastructure support to development and project teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve cloud\-related incidents and service disruptions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable cloud solutions.

### **Documentation**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and best practices.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

### **Must Have**

* Microsoft Azure Cloud Infrastructure
* Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
* Azure DevOps \& CI/CD Pipelines
* Azure Application Gateway
* Azure PostgreSQL Database
* Azure Event Hub
* Azure Key Vault
* Azure Blob Storage
* Azure Container Registry (ACR)
* Infrastructure Monitoring \& Performance Optimization
* PowerShell / Azure CLI Scripting
* Backup \& Disaster Recovery Solutions
* Infrastructure Troubleshooting \& Operations Support

### **Good to Have**

* Terraform / Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Docker \& Containerization
* GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
* Azure Cost Optimization
* Cloud Security \& Governance

**Certifications (Preferred)**
------------------------------

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals ( **AZ\-900** )
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate ( **AZ\-104** )
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert ( **AZ\-400** )

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
-------------------------------

* Strong experience in Azure Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps practices.
* Hands\-on expertise with AKS and containerized deployments.
* Experience in automation, monitoring, and cloud operations.

93156639.description:
LNT/HACSA/1842117
* IU72\-Larsen \& Toubro – Vyoma
* AMN Tower, Powai
* Posted On 25 Aug 2026
* End Date 21 Feb 2027

**Skills**
----------


#### **Knowledge \& Posting Location**


Artificial Intelligence Cloud Storage

Bachelor of Technology (BTech)
  
**Job Description**
-------------------


Job Purpose


Lead the overall Solutions and Presales function across Cloud, AI and Managed Services, providing strategic and technical leadership for enterprise and government customer engagements.


The role will own the end\-to\-end solutioning lifecycle from customer requirement discovery and solution strategy through architecture, proposal, commercials, technical validation and transition to delivery. The position will establish a unified solutioning framework across Cloud Infrastructure, AI/GPU Platforms and Managed Services, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable and aligned with the business strategy


Roles \& Responsibilities


**1\. Solutions Strategy \& Leadership**


* Own and lead the overall solutioning strategy across **Cloud, AI/GPU and Managed Services**.
* Establish common solution architecture, design and governance standards across the three solution domains.
* Develop differentiated and repeatable solution frameworks, reference architectures, service models and solution blueprints.
* Align solution capabilities with business strategy, market opportunities, customer requirements and revenue objectives.
* Drive continuous innovation across cloud\-native, AI, automation, observability, security and managed services.

**2\. Enterprise Solution Architecture**


* Provide executive\-level architectural leadership for complex, large\-scale enterprise and government opportunities.
* Lead development of end\-to\-end solutions spanning **compute, storage, networking, cloud, AI/GPU infrastructure, security, backup/DR, observability and managed services****.**
* Ensure integration of public, private, hybrid and sovereign cloud environments.
* Define architecture principles covering scalability, performance, security, compliance, availability and cost optimization.
* Review and approve solution architectures, BoQs, technical designs and major proposals.

**3\. AI \& GPU Solution Leadership**


* Lead AI Cloud and AI Factory solutioning covering GPU infrastructure, HPC, high\-performance networking and AI platforms.
* Provide oversight on GPU sizing, workload architecture, distributed training/inference, Kubernetes, Slurm, InfiniBand/RoCE and high\-performance storage.
* Guide architecture for GenAI, RAG, agentic AI and enterprise AI workloads.
* Drive adoption of emerging NVIDIA and other accelerator technologies and establish reusable AI reference architectures.
* Ensure AI solutions address performance, utilization, scalability, data sovereignty and commercial viability.
   

The underlying AI Architect JD specifically covers NVIDIA GPU clusters, InfiniBand/RoCE, GPU/CPU/memory/NVMe sizing, Kubernetes/Kubeflow, Slurm, vLLM/Triton/TensorRT\-LLM and RAG/agentic AI.

**4\. Managed Services Solution Leadership**


* Own the solutioning strategy for managed infrastructure, cloud operations, security, network, backup/DR, SOC/NOC, observability, automation and ITSM services.
* Define service catalog, SLA/KPI frameworks, operating models and transition approaches.
* Ensure managed services solutions are aligned with customer business outcomes, operational feasibility and commercial objectives.
* Establish strong solution\-to\-delivery governance and ensure effective transition of won engagements.
   

The existing Managed Services JD emphasizes requirement discovery, service design, RFP/RFI responses, SLA/KPI mapping, pricing, customer value and pre\-sales\-to\-delivery transition.

**5\. Customer \& CXO Engagement**


* Act as the senior technology and solutioning interface for strategic customers and CXO stakeholders.
* Lead discovery workshops, solution presentations, technical negotiations, PoCs and executive\-level discussions.
* Translate complex technology capabilities into clear business value, ROI, risk and transformation outcomes.
* Build trusted\-advisor relationships with enterprise and government customers.

**6\. Pre\-Sales \& Business Enablement**


* Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to identify, qualify and shape strategic opportunities.
* Lead solution strategy for large RFP/RFI, tenders and strategic bids.
* Ensure high\-quality technical proposals, BoQs, SOWs, solution narratives and presentations.
* Drive solution competitiveness through differentiated architecture, service models and commercial constructs.
* Support deal strategy, technical negotiations and closure of strategic opportunities.

**7\. Commercial \& Business Case Ownership**


* Provide leadership on solution costing, pricing assumptions, capacity models and business cases.
* Ensure solutions balance technical excellence with commercial viability and target margins.
* Review major BoQs, partner/OEM proposals and commercial assumptions.
* Identify opportunities for standardization, reuse and optimization to improve solution profitability.

**8\. Technology Partners \& OEM Ecosystem**


* Build and manage strategic relationships with cloud, AI, infrastructure, security and managed services technology partners.
* Work with OEMs to develop joint reference architectures, solution offerings and GTM propositions.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and determine their relevance to the solution portfolio.
* Drive partner enablement and technical competency development across the solutions team.

**9\. Solution Governance \& Quality**


* Establish architecture and solution review mechanisms for strategic and complex opportunities.
* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, data sovereignty and regulatory requirements.
* Drive standardization of solution documentation, architecture reviews, costing models and handover processes.
* Ensure alignment between proposed solutions, available platform capabilities and delivery readiness.

**10\. Team Leadership \& Capability Building**


* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary solutions organization covering Cloud, AI/GPU and Managed Services.
* Define competency frameworks, role structures, KPIs and career paths for solution architects and specialists.
* Build a culture of technical excellence, customer centricity, collaboration and ownership.
* Mentor senior architects and develop future solution leaders.
* Create cross\-functional collaboration between Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Security and Delivery teams.

**Educational Qualifications**


BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication


**Relevant Experience**


* Experience: 15\-20 years of overall IT experience, with a minimum of 3 years in GPU cloud architecture and design roles.
* Cloud Infrastructure Expertise: Proven track record in the design, operations, and maintenance of public/private cloud platforms, including service migration from on\-premises to cloud or between enterprise data centers.
* Result\-Oriented with Security Focus: Strong background in IT networking and cloud security, with the ability to address complex business needs in global, enterprise\-scale environments.
* Deep knowledge of Azure, AWS, and GCP services, including native security controls, security centers, DDoS protection, firewalls, express route/direct connect, storage solutions, CDN, and site recovery.
* Proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms and tools such as, AWS EC2, AWS GuardDuty, AWS KMS, CloudWatch, AWS Lambda, and other modern cloud\-native services.
* Private Cloud Technologies: Experience in OpenStack, VMware, Nutanix, and Kubernetes\-based private cloud platforms, along with SaaS integration.
* Multi\-Cloud \& Hybrid Cloud: Skilled in design, deployment, and maintenance of hybrid/multi\-cloud architectures with seamless connectivity and governance.
* Cloud Migration \& Consulting: Strong expertise in cloud migration strategy, execution, and advisory consulting for enterprise clients.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and presentation skills with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.
* Compliance \& Identity Management: Experience in cloud networking, IAM (Identity \& Access Management), governance, and compliance frameworks (ISO, PCI\-DSS, DPDP, etc.)

* Drive partner enablement and technical competency development across the solutions team.

* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, data sovereignty and regulatory requirements.
* Drive standardization of solution documentation, architecture reviews, costing models and handover processes.
* Ensure alignment between proposed solutions, available platform capabilities and delivery readiness.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary solutions organization covering Cloud, AI/GPU and Managed Services.
* Define competency frameworks, role structures, KPIs and career paths for solution architects and specialists.
* Build a culture of technical excellence, customer centricity, collaboration and ownership.
* Mentor senior architects and develop future solution leaders.
* Create cross\-functional collaboration between Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Security and Delivery teams.

 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication

25d9f178.title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
25d9f178.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Migration Strategy: Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

d1493643.title: Program Manager 4
d1493643.description:
**Job Description**
 Principal Program Manager, OCI Transitions and Migrations
   

  

 Are you a creative problem\-solver who thrives on complex challenges? Do you enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving large\-scale programs to successful outcomes? If so, you may be the perfect fit for our team as a Principal Program Manager.
   

  

 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is transforming how organizations run their most important applications and workloads. The OCI Transitions and Migrations team helps customers plan and execute complex transitions to Oracle Cloud, coordinating activities across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and other Oracle organizations.
   

  

 As a Principal Program Manager for OCI Transitions and Migrations, you will lead high\-impact migration and transition programs, establish clear execution plans, manage cross\-functional dependencies, and ensure successful delivery. You will act as a central point of accountability, communicate program status to senior leadership, and drive resolution of issues that span teams and organizations.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

**8\+ Years of Related Experience:**
 Eight or more years of experience in program management, project management, cloud migrations, enterprise technology delivery, consulting, operations, or a related field.
   

  

**Program Leadership and Execution:**
 Demonstrated experience leading large, complex programs across multiple teams, workstreams, and organizational boundaries. Proven ability to develop integrated plans, roadmaps, milestones, governance models, and success measures.
   

  

**Cloud and Migration Experience:**
 Experience supporting cloud transitions, enterprise migrations, infrastructure programs, application migrations, data migrations, or technology transformation initiatives. Experience with OCI, AWS, Azure, or other enterprise cloud platforms is preferred.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Leadership:**
 Ability to build strong relationships, align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and drive shared outcomes across engineering, operations, product, support, sales, customer, and leadership teams.
   

  

**Risk, Dependency, and Change Management:**
 Experience identifying risks, managing complex dependencies, developing mitigation and recovery plans, and maintaining progress through changing priorities or ambiguous conditions.
   

  

**Communication and Influence:**
 Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex information clearly, influence without direct authority, and represent programs effectively with senior leaders.
   

  

**Strategic and Analytical Thinking:**
 Ability to connect program execution to broader customer and business objectives, work with large amounts of qualitative and quantitative information, assess program health, and make sound recommendations.
   

  

**Educational Background:**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Lead Program Delivery:**
 Lead complex OCI transition and migration programs from planning through execution, stabilization, and completion, ensuring delivery aligns with scope, schedule, customer commitments, and business objectives.
   

  

**Manage Roadmaps, Dependencies, and Resources:**
 Develop and maintain integrated program roadmaps, milestones, ownership models, dependencies, resource requirements, and success criteria across cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**Drive Stakeholder Alignment and Execution:**
 Establish alignment and accountability across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and partner organizations. Remove barriers and drive timely decisions and actions.
   

  

**Manage Risks and Resolve Issues:**
 Identify risks, issues, and dependencies early; develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans; and independently drive resolution of cross\-team and division\-level challenges.
   

  

**Establish Program Governance:**
 Create and maintain effective governance, including decision\-making processes, escalation paths, status reporting, operating cadences, metrics, and executive review mechanisms.
   

  

**Communicate Program Status and Recommendations:**
 Provide clear written and verbal updates on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and customer impact. Present complex issues with relevant data, tradeoffs, options, and recommendations.
   

  

**Represent the Program With Senior Leadership:**
 Represent the program and organization independently in discussions through the VP level and support higher\-level executive engagements as appropriate.
   

  

**Maintain Customer and Operational Excellence:**
 Ensure a consistent Oracle customer experience throughout the transition and migration lifecycle while maintaining high standards for quality, readiness, and execution.
   

  

**Improve Program Practices:**
 Identify and implement improvements to planning, governance, reporting, risk management, communications, and execution. Develop reusable templates, dashboards, metrics, and best practices that improve consistency and predictability.
   

  

**Build Relationships and Mentor Others:**
 Build trusted partnerships across teams, organizations, cultures, and geographies, while providing guidance and mentorship to other program managers.
   

  

 Join Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and help customers successfully transition their most important workloads to the cloud. Your leadership, judgment, and ability to drive complex programs will play a critical role in delivering successful migration outcomes and improving how OCI executes transitions at scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Identifies, prioritizes, and successfully executes a broad portfolio of functional initiatives and programs. Plans and directs schedules for multiple programs running simultaneously. Partners closely with global cross\-functional teams to understand and capture requirements for programs. Navigates complex dependencies between cross\-functional teams and organizational priorities to optimize the critical path and addresses \& mitigates risks. Effectively influences internal and external teams to prioritize; Drives mitigation plans and ensures ownership for each item and regular follow up through to program closure while ensuring resolution of risk and issues, escalating, as necessary. Provides rigorous management and analysis of overall portfolio budget (including spend and forecasted spend vs. budget, spend per program and historical trends, etc.). Establishes scalable frameworks (process, tools, etc.) for the end\-to\-end project and manages stakeholders applying project management standards and documentation best practices. Runs standups and sprint planning exercises for programs owned. Builds and maintains consistent reporting across numerous programs. Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel. Performs other duties as assigned.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC4
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

a3fc2e3c.description:
Solution Architect / Solution Planner – Accenture SONG
   

  

 Management Level
   

  

 Open across multiple levels.
   

  

 To be determined based on candidate experience, capability, and overall fit
   

  

 Location
   

  

 Any Accenture Location
   

  

 Priority Skills
   

  

 Solution Architecture \| Solution Planning \| Presales \| Client Advisory \| Commercial Solutioning \| Adobe \| Salesforce \| Martech \| Commerce Platforms \| CRM Transformation \| Customer Experience
   

  

 Must Have Skills
   

  

 Solution Architecture, Solution Planning, Presales \& Pursuit Support, Client Advisory, Commercial Solutioning, RFP/RFI/RFQ Management, Estimation \& Pricing Support, Stakeholder Management, Digital Transformation, Business Consulting
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Service Cloud, SAP Hybris/SAP Commerce, Shopify Plus, Martech Platforms, Customer Data Platforms, Customer Experience Platforms, CRM Transformation, Omnichannel Commerce Solutions
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Accenture SONG is seeking Solution Architects and Solution Planners who can operate at the intersection of business consulting, technology strategy, solution architecture, client advisory, and commercial solutioning. The role requires professionals who can shape, position, influence, and govern complex transformation opportunities by bringing together business objectives, technology solutions, commercial considerations, and delivery capabilities. The successful candidate will work closely with clients, sales teams, delivery organizations, pricing teams, business stakeholders, and technology leaders to develop compelling, scalable, and commercially viable solutions.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

 Solution Strategy \& Architecture: Design end\-to\-end solutions, define roadmaps, and ensure alignment of business and technology goals. Business Consulting \& Advisory: Engage stakeholders, understand business challenges, and advise on transformation strategy. Presales \& Pursuit Support: Lead or support RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, proposals, workshops, and solution defense activities. Commercial Solutioning: Support estimation, pricing, staffing strategies, and business case development. Stakeholder Management: Collaborate across sales, delivery, technology, and client teams. Solution Governance: Identify risks, dependencies, assumptions, and ensure solution viability.
   

  

 Professional \& Technical Skills
   

  

 Enterprise Solution Architecture, Digital Transformation Architecture, Customer Experience Architecture, Commerce Architecture, CRM Transformation, Omnichannel Experience Design, Presales Leadership, Proposal Development, Solution Positioning, Effort Estimation, Commercial Modeling, Pricing Support, Client Workshops, Solution Defense, Adobe Ecosystem, Salesforce Ecosystem, Martech Platforms, Customer Data Platforms, Customer Journey Platforms.
   

  

 Hiring Considerations
   

  

 Profiles primarily focused on infrastructure management, cloud migration delivery, application support, testing management, program governance, engineering management, or operational support without meaningful solution planning and presales exposure may not align with the core intent of this role.
   

  

 About Our Company \| Accenture
   

  

 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud, and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, Accenture provides services in Strategy \& Consulting, Technology, Operations, and Accenture Song.

7e394302.title: AI Architect
7e394302.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------



Responsible for designing the end\-to\-end architecture, frameworks that enable scalable, and high\-performance AI systems both within the organization and for product teams. This role bridges machine learning, software engineering, and cloud infrastructure to create a cohesive enterprise AI ecosystem. The AI Architect defines reference architectures, accelerates solution teams, ensures compliance, and sets the technical direction for how AI is built, deployed, and governed.


Work Location: Bangalore  

Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------


* Design the AI architecture for the enterprise including inference layers, vector stores, data ingestion, orchestration, and monitoring.
* Architect scalable LLM/RAG systems, agent frameworks, and generative AI services that can be reused across domains and business units.
* Define standards for embeddings, vectorization, prompt orchestration, caching layers, and evaluation pipelines.
* Establish patterns for developing, fine\-tuning, and deploying ML/LLM models
* Evaluate when to use foundation models, when to fine\-tune, and when to build custom models.
* Define and enforce AI architecture principles, security policies, and compliance (HIPAA, FDA, ISO).
* Implement guardrails for privacy, PHI/PII protection, safe model usage, hallucination risk mitigation, audit logging, and explainability
**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------


* Partner with data engineering, IT security, cloud infrastructure, and product teams to ensure architectural alignment.
* Participate in roadmap planning and technology selection for the AI/ML ecosystem.
* Conduct build\-vs\-buy assessments for AI platforms, tokenization, data protection, vector databases, model hosting, and MLOps tools.
**Your Background**
-------------------


**Required Technical Skills :**

**Total Expereince \- 10\+ years**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 5\+ years of experience in ML/AI engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or cloud architecture.
* Strong proficiency in distributed systems, cloud architecture (Azure)\-any, and containerization (Kubernetes).
* Hands\-on experience designing and deploying ML/LLM systems in production.
* Expertise with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), MLOps tools (MLflow, KServe, Kubeflow, Airflow), and vector databases.
* Deep understanding of LLM/RAG patterns, embeddings, prompt engineering, caching layer

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, OpenAI Agents API).
* Experience in highly regulated industries (healthcare, MedTech, pharma).
* Experience with encryption, tokenization, PHI/PII protection, or secure ML workflows
**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------


**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------

  

EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

0b36df16.title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
0b36df16.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

c481c202.title: Technical Program Manager
c481c202.description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future\-proof their businesses. Through real\-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One — our cloud\-first, AI\-powered platform — CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve.
   

  

 We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager in Cloud Operations, you will drive operational reliability across our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem. You will lead critical incident post\-mortems, govern security frameworks, and partner with application development and platform engineering teams to ensure all new services meet strict production entry criteria for reliability and observability.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

**Production Readiness \& Operations Governance**
* Define, govern, and enforce production entry criteria for all new services and features.
* Partner with application development and platform engineering to audit deployment readiness.
* Validate that incoming services meet corporate standards for observability, monitoring, and alerting.
* Scale reliable operational practices across engineering teams to reduce launch\-day risks.


**Critical Incident \& Post\-Mortem Management**
* Own the end\-to\-end post\-mortem lifecycle for critical GCP production outages and high\-severity incidents.
* Lead "Five Whys" and blameless Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions to identify system vulnerabilities.
* Track actionable remediation items, ensuring timely execution to prevent recurrence.
* Report SLA/SLO compliance metrics and incident trends to engineering leadership.


**Release Management \& Compliance Coordination**
* Bridge the gap between engineering, QA, and cloud operations to ensure streamlined CI/CD pipelines.
* Align release schedules with maintenance windows to minimize customer impact and system downtime.
* Partner with InfoSec to enforce Google Cloud security, data governance, and regulatory compliance.
* Maintain documentation and evidence collection for ongoing infrastructure compliance audits.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience: 5\+ years of Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, or Cloud Operations experience.
* GCP Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud services, security controls, and infrastructure.
* Production Readiness: Proven experience defining and enforcing production entry, reliability, and observability criteria.
* Incident Management: Strong track record running blameless post\-mortems and driving infrastructure solutions from RCAs.
* Release \& DevSecOps: Deep understanding of modern CI/CD tools, release management, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Communication: Ability to align cross\-functional engineering teams around shared operational and reliability goals.


**Location:**
* India – (Flexible hybrid work model \- work from Bangalore office for 20 days in a quarter)

57d2bf4e.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Solution Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Translate client requirements into differentiated, deliverable solutions using in\-depth knowledge of a technology, function, or platform. Collaborate with the Sales Pursuit and Delivery Teams to develop a winnable and deliverable solution that underpins the client value proposition and business case.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Network Architecture and Design
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 SD\-WAN Implementation
   

  

**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, a typical day involves interpreting and transforming client needs into unique and actionable solutions that align with business objectives. This role requires close collaboration with sales and delivery teams to craft strategies that not only meet client expectations but also provide a strong foundation for successful project execution. The position demands continuous engagement with various stakeholders to ensure that the proposed solutions are practical, innovative, and add significant value to the client s business case, fostering long\-term partnerships and successful outcomes.
   

  

 We are seeking a seasoned and highly experienced Senior Solution Architect to join our Technology Practice. This is a strategic, client\-facing solutioning role where the primary focus is converting sales\-qualified opportunities into well\-defined, technically sound, and commercially viable solutions. Opportunities are brought in by the Sales Team — your remit begins with validating the requirement and ends with a complete solution ready for delivery.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work in close partnership with the Sales Team to understand client needs, validate scope, and develop compelling solution proposals. This role demands exceptional communication skills, deep technical expertise across networking, cloud, and Microsoft technologies, and the ability to define resource requirements and delivery timelines with precision.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Requirement Validation \& Sales Collaboration


 Receive sales\-qualified opportunities from the Sales Team and conduct thorough validation of client requirements, scope, and technical feasibility.
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales Team to clarify ambiguities, fill gaps in the brief, and ensure a clear understanding of the client's business and technical needs before solutioning begins.
   

  

 Act as the key liaison between the Sales Team and the technical practice — ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, and commercial expectations throughout the engagement.
   

  

* Client Engagement \& Advisory


 Lead client\-facing conversations to probe, validate, and refine requirements in collaboration with the Sales Team.
   

  

 Build credibility with client stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, articulating solution value clearly at both technical and business levels.
   

  

 Present solution proposals, architecture blueprints, and delivery roadmaps with confidence to client and internal stakeholders.
   

  

* Solutioning \& Architecture


 Design end\-to\-end technical solutions across SD\-WAN, networking, Microsoft Product Suite, and Cloud Implementation Services based on validated requirements.
   

  

 Define resource requirements and effort estimates — specifying the number of resources and number of days required for delivery.
   

  

 Develop high\-level and detailed architecture documentation, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and technical proposals.
   

  

 Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with client business objectives and industry best practices.
   

  

* Internal Coordination \& Stakeholder Management


 Coordinate internally with delivery leads, engineers, project managers, vendors, and practice leads to validate and refine solutions prior to submission.
   

  

 Serve as the bridge between the Sales Team and delivery, ensuring a seamless handover with complete solution documentation and knowledge transfer post\-award.
   

  

 Engage with vendor and partner ecosystems (e.g., Microsoft, Cisco, AWS/Azure) to leverage technical and commercial support during the solutioning process.
   

  

 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

 Required Technical Expertise \-
   

  

* SD\-WAN \& Networking


 Hands\-on experience designing and architecting SD\-WAN solutions (e.g., Cisco Meraki, Fortinet, VMware VeloCloud, or equivalent).
   

  

 Strong grounding in enterprise networking — routing, switching, firewalls, MPLS, BGP, and network segmentation.
   

  

 Experience with network transformation projects, including migration from legacy WAN to SD\-WAN environments.
   

  

* Microsoft Product Suite


 Deep expertise across Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, Intune, Teams, SharePoint, and related productivity and security toolsets.
   

  

 Familiarity with Microsoft licensing models and their commercial implications in solution design.
   

  

 Experience with Microsoft security frameworks including Defender, Sentinel, and Zero Trust architecture principles.
   

  

* Cloud Implementation Services


 Proven experience architecting cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure and/or AWS — including IaaS, PaaS, hybrid cloud, and cloud migration projects.
   

  

 Understanding of cloud governance, cost optimisation, and security best practices in enterprise environments.
   

  

 Ability to size and scope cloud engagements, including resource and effort estimation for delivery.
   

  

 Additional Information:
   

  

* Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering complex, multi\-technology solutions in client\-facing solutioning roles.
* Experience working alongside Sales Teams — translating sales\-qualified opportunities into complete, delivery\-ready solution proposals.
* Strong commercial acumen — experience building resource plans, effort estimates, and solution costings.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills ability to present confidently to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Relevant certifications highly regarded: CCNP/CCIE, Microsoft Azure/M365 certifications, AWS Solutions Architect, TOGAF or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).


 You Excel At
   

  

 Leading complex client conversations with confidence
   

  

 Translating business problems into technical solutions
   

  

 Navigating ambiguity and driving clarity
   

  

 Collaborating across technical and commercial teams
   

  

 You Are Known For
   

  

 Executive presence and polished communication
   

  

 Attention to detail in solution documentation
   

  

 Ownership mentality — end to end
   

  

 A collaborative, low\-ego approach
