de212564.title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
de212564.description:
Overview:
**Working at Atlassian**


Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

 **Why should you apply to this role?**  

The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.  

You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.  

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.


Responsibilities:
* **Migration Strategy:** Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
* **Risk Management**: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* **Technical Architecture:** Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* **Trusted Advisor:** Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* **Delivery Excellence:** Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* **Drive Accountability**: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* **Escalation Management:** Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* **Team Leadership**: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.

**Industry Insight:** Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.


Qualifications:

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.


This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.

**Benefits \& Perks**  

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits****.**

 **About Atlassian**  

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.  

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

06d05ecb.description:
Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000\+ employees and 24,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

  

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

  

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future  

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation

  

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

 ***Recruitment Scam Notice:*** *Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “**name@cvent.com**” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

 *If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at* *recruitingindia@cvent.com**.*

 *For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud**.*

 **About the role:**


Cvent’s Platform Services team is looking for a Senior Cloud Systems/Platform Engineer based in India. You’ll work shifted hours to provide morning overlap with the US team, covering day\-to\-day Linux operations, driving automation initiatives, and taking technical lead ownership on infrastructure and application projects. This is a hands\-on role — we want someone who identifies toil and builds solutions, not just executes tickets.


In This Role, You Will::
* Provide Follow\-the\-Sun Linux operations coverage; monitor, respond to incidents, and perform root cause analysis.
* Administer Rocky Linux / RHEL / CentOS systems across on\-prem datacenters (SF, CO, Amsterdam) and cloud environments.
* Design and maintain Ansible playbooks, roles, and inventories for configuration management, patching, and deployments.
* Manage OS lifecycle and patching using tools such as Foreman, Satellite, or equivalent.
* Build and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines (declarative/Jenkinsfile); integrate automation tooling into release workflows.
* Manage Git repositories and IaC version control; enforce code review and change management practices.
* Administer and troubleshoot Java application servers (WebLogic, Tomcat) and web servers (NGINX, Apache).
* Support workloads in GCP, AWS, and/or Azure; contribute to cloud migration projects.
* Work with Kubernetes/GKE for containerized workload operations and deployments.
* Lead and contribute to migration of legacy monitoring platforms to Datadog, including APM, centralized logging, security monitoring, dashboards, and alerting.
* Evaluate and integrate AI\-assisted tooling into automation and operational workflows (e.g., AI powered observability, LLM\-assisted scripting, intelligent alerting).
* Write clean, maintainable Bash and Python scripts for operational tooling.
* Participate in on\-call rotation; collaborate daily with US\-based engineers and management.


Here's What You Need::
**Must\-have:**

* 7\+ years Linux sysadmin experience in production enterprise environments (Rocky Linux, RHEL,  

CentOS).
* 3\+ years hands\-on Ansible/AWX — writing playbooks, roles, and inventories from scratch.
* Jenkins CI/CD pipeline experience (declarative syntax / Jenkinsfile).
* Git proficiency — branching strategies, IaC version control, PR workflows.
* Hands\-on cloud experience — AWS preferred, GCP and Azure helpful. Ability to administer and deploy workloads, not just familiarity.
* Shifted schedule availability for US morning overlap (\~4:00 PM–12:30 AM IST).
* Strong English communication skills — daily collaboration with US team.
* Kubernetes / GKE experience.

**Nice\-to\-have:**

* AI tooling exposure — AI\-assisted observability, LLM\-integrated scripting, or automation platforms with AI capabilities.
* OS patch management tooling: Foreman, Satellite, or equivalent.
* Java app server administration: WebLogic, Tomcat.
* Infrastructure\-as\-code in cloud environments.
* Additional CI/CD tooling: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD.
* Monitoring/observability platforms — Datadog preferred; Checkmk, Nagios, Zabbix, or similar also relevant.
* F5 BIG\-IP or enterprise load balancer exposure.
* Multi\-cloud (AWS \+ Azure/GCP) experience.

336a35d5.description:
**Description**
 Senior Program Manager, Purchase – Retail Business Services
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead strategy and execution for Shopping Mission Completion, ensuring customers can seamlessly discover, evaluate, and purchase products across the Amazon store.
   

  

**About Amazon**
 Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the widest of selection at low price that drives Amazon’s flywheel.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The vision of Retail Business Services (RBS) Organization at Amazon is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by improving customer experience and enabling our Selling Partners (SPs) to grow their business with Amazon. RBS provides catalog augmentation and correction technologies for the Amazon selling community. Our solutions ensure information in Amazon's catalogs is both complete and comprehensive enough to give our customers a great shopping experience every time.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 RBS is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead a Strategy for Shopping Mission Completion for Customers. Amazon Store Walk analysis uncovers critical defects across the Amazon shopping journey; spanning across product discovery, evaluation, and purchase completion. These systemic problems impact the customer shopping journey, from how customers discover and evaluate products to their ability to complete purchases. These issues are categorized into four key defect themes: Data, Search, Catalog and Customer Experience. To resolve these issues, we recommend a coordinated, cross\-functional engagement with partner teams that will improve overall customer shopping experience . This role will be at the center of collaboration between multiple world wide teams in re\-imagining the purchase experience for customers.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities

Here, you'll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI\-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you're ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

* Drive best practice contact center design into each and every aspect of solution delivery

* Exercise independent judgment, and take the lead role on enterprise level projects with minimal direction from senior management

 QUALIFICATIONS:

 What's it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.



As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will own our large and important customer issues in addition to providing level two support to our other support teams. You will be a part of a global team that provides 24x7 support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud.  

In this role, you will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. Sr. Solutions Architect  



  

**Full Location:** Bengaluru \- IN

  

The Sr. Solutions Architect designs and sells winning outsourcing solutions for the assigned vertical. This role owns the solution response on new business and expansion pursuits: sizing the work, shaping the operating and delivery model, building the staffing and cost model, and making a clear case for how ResultsCX (RCX) will run the client’s customer experience better than it runs today. The role works directly with prospects and clients (“client”) and with RCX sales, operations, workforce management, recruiting, training, and pricing teams to produce solutions that win in the market and hold up in the field. The measures that matter are operational and commercial: cost to serve, CSAT and NPS, first contact resolution, sales conversion, quality, and compliance. This role also shapes the transformation roadmap for large multi\-tower deals, new geographies, and new service offerings.

**In this role you will:**

* Own the solution end to end on assigned pursuits, from qualification through contract signature and handoff to the implementation and transition teams.
* Drive the process with a sense of urgency while protecting the quality of the solution.
* Timely responses to RFIs, RFPs, proposals, and contractual obligations.
* Development and delivery of client presentations, solution documents, and the commercial story behind the price.
* Orchestration of pilots, site visits, and proof\-of\-concept work.
* Preparation of cost estimates, staffing models, and pricing assumptions.
* Coordination of operations, workforce management, recruiting, training, and quality resources as required.
* Identify solutioning opportunities
* Conducting discovery across the client’s current operation: volumes, channels, handle times, shrinkage, occupancy, staffing, schedules, and cost per contact.
* Capturing pain points and business requirements, and documenting both the “as is” and “to be” operating models.
* Build a clear picture of how the client’s operation runs today
* Match RCX delivery locations, labor models, and service offerings to what the client actually needs.
* Identify performance gaps and recommend practical options to close them.
* Assess risk and regulatory exposure that affects the client’s operation and the proposed solution.
* Design solutions that combine people, process, and automation in a mix the client can adopt and RCX can deliver.
* Maintain professional and industry knowledge by attending events and workshops, reviewing industry publications, building a network, and participating in professional associations.

**We are looking for someone who has:**

* A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in area of Business, Management, Marketing, Finance or other closely degree. Equivalent experience may be substituted for education.

Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high\-performing, fun culture to deliver next\-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.

26005c4b.title: Solution Architect
26005c4b.description:
**Project Role :** Solution Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Translate client requirements into differentiated, deliverable solutions using in\-depth knowledge of a technology, function, or platform. Collaborate with the Sales Pursuit and Delivery Teams to develop a winnable and deliverable solution that underpins the client value proposition and business case.
  

**Must have skills :** Network Architecture and Design  

**Good to have skills :** SD\-WAN Implementation  

Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Solution Architect, a typical day involves interpreting and transforming client needs into unique and actionable solutions that align with business objectives. This role requires close collaboration with sales and delivery teams to craft strategies that not only meet client expectations but also provide a strong foundation for successful project execution. The position demands continuous engagement with various stakeholders to ensure that the proposed solutions are practical, innovative, and add significant value to the client s business case, fostering long\-term partnerships and successful outcomes.  

We are seeking a seasoned and highly experienced Senior Solution Architect to join our Technology Practice. This is a strategic, client\-facing solutioning role where the primary focus is converting sales\-qualified opportunities into well\-defined, technically sound, and commercially viable solutions. Opportunities are brought in by the Sales Team — your remit begins with validating the requirement and ends with a complete solution ready for delivery.
  

The successful candidate will work in close partnership with the Sales Team to understand client needs, validate scope, and develop compelling solution proposals. This role demands exceptional communication skills, deep technical expertise across networking, cloud, and Microsoft technologies, and the ability to define resource requirements and delivery timelines with precision.
  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Requirement Validation \& Sales Collaboration

Receive sales\-qualified opportunities from the Sales Team and conduct thorough validation of client requirements, scope, and technical feasibility.
  

Work closely with the Sales Team to clarify ambiguities, fill gaps in the brief, and ensure a clear understanding of the client's business and technical needs before solutioning begins.
  

Act as the key liaison between the Sales Team and the technical practice — ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, and commercial expectations throughout the engagement.
  

* Client Engagement \& Advisory

Lead client\-facing conversations to probe, validate, and refine requirements in collaboration with the Sales Team.
  

Build credibility with client stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, articulating solution value clearly at both technical and business levels.
  

Present solution proposals, architecture blueprints, and delivery roadmaps with confidence to client and internal stakeholders.
  

* Solutioning \& Architecture

Design end\-to\-end technical solutions across SD\-WAN, networking, Microsoft Product Suite, and Cloud Implementation Services based on validated requirements.
  

Define resource requirements and effort estimates — specifying the number of resources and number of days required for delivery.
  

Develop high\-level and detailed architecture documentation, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and technical proposals.
  

Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with client business objectives and industry best practices.
  

* Internal Coordination \& Stakeholder Management

Coordinate internally with delivery leads, engineers, project managers, vendors, and practice leads to validate and refine solutions prior to submission.
  

Serve as the bridge between the Sales Team and delivery, ensuring a seamless handover with complete solution documentation and knowledge transfer post\-award.
  

Engage with vendor and partner ecosystems (e.g., Microsoft, Cisco, AWS/Azure) to leverage technical and commercial support during the solutioning process.
  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

Required Technical Expertise \-  

* SD\-WAN \& Networking

Hands\-on experience designing and architecting SD\-WAN solutions (e.g., Cisco Meraki, Fortinet, VMware VeloCloud, or equivalent).
  

Strong grounding in enterprise networking — routing, switching, firewalls, MPLS, BGP, and network segmentation.
  

Experience with network transformation projects, including migration from legacy WAN to SD\-WAN environments.
  

  

* Microsoft Product Suite

Deep expertise across Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, Intune, Teams, SharePoint, and related productivity and security toolsets.
  

Familiarity with Microsoft licensing models and their commercial implications in solution design.
  

Experience with Microsoft security frameworks including Defender, Sentinel, and Zero Trust architecture principles.
  

  

* Cloud Implementation Services

Proven experience architecting cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure and/or AWS — including IaaS, PaaS, hybrid cloud, and cloud migration projects.
  

Understanding of cloud governance, cost optimisation, and security best practices in enterprise environments.
  

Ability to size and scope cloud engagements, including resource and effort estimation for delivery.
  

  

Additional Information:
  

* Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering complex, multi\-technology solutions in client\-facing solutioning roles.
* Experience working alongside Sales Teams — translating sales\-qualified opportunities into complete, delivery\-ready solution proposals.
* Strong commercial acumen — experience building resource plans, effort estimates, and solution costings.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills ability to present confidently to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Relevant certifications highly regarded: CCNP/CCIE, Microsoft Azure/M365 certifications, AWS Solutions Architect, TOGAF or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  

You Excel At
  

Leading complex client conversations with confidence
  

Translating business problems into technical solutions
  

Navigating ambiguity and driving clarity
  

Collaborating across technical and commercial teams
  

  

You Are Known For
  

Executive presence and polished communication
  

Attention to detail in solution documentation
  

Ownership mentality — end to end
  

A collaborative, low\-ego approach
  

  

The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Network Architecture and Design.  

* This position is based at our Pune office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

Responsibilities also include the design, architecture and management of the end user computing platform, developing and maintaining technology standards based on industry best practices, managing a technology roadmap, and proposing and developing new solutions based on business strategy. The Manager will work with the broader IT and business organization to deliver solutions, serve as a subject matter expert in end user computing technology, manage governance and compliance to the standards, and drive focus on delivering an excellent customer experience.

1\) Overseeing the end\-to\-end delivery process of services, ensuring that they are delivered according to agreed\-upon service level agreements (SLAs) or key performance indicators (KPIs). Monitoring service performance and taking necessary actions to meet or exceed service targets.  

2\) Plan, engineer, test and implement robust and cost\-effective computing environments, exploiting emerging technologies to provide compelling client solutions to our business users and improve client service, perception, and satisfaction.  

3\) Develop and manage a clear and concise engineering plan, based on provided architectural documents, for the Client Computing platform.  

4\) Communicate and justify recommendations and plans to management and user communities.  

5\) Assist with the evaluation and characterize software products and technologies and provide recommendations regarding selection and adoption, backed by rigorous analysis and justification.  

6\) Assist with conducting proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) and pilots for new products and technologies, analyze the value and impacts from technical perspectives, and effectively communicate results and recommendations.  

7\) Advise, collaborate, and possibly lead business divisions and IT partners in projects to enable users and applications to take full advantage of new / enhanced solutions.  

8\) Advise, collaborate, and lead application solution delivery groups in design and development of business solutions incorporating new and/or approved technologies, by contributing to engineering decisions, and characterizing designs and implementation approaches in a controlled environment to ensure they meet desired operational goals (performance, stability, scalability, usability, manageability etc ).  

9\) Lead team responsible for aspects of IT Infrastructure, examples Network, Operating Systems, Identity, Applications, Voice, Virtualization, both on\-premise and in Cloud.  

10\) Organize, schedule, and supervise the day\-to\-day technical support activities, including troubleshooting, customer service issues, approvals, and installations.  

11\) Measure, monitor, and maintain team s ability to meet or exceed contact and resolution SLA.  

12\) Deep knowledge of and extensive experience with Microsoft s enterprise platform.  

13\) Demonstrated leadership in developing and propagating best practices for management of enterprise systems through the full lifecycle from planning to retirement.  

14\) Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-disciplinary project teams in high\-stress environments with strict time and resource constraints. Formal qualification in project management is a big advantage.  

15\) Demonstrated ability to manage and direct senior professionals, and to provide coaching and mentoring to help them realize their potential and to maximize their value to the organization. Strong analytical and decision\-making abilities.  

16\) Approaches opportunities and issues with an optimistic, action\-oriented, and solution\-based approach.  

17\) Engagement with Project team for SOP, RACI, SRT, SOP type document creation and KT process.  

18\) Coordinate and manage installations, upgrades, changes, and integrations including test design, execution and support.  

19\) Develop timelines, work estimates, cost projections, and manage projects to approved guidelines review and consult on design and technical approach of projects to ensure consistency.  

20\) Participate in the review of software procurement plans for compliance with IT standards and architectural decisions.  

21\) Provide analytical and programming support and planning for IT projects, initiatives, and systems.  

22\) Ensure change management protocols maximize benefit and alleviate.
  

23\) Manage use of corporate funds including budgeting, financial management, and reporting. Identify opportunities to achieve administrative efficiencies while maintaining service.  

24\) Provide capacity planning, forecasting, and budgeting of equipment, software, service, and End User license needs to support Information Technology and our Business partners.  

25\) Review software procurement plans for compliance with IT standards and architectural decisions.  

26\) Conduct vendor negotiations to contain or reduce contract services expense and/or one time purchase expense OTHER.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:  

1\) Strong understanding in BYOD and COD, WCD (Configuration Designer), Autopilot, Auto\-Enrolment, Auto\-Enrol with GPO via AAD or ADFS, Autopilot Hybrid, Dual management with Intune and SCCM  

2\) Direct systems design, programming, implementation and modification activities in the area of End User Computing, in conjunction with Team Leaders, other IT technical managers, users, and management.  

3\) Analyze design and architectural issues pertaining to End User Computing services and adjust design to solve problems in a dynamic environment align business requirements with enterprise technology alternatives and options. Provide  

4\) perspective on leading industry trends and recommend new and emerging technologies.  

5\) Optimize desktop infrastructure through virtualization technologies and provide Subject Matter Expertise (SME) input into solution design, and optimization for end user productivity solutions.  

6\) Oversee the management of a high performing end\-user desktop environment including virtual desktops, laptops, desktops, thin clients and all application delivery to those computing environments.  

7\) Work with Information Security Services and Corporate Integrity to maintain system and application securities.  

  

Additional Information:  

1\) Ability to work independently and make decisions with little direct supervision.  

2\) Good interpersonal communication and customer service skills are needed in order to work successfully with customers in high stress and or ambiguous situations.  

3\) Bachelor s Degree / Diploma in Engineering / Computer Science  

4\) Experience in providing voice based Technical Support is desirable.  

5\) Experience of working with global customers is an asset.


  

15 years full time education

 ,
 **large deal leadership** 
 , and a strong

 .

 .

 to create cohesive and compelling solutions.

 **clear business value narratives**

 .

 .

 .

 .

 .

2b331024.title: Programmatic Solutions Consultant, DSP IN, Amazon DSP, DSP IN, Amazon DSP
2b331024.description:
**Description**
 Amazon India Advertising is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions \- including sponsored, display, video, and custom ads \- leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self\-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e\-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.
   

  

 Our programmatic advertising platform team, is looking for an Programmatic Solutions Consultant to join Amazon Advertising's growing team.
   

  

 As a Programmatic Solutions Consultant, DSP, you will manage the end to end experience of our enterprise trading desk and large agency customer, driving the overall expertise for our programmatic advertising DSP. The PSC has expertise in advertising technology, programmatic advertising, and the Amazon DSP, and is leveraging this expertise to develop our customers into proficient users. **This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Support Engineer (Night Shift \- US timing) based in India.**
 This is a remote, customer\-facing technical support role focused on helping enterprise customers maintain reliable, high\-performing digital services.
   

  

 You’ll troubleshoot complex issues across web performance, media delivery, security, and edge computing environments.
   

  

 The role combines strong networking and Linux expertise with programming knowledge and a customer\-first mindset.
   

  

 You’ll lead technical investigations, coordinate with internal teams globally, and remain accountable for customer issues through resolution.
   

  

 Working with customers primarily in U.S. regions, you’ll communicate through tickets, email, and online calls while maintaining clear technical documentation.
   

  

 The position offers exposure to large\-scale cloud and internet technologies and opportunities to develop deep subject\-matter expertise.
   

  

 It is an excellent environment for engineers who stay calm under pressure, enjoy solving challenging problems, and want to grow within a global technical organization.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Act as a trusted technical partner for customers in U.S. regions, troubleshooting and mitigating complex issues across cloud, web performance, media, security, and edge computing services.
* Lead technical investigations across globally distributed cloud and internet infrastructure, identifying root causes and implementing or recommending effective solutions.
* Own customer issues from initial investigation through resolution, maintaining clear communication and appropriate expectations throughout the support lifecycle.
* Provide technical assistance through ticketing systems, email, and online calls, ensuring interactions are accurately documented and followed through.
* Collaborate with internal engineering, product, and support teams across different time zones to resolve complex or escalated technical problems.
* Apply knowledge of networking protocols and Linux environments to diagnose connectivity, application, performance, and infrastructure\-related issues.
* Analyze application logs and command\-line outputs to investigate technical problems and determine appropriate remediation steps.
* Maintain and leverage internal knowledge resources to improve troubleshooting efficiency and consistency.
* Contribute feedback that helps improve internal tools, support procedures, documentation, and customer\-facing processes.
* Continuously develop technical expertise and work toward becoming a subject matter expert in relevant products and technologies.
* Maintain a calm, empathetic, and professional approach when handling technically complex or high\-pressure customer situations.


**Requirements**
* 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in technical support, cloud support, network operations, application support, or a comparable customer\-facing engineering environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Strong understanding of standard internet and networking protocols, including TCP/IP, UDP, QUIC, DNS, HTTP, and BGP.
* Hands\-on experience working with Linux, particularly Bash/Shell command\-line environments and application log analysis.
* Demonstrable programming experience in languages such as Python or Java.
* Familiarity with web technologies such as HTML and JavaScript.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical problems methodically and identify root causes.
* Excellent customer\-service orientation and experience providing business\-to\-business technical support.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple investigations, prioritize effectively, and maintain ownership of customer issues through resolution.
* Comfortable collaborating with globally distributed teams and working across multiple time zones.
* Ability to remain composed under pressure while maintaining a high standard of technical accuracy and customer empathy.
* Curious and proactive mindset, with a willingness to continuously learn new technologies, tools, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Willingness and ability to work a night shift aligned with U.S. business hours.


**Benefits**
* Fully remote working opportunity from India.
* Night\-shift schedule aligned with U.S. customer support hours.
* Opportunity to work with large\-scale cloud, internet, web performance, security, media, and edge computing technologies.
* Exposure to complex technical investigations involving globally distributed infrastructure.
* Customer\-facing experience with enterprise and business\-to\-business environments.
* Opportunities to develop specialized technical expertise and progress toward subject matter expert roles.
* Access to professional development initiatives, mentoring, internal learning resources, and career\-growth programs.
* Opportunities to explore different technical roles and career paths within a global technology organization.
* Collaborative environment with colleagues and technical teams working across multiple regions.
* Meaningful opportunity to contribute to customer reliability and the performance of critical digital services.

 Abacus.AI is a pioneering company in the field of Generative AI, dedicated to shaping the future of work through innovative AI\-powered solutions. Our mission is to empower enterprises and professionals by automating workflows, enhancing productivity, and unlocking new capabilities that drive business growth. Your leadership will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with strategic objectives. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background combined with excellent project management skills, enabling seamless coordination across multiple teams and stakeholders.
 



 You will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end delivery of strategic technical programs, building detailed project plans, defining milestones, and tracking progress. Your ability to identify dependencies, mitigate risks, and resolve blockers will be critical to maintaining momentum. Additionally, you will facilitate cross\-functional collaboration, ensure high\-quality releases, and communicate program status effectively to leadership. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI technology, influencing product development and operational excellence at a high\-growth company.

 The ideal candidate will have between 4 to 7 years of professional experience, currently functioning as a Technical Program Manager or Technical Project Manager. A strong technical understanding of software development processes and system architecture is essential. Experience managing complex, cross\-functional engineering programs is required, along with proven ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Product, Design, QA, and executive teams.
 



 Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and execution skills are vital for success in this role. Candidates should have experience working in fast\-paced product organizations with frequent release cycles, demonstrating strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a bias for action. Familiarity with billing, payments, subscriptions, invoicing, revenue systems, or financial transaction processes will be highly advantageous. Experience in payments, fintech, or owning billing/payment initiatives is considered a strong plus.
 



  





  





 Responsibilities
 



 You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of strategic technical programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer impact. Your responsibilities include building comprehensive program plans, defining key milestones, and meticulously tracking execution progress. You will manage dependencies, identify and mitigate risks, and coordinate efforts across multiple teams to maintain project momentum.
 



 Driving alignment among Engineering, Product, Design, and Business teams will be a core part of your role. You will lead release planning activities, ensuring timely and high\-quality deliveries that meet or exceed expectations. Monitoring program health through relevant metrics and communicating progress effectively to leadership stakeholders will be essential. Additionally, you will identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance engineering efficiency and delivery predictability, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
 



 Ensuring that project execution remains aligned with strategic priorities and delivers measurable customer value will be a key focus. Your leadership will help streamline workflows, optimize resource utilization, and support the company's growth objectives.
 



  





  





 Benefits
 



 At Abacus.AI, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' professional and personal growth. This includes competitive salary packages, flexible remote working arrangements, and opportunities for continuous learning and development. Employees gain access to cutting\-edge AI technologies and participate in innovative projects that have a tangible impact across industries. We promote a healthy work\-life balance, foster a collaborative work environment, and provide health insurance coverage, paid time off, and other wellness benefits. Joining our team means being part of a forward\-thinking organization committed to technological excellence and employee success.
 



  





  





 Equal Opportunity
 



 Abacus.AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and drives better business outcomes. bd69b6e3.title: DE - Cloud Data Engineer - AWS - GDSN02
bd69b6e3.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AWS Cloud Data Engineer**
**The opportunity**
 We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering Team and you will work with multi\-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world\-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled AWS Data Engineer to lead the design, development, and implementation of modern cloud\-native data platforms and analytics solutions on AWS. In this role, you will be responsible for defining scalable, secure, and high\-performance data architectures that enable organizations to unlock business value from their data assets. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, application teams, data scientists, and enterprise architects to deliver end\-to\-end data solutions that support analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and Generative AI initiatives.
   

  

 EY Digital Engineering is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Digital Engineering (DE) practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s DE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Data Architecture \& Solution Design**
* Design and implement scalable, secure, and high\-performing cloud\-native data architectures on AWS aligned with business and enterprise objectives.
* Define solution architectures, architecture patterns, and best practices for Data Lakes, Lakehouse platforms, Data Warehouses, and Real\-Time Data Processing solutions.
* Produce architecture blueprints, technical designs, and implementation roadmaps for data modernization and transformation initiatives.
* Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise security, governance, compliance, reliability, and cost optimization standards.


**AWS Data Platform Implementation**
* Architect and guide the implementation of AWS\-based data solutions leveraging services such as Amazon S3, Redshift, Glue, Athena, EMR, Lambda, Lake Formation, Kinesis, and IAM.
* Lead the design of batch, streaming, and real\-time data processing pipelines supporting analytics, reporting, and business intelligence requirements.
* Establish observability, monitoring, and data quality frameworks to improve platform reliability and operational efficiency.
* Support performance tuning, scalability improvements, and optimization of enterprise data platforms.


**Data Governance \& Information Management**
* Define and implement data modeling standards, metadata management, data governance, and data lifecycle strategies.
* Collaborate with security, risk, and compliance teams to ensure adherence to organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Promote best practices around data quality, lineage, stewardship, and master data management.


**AI, Analytics \& GenAI Enablement**
* Design modern data architectures that support analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI use cases.
* Build data foundations for Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, semantic search, and AI\-powered applications.
* Leverage AWS AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenSearch, Textract, and Comprehend to deliver intelligent data solutions.
* Partner with data scientists and analytics teams to operationalize AI and GenAI capabilities at scale.


**Stakeholder Management \& Technical Leadership**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical discussions with clients and internal teams.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to data engineers and development teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support solutioning, estimation, proposal development, and technical reviews for new opportunities.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* 4 \- 7\+ years of overall IT experience, including 3\+ years in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, and Cloud Architecture, with a proven track record of designing and delivering scalable, cloud\-native data platforms on AWS.
* Strong expertise in AWS Data \& Analytics services including S3, Redshift, Glue, Athena, EMR, Lambda, Lake Formation, Kinesis, and IAM, with hands\-on experience architecting and implementing enterprise\-grade data solutions.
* Extensive experience designing and delivering Data Lakes, Lakehouse Architectures, Data Warehouses, and Real\-Time Data Platforms, along with a strong understanding of data modeling, governance, security, metadata management, data quality, and data lineage.
* Proven ability to define solution architectures, architecture artifacts, reference designs, and technical roadmaps, while guiding engineering teams and ensuring alignment with AWS Well\-Architected Framework and enterprise standards.
* Experience in cloud migration, modernization, and data transformation initiatives, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and delivery teams.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML and Generative AI\-enabled data platforms, including LLMs, RAG, vector databases, semantic search, and AI\-powered analytics solutions, leveraging services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenSearch, Textract, and Comprehend, complemented by strong communication, stakeholder management, consulting, and technical leadership skills.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and AWS Certified Data Analytics/Data Engineer are highly desirable.
* Experience with modern data platform technologies including Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Airflow, DBT, and Matillion will be advantageous
* Experience with data governance frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).


**Education:**
* Degree: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!

 **GDC** 
 team in our
 **SAP**

However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.

Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
   

  

 We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE.**
**Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**
* Configure and maintain financial applications within SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
* OTC Process Management
* Architect, configure, and maintain SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud OTC processes, ensuring end\-to\-end order lifecycle from order entry to invoicing and cash application.

+ Integrate OTC with other SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud modules (FICO, Project Systems) and external systems using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), APIs, and EDI/IDoc interfaces.

+ Monitor OTC transaction flows, troubleshoot issues, and optimize performance.

+ Provide advanced support and training to OTC users, ensuring adoption and satisfaction.

+ Monitor system performance and proactively identify and resolve issues.
+ Manage user access and security policies to safeguard system integrity.
+ Document system configurations and procedures for future reference and compliance.

+ Execute UAT and tasks for Upgrades, Mergers and Acquisitions, Vendor Coordination, and other associated projects.

+ Ensure high system performance and reliability to meet user needs.
+ Implement/Maintain robust user access and security policies to protect system data.
+ Resolve complex system issues promptly to minimize downtime.
+ Maintain comprehensive system documentation for future reference.
+ Provide advanced user support and training to enhance system utilization.
+ Lead successful system audits and compliance checks to meet regulatory requirements.
+ Implement new SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud features and modules to enhance system capabilities.
+ Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to integrate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems with other business applications.

+ Excellent communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate with various stakeholders. Experience working in a global team environment.
+ In\-depth knowledge of data management to ensure data integrity.
+ SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud certification to validate expertise.
+ Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet business demands.
+ Lead meetings by setting clear objectives, driving focused and collaborative discussion, and ensuring accountability for timely completion of action items.

**Required Knowledge And Skills**+ Comprehensive knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud architecture to understand system components.
+ SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Expertise
+ Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud OTC functionalities and SD module.
+ Familiarity with SAP Activate methodology, cloud implementation lifecycle, and best practices.

* Business Process Knowledge

5200c111.title: Application Consultant-IBM Cloud Migration
5200c111.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant for Cloud Migration, you will play a key client\-facing leadership role in developing and delivering cloud migration solutions. You will lead the development of migration platform solutions for hybrid\-cloud environments, including IBM Cloud Private and IBM Cloud Platform, based on client priorities and business benefits.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Lead Migration Solution Development: Lead the development of migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms, including on\-prem, off\-prem, and dedicated cloud environments, in collaboration with client representatives.
* Build Migration Strategy: Lead the team in building migration strategies based on value vs. effort, and prepare cost\-benefit models and inputs to ROI analysis.
* Collaborate with Vendors/Partners: Lead discussions with migration vendors/partners to determine solution\-based tools/vendors specialties, including what vendor/tool, when, why, and benefits.
* Contribute to Migration Methodology: Significantly contribute to migration methodology and tailor methods to client environments and industries.
* Deliver Solution Design: Lead the team in delivering migration solution designs, including effort estimation, costing, staffing, client negotiations, and tailoring solutions to meet client budgetary guidelines.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Cloud Migration Solution Development: Exposure to leading the development of migration platform solutions for hybrid\-cloud environments, including IBM Cloud Private and IBM Cloud Platform.
* Hybrid Cloud Migration: Experience working with migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms, including on\-prem, off\-prem, and dedicated cloud environments.
* Migration Strategy Development: Exposure to building migration strategies based on value vs. effort, and preparing cost\-benefit models and inputs to ROI analysis.
* Vendor/Partner Collaboration: Experience working with migration vendors/partners to determine solution\-based tools/vendors specialties.
* Migration Methodology: Exposure to contributing to migration methodology and tailoring methods to client environments and industries.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Cloud Migration Methodology: Exposure to contributing to migration methodology and tailoring methods to client environments and industries, with the ability to adapt to changing client needs.
* Hybrid Cloud Platforms: Experience working with migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms, including on\-prem, off\-prem, and dedicated cloud environments, with a focus on delivering client\-centric solutions.
* Migration Solution Design: Exposure to delivering migration solution designs, including effort estimation, costing, staffing, client negotiations, and tailoring solutions to meet client budgetary guidelines.

9a95967e.title: Engagement Manager
9a95967e.company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
9a95967e.description:
**Purpose** 




  





 CEEW seeks to hire an Engagement Lead (EL) for its Low Carbon Economy (LCE) programme. The individual would be responsible for actively engaging while strengthening and building trusted relationships with state governments, while also engaging with central government ministries, industry, academia, civil society and other stakeholders as need to achieve the programme’s objective. The EL will be responsible for preparing the engagement and advocacy strategy for the LCE programme’s initiatives across various states and implementing it through intensive consultations with major stakeholders.
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced professional with hands\-on experience and deep sectoral understanding, to build and expand CEEW’s work on informing climate policy\-making, particularly at the state level. The candidate should be able to connect the dots across many moving parts and look for innovative ways to conduct and socialise research with the key decision makers.
 



  





**Job Duties and Accountabilities** 




  




* Represent CEEW and build networks: represent CEEW at relevant meetings and events especially at the state level, and strengthen relationships with governmental and non\-governmental stakeholders.
* Develop state\-level strategies: Support the design and implementation of the LCE programme’s engagement and advocacy strategy.
* Facilitate communication and coordination: Act as the primary point of contact for technical exchanges and communication between CEEW and stakeholders and prepare meeting notes.
* Organise strategic events: Plan, minute and manage meetings, consultations, and events in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Build research networks: Establish and maintain local, national, and international research collaborations to support program goals.
* Work closely with senior researchers to develop short briefs/presentations with research insights and support revenue generation.
* Present research findings: Share research outcomes with key stakeholders, advisory bodies, and at conferences.
* Any other responsibilities related to the work profile.



  





**Selection Criteria** 




  





**Education and Experience:** 




  




* Master’s degree in Public Policy/Governance/Climate Change /Environment Management/Urban Planning/ Sustainable Development or any other relevant field.
* At least 10 years of relevant work experience in consulting, policy engagement and project management, preferably in climate policy or sustainable development.
* Experience of engagement with government ministries is critical.



  





**Key Skills:** 




  




* Strong networking skills with senior government representatives.
* Understanding of India’s climate policy and the role of states in it.
* Demonstrate strong networking skills and ability to represent the organisation on national and international platforms.
* Ability to summarise and communicate research insights/findings as briefs and presentations.
* Must leverage his/her stakeholder network in the to keep a tab on the latest climate policy trends.
* Strong written and oral communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office application suite.



  





**Personality** 



* Willingness to learn new skills.
* Ability to adapt and deliver under tight deadlines in a professional environment.
* Striving for rigour and quality in work output.
* Ability to effectively work in a team.
* Ability to dig deeper into details while understanding the big picture.
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Good organisational skills are desirable.



  





**Compensation** 




 Competitive compensation – commensurate to the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.
 



  





**Application Process** 




  





 CEEW is an equal opportunity employer and the selection process does not discriminate on the basis of gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, or sexuality.
 



 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Interested applicants are advised to apply at the earliest possible.
 



 Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by us. We appreciate your interest.
 



 CEEW operates in a dynamic environment and the candidate will be required to show flexibility in undertaking a variety of tasks.

f8775617.title: Global Technical Program Manager
f8775617.description:
**Company Description** 
 SysTechCorp Inc delivers leading\-edge technology services that help clients achieve and surpass their strategic business goals. The company’s practices in AI, machine learning, mobile solutions, cloud technologies, and ERP systems are supported by years of implementation experience and strong domain expertise. SysTechCorp Inc serves a diverse range of industry verticals, giving team members exposure to complex, global business environments. Team members work with innovative technologies and enterprise\-scale solutions that drive measurable impact for clients.
 


**Role Description** 

 The Global Program Manager for Query Fabric / Fabric as a Service (FaaS) is responsible for leading the program delivery of Teradata's unified query execution platform — enabling enterprises to run analytical workloads across heterogeneous compute environments and data sources through a single, governed fabric. This is a technically complex, ecosystem\-facing program that requires close coordination with engineering, cloud partners, enterprise architects, and field technical teams. The GPM owns the program structure that ensures FaaS capabilities are delivered with interoperability, enterprise readiness, and GTM alignment as first\-class outcomes.
 



 This role requires deep engagement with platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, and solutions architecture on the build side, and with sales engineering, technical enablement, customer success, and cloud alliance teams on the deployment and adoption side. You will represent FaaS program status to senior leadership and navigate external partner relationships at a program level.
 


 What You'll Do
 
 •       Own the Fabric as a Service program plan — defining delivery milestones across query engine integrations, connector development, governance layers, and cloud deployment targets.
 



 •       Drive alignment across engineering, platform architecture, cloud partnerships, and product management on FaaS scope, sequencing, and launch criteria.
 



 •       Manage the dependency surface between Query Fabric and other platform programs — including Elastic Compute, ADP, and Context Engine — ensuring workstreams are coordinated and blockers are resolved without downstream impact.
 



 •       Define and track enterprise readiness criteria for FaaS: security, compliance, performance SLAs, observability, and support coverage — ensuring each capability meets the bar before customer exposure.
 



 •       Partner with cloud and ecosystem alliance teams to manage external partner dependencies, integration timelines, and co\-launch coordination.
 



 •       Lead technical enablement readiness — ensuring that sales engineers, solution architects, and customer\-facing technical teams can position, configure, and support FaaS effectively at launch.
 



 •       Own program health reporting for FaaS leadership reviews, tracking delivery confidence, integration status, risk exposure, and partner readiness.
 



 •       Facilitate feedback loops between early adopter customers, field teams, and product engineering — translating real\-world configuration and performance signals into prioritized backlog input.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 •       10\+ years of program management experience in the tech industry, with at least 5 years leading cross\-functional, global programs.
 



 •       Demonstrated experience managing technically complex platform or infrastructure programs — ideally with cloud, data, or query/compute infrastructure components.
 



 •       Ability to engage credibly with engineers and architects on technical scope and integration design, while simultaneously managing GTM and enablement workstreams.
 



 •       Strong dependency management skills — experience mapping and managing large, multi\-team delivery programs with external partner components.
 



 •       Effective communicator across engineering, field, and executive audiences.
 



 •       Bachelor's degree required.
 


 Preferred Qualifications
 
 •       Experience with federated query engines, data virtualization, cloud data platforms, or multi\-cloud architecture programs.
 



 •       Familiarity with ecosystem partner management and co\-sell or co\-launch motions with cloud providers.
 



 •       PMP or equivalent certification; agile delivery experience in a large engineering organization.
 


* •       Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline.

507f7ab6.title: AI Solutions lead
507f7ab6.description:
**About the role** 





 We help mid\-market and mid\-tier enterprises move from AI intent to AI in production — with the outcome measured, governed, and owned. We are not a strategy firm and not a development shop; we sit in the gap between them, where most enterprise AI initiatives die.
 





 This is a senior, client\-facing role. Your first engagement is with a law firm that wants to understand what AI can realistically do for their practice, which tools are worth adopting, and what needs to be purpose\-built. You will be embedded with them — sitting with partners and associates, learning how the work actually gets done, and translating that into a concrete, sequenced plan they can act on.
 





 You will then do the same for clients in banking, insurance, manufacturing and shared\-services centres.
 





 This is not an implementation\-only role and it is not a research role. You need to be credible in a partner's office and credible at a terminal, in the same week.
 




**What you will actually do** 




**Discovery and opportunity mapping** 



* Sit inside the client's workflows — matter intake, conflict checks, document review, contract abstraction, due diligence, legal research, drafting, knowledge management, time capture and billing — and understand where the real friction is, as opposed to where people say it is
* Quantify baselines before proposing anything: hours spent, turnaround times, error rates, cost per unit of work. No recommendation goes out without a measured baseline behind it
* Interview across seniority — a senior partner and a second\-year associate will describe the same process completely differently, and the gap between those accounts is usually where the opportunity sits



**Assessment and prioritisation** 



* Generate a candidate use\-case portfolio and score it on value, feasibility, risk and data readiness
* Kill the majority of candidates and say clearly why. A client who receives twenty "opportunities" has received nothing
* Assess whether the client's data and systems can actually support each candidate — most AI failures are data failures, not model failures



**Tool evaluation and build\-vs\-buy** 



* Evaluate the legal AI tool landscape on merit rather than marketing — contract review and abstraction platforms, legal research assistants, document intelligence, e\-discovery, drafting and knowledge management tools, and general\-purpose LLM deployments
* Make a clear build\-vs\-buy call per use case with the reasoning exposed
* Run structured vendor evaluations: security posture, data residency, model provenance, pricing at scale, exit terms



**Solution design** 



* Write specifications precise enough for an engineering pod to build from — architecture, integration points, evaluation criteria, human\-in\-the\-loop design, failure modes
* Build lightweight prototypes yourself where a working demonstration will settle an argument faster than a document
* Design the evaluation harness and golden dataset up front, not after the build



**Governance and risk** 



* Design for the client's actual constraint set. In a legal practice that means client confidentiality and privilege, conflicts of interest, DPDP obligations, retention and disposal, and the professional consequences of unverified AI output reaching a filing or a client
* Specify audit logging, human review checkpoints, output constraints and escalation paths as part of the solution, never as an afterthought



**Adoption** 



* Design the rollout, run enablement, and stay close enough to see where usage actually lands. A tool nobody opens is not a deployment
* Build the client's internal capability deliberately. Every engagement includes a knowledge transfer plan and a capability assessment at exit — we are explicitly not trying to make ourselves permanent



**What we need from you** 




**Essential** 



* 7\+ years total experience, with at least 2 years working substantively with LLMs, RAG systems, agentic workflows or applied ML in a production or near\-production context
* Demonstrated consulting or client\-facing capability. You have run discovery, presented to senior stakeholders, been challenged, and held your position with evidence. This is weighted as heavily as technical depth
* Genuine hands\-on ability. You can build a working prototype, evaluate a model's output rigorously, and read enough code to know when a vendor is overselling. You do not need to be the strongest engineer in the room, but you cannot be dependent on one to have an opinion
* Process analysis instinct. You are drawn to how work actually flows through an organisation, and you notice the gap between the documented process and the real one
* Structured written communication. Our deliverables are documents. You will write assessment reports, solution specifications and board\-ready summaries, and they need to be good
* Intellectual honesty. You will regularly need to tell a client that a use case they are excited about will not work, or that they should not do AI in a function yet. Candidates who cannot do this are not usable in this role



**Strongly preferred** 



* Exposure to legal, professional services, or another document\-and\-judgement\-heavy domain (audit, compliance, insurance underwriting, medical coding)
* Familiarity with India's regulatory environment for AI and data — DPDP, and sectoral expectations in financial services
* Experience evaluating or deploying enterprise SaaS, including security review and vendor negotiation
* Track record of designing evaluation methodology for AI systems
