eab5a91f.title: Test Automation Architect
eab5a91f.description:
##### **Project description**

The Test Automation Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for defining and delivering the organisation’s end‑to‑end automation strategy. This role designs scalable automation frameworks, selects the right tools and technologies, and drives best‑practice adoption across delivery teams. Operating from a central capability function, the Architect works closely with developers, platform engineers, product managers, and delivery leads to ensure automation effectively validates the full system under test. The role also provides hands‑on leadership and coaching to automation testers across multiple ARTs and programmes.


##### **Responsibilities**


Develop and implement the automation strategy


Build a comprehensive automation strategy aligned with organisational testing goals, defining scope, tooling, frameworks, and required resources.


Identify and prioritise automation opportunities


Work with stakeholders to assess risk, cost, and business value to determine where automation delivers the greatest impact.


Select and implement automation frameworks and tools


Choose and deploy frameworks and technologies that fit the organisation’s needs, considering test types, team capability, and budget.


Lead and mentor automation testers


Provide technical leadership, coaching, and direction to automation testers across teams, ensuring high‑quality test development and execution.


Collaborate with stakeholders


Engage with developers, platform teams, product managers, and business stakeholders to ensure automated tests meet expectations and coverage needs.


Monitor and report automation effectiveness


Track key metrics such as coverage, execution time, stability, and defect detection, and communicate progress to leadership.


Stay current with modern automation and AI practices


Continuously evaluate emerging tools, AI‑driven testing capabilities, and industry best practices; uplift team knowledge through communities of practice.


Support pre‑sales and solutioning activities


Contribute to pre‑sales discussions by shaping automation solutions, estimating effort, preparing technical proposals, and demonstrating automation capabilities to clients and internal stakeholders.


##### **Skills**


Must have


Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field


15\+ years of experience in testing in test automation and more than 5 years of experience as Test Automation Architect.


Automation Framework Design — Ability to architect scalable, modular, and reusable automation frameworks for UI, API, and mobile testing


Strong Programming Skills — Expertise in Java, Python, C\#, or JavaScript for building custom automation solutions


Tooling Expertise — Deep hands‑on experience with Selenium, Playwright, Appium, RestAssured, Cypress, Cucumber, TestNG, JUnit


CI/CD Integration — Skilled in embedding automated tests into Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab pipelines


AI‑Driven Testing — Leveraging AI/ML for test generation, self‑healing scripts, defect prediction, and intelligent test selection


API \& Microservices Testing — Strong understanding of REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and contract testing


Cloud \& Containerisation — Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud‑based test environments (AWS/Azure/GCP)


Automation Strategy Development — Ability to define enterprise‑wide automation vision, roadmap, and maturity model


Tool Evaluation \& Selection — Skilled at assessing tools based on scalability, maintainability, and alignment with tech stack


Test Design \& Coverage Optimisation — Strong grasp of test pyramid, risk‑based testing, and shift‑left practices


Quality Governance — Ability to define coding standards, quality gates, and automation best practices


Test Data \& Environment Strategy — Knowledge of synthetic data creation, stubs, mocks, and environment‑independent automation


Cross‑Functional Collaboration — Works effectively with Dev, QA, DevOps, Product, and Architecture teams


Technical Mentorship — Ability to coach SDETs and QA engineers on automation patterns and best practices


Stakeholder Communication — Skilled at translating technical automation concepts into business value


Nice to have


Experience with Agile development methodologies


Performance and Security Testing

 Master's Degree

* Design master\-data ingestion, standardization, matching, deduplication, survivorship, Golden Record, distribution, and governance capabilities

**Security \& Compliance**

* Define MDM security and role\-based access\-control architecture
* Establish requirements for **data privacy, masking, encryption, auditing, retention, archival, and deletion**
* Ensure sensitive and confidential master data is appropriately protected
* Ensure MDM architecture complies with enterprise security and regulatory requirements

94a03778.description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is building a world\-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain. This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3\-4 days of in\-office collaboration per week.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Cloud CI/CD Engineer will be responsible for the design, development, and implementation of CI/CD pipelines supporting automation application deployment in both public and private clouds. Ensure an “Automate first” culture that builds in optimization and automation opportunities from the onset and accelerates adoption and rollout plans in the existing infrastructure. Responsibilities also include development \& rollout of automated servers and application provisioning routines to perform headless installation of QAD application and third Party software across both Public and Private Clouds. The Cloud CI/CD Engineer will be embedded in product development and release cycles to ensure representation of an operational view of the product including Consistency/Standards, Security, Availability/Uptime, Scalability/Performance, Ease of Maintenance, Business Continuity, \& Cost of Ownership
   

  

**Responsibities**
 Design \& Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) automation through DevSecOps pipelines. Provision and Manage Git Source Control Management (SCM).
   

  

 Develop, Test, \& Rollout automated application provisioning routines to perform headless installation of QAD application and third Party software. This includes development, documentation, and training for scripts \& routines to deploy QAD ERP software, QAD Divisional software, and 3rd Party software
   

  

 Troubleshoot, maintain, and improve upon new and existing CI/CD implementations
   

  

 Evaluate and recommend potential new and/or improved technologies to help facilitate IaC execution and efficiency
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education:**
 Professional degree: Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science, or equivalent experience
   

  

 Graduate Program (MBA, MIB or Masters): 4 years with a Master’s degree
   

  

**Number Of Years**
 Minimum 3 to 5 years of building automated solutions experience in cloud\-based applications. Strong practical Windows and Linux\-based systems administration skills in a Cloud or Virtualized environment. Infrastructure automation through DevOps scripting (E.g. shell, Python, Powershell, Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, \& similar technologies). Hands\-on knowledge of Public Cloud (preferably AWS) services. Strong ability to design and develop scalable automation to quickly deploy large enterprise customers in both Public and Private Clouds. Wide breadth of experience working at all layers of the tech stack (database, networking, applications, infrastructure).
   

  

**Computer Skills**
 CI/CD pipeline creation and maintenance: Terraform, Packer, Jenkins, Ansible, Gitlab Cloud Infrastructure: AWS (preferred), Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)Databases: MS SQL, Progress OpenEdge, Cassandra, MariaDB OS: RedHat Linux, Windows Containerization: Kubernetes, Docker, other Microservices Other technologies: Apache Tomcat, Kafka, NiFi, Spark, JVM Good Understanding of networking concepts (private vs public, TCP ports, VLANs, subnets, CIDR, etc.)
   

  

**Other Knowledge**
 MS SQL, Progress OpenEdge, Cassandra, MariaDB, RedHat Linux, Windows, Kafka, NiFi
   

  

 Highly motivated self\-starter and a change agent with experience and desire to drive organizations to be successful on cutting\-edge Cloud technologies. Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with evolving requirements. Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Effectively able to depict complex systems through diagrams and documentation. Excellent interpersonal skills to work with cross\-functional teams. Knowledge of software development processes \& lifecycle management. Able to effectively present technical information to non\-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly. Strong customer relation and leadership skills
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
   

  

 QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

884ab692.title: Cloud Engineer / Cloud-Native Software Developer
884ab692.description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a skilled
 **Cloud Engineer / Cloud\-Native Software Developer** 
 with strong expertise in
 **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), cloud platform engineering, API development, automation, security, and cloud\-native application development** 
 . The candidate will design and implement scalable GCP platforms, reusable infrastructure modules, integration patterns, and operational data hubs while enabling Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and Data Scientists.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and implement GCP landing zones, cloud architecture patterns, reusable infrastructure modules, and secure cloud\-native solutions.
* Develop and maintain Terraform\-based infrastructure, including reusable modules and infrastructure automation using Atlantis.
* Build, manage, and support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments.
* Develop cloud\-native applications and services using Go, APIs, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, and GKE.
* Design and implement REST APIs and integration patterns for cloud\-native applications and data platforms.
* Build and support operational data hubs leveraging Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, Composer/Airflow, Vertex AI, and AgentSpace.
* Implement and manage IAM, service accounts, security controls, networking, auditing, monitoring, logging, and alerting across GCP environments.
* Develop automated solutions for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, deployment, monitoring, and operational support.
* Manage and support the GitHub Enterprise environment, including repositories, access, integrations, workflows, and enterprise\-level CI/CD capabilities.
* Work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and Data Scientists to provide scalable and reusable cloud platforms.
* Ensure cloud solutions are secure, highly available, scalable, automated, and cost\-efficient.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement preventive solutions.
* Establish and maintain cloud platform engineering standards, reusable patterns, documentation, and best practices.
* Support multi\-team GCP environments and ensure consistent implementation of security and governance standards.


 Mandatory Technical Skills
   

  

* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Terraform
* Atlantis
* Go / Golang
* REST API / API Development
* Cloud Run
* Pub/Sub
* GKE / Kubernetes
* Cloud SQL
* IAM
* GCP Networking
* CI/CD
* GitHub Enterprise
* Cloud Monitoring / Logging / Alerting
* Cloud Composer / Airflow


 Good to Have
   

  

* Vertex AI
* AgentSpace
* Cloud Functions
* Dataflow / Apache Beam
* BigQuery
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* GitHub Actions
* Python
* Infrastructure as Code best practices
* Cloud security and governance
* FinOps / GCP cost optimization


 Required Competencies
   

  

* Strong cloud platform engineering experience.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native architecture and microservices.
* Hands\-on experience in API development and integrations.
* Strong automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code mindset.
* Good understanding of GCP security, IAM, networking, and governance.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale, multi\-team GCP environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and production\-support skills.
* Ability to create reusable, scalable, secure, and cost\-efficient cloud solutions.
* Strong collaboration skills with Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, and Application teams.


 Ideal Candidate Profile
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be a
 **GCP Cloud/Platform Engineer or Cloud\-Native Software Developer** 
 rather than a purely Data Engineer. The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in
 **GCP \+ Go \+ APIs \+ Terraform/Atlantis \+ Kubernetes/GKE \+ Cloud Run \+ Pub/Sub \+ Cloud SQL** 
 , along with CI/CD, IAM, networking, monitoring, and enterprise cloud platform management.
   

  

 Skills: gcp,api,golang

 Prodapt is the largest specialized player in the Connectedness industry, serving leading telecom and technology enterprises that build next\-generation networks and digital experiences. As an AI\-first strategic technology partner and ServiceNow\-invested company, Prodapt delivers consulting, business reengineering, and managed services recognized by Gartner as a Large, Telecom\-Native, Regional IT Service Provider. The company connects over 1\.1 billion people and 5\.4 billion devices worldwide, with a client portfolio that includes global brands such as Google, Amazon, PayPal, ServiceNow, Verizon, and Vodafone. Prodapt is “Great Place To Work® Certified™” and employs more than 6,000 technology and domain experts across the Americas, Europe, India, Africa, and Japan. Part of the 130\-year\-old Jhaver Group, Prodapt offers a stable, global environment with diverse growth opportunities.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a ServiceNow Lead Engineer and Architect based in Bengaluru South. The individual in this role will lead the design and architecture of ServiceNow solutions, translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable platform implementations. Daily responsibilities include overseeing configuration and customization of ServiceNow modules, guiding the technical implementation team, and ensuring adherence to best practices and governance standards. The role involves collaborating with stakeholders to define roadmaps, conducting technical reviews, optimizing platform performance, and driving integrations with other enterprise systems. The ServiceNow Lead Engineer and Architect will also mentor team members, contribute to solution documentation, and support ongoing enhancement and incident resolution activities.
 



**Qualifications** 




 ServiceNow Architect\-OMT/SOMT
 



 Experience
 


* Overall Experience: 15\+ years in IT Service Management / IT Operations / Enterprise Monitoring
* Relevant Experience: 8\+ years in ServiceNow platform with deep focus on TSOM



 Job Summary
 



 We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Architect to lead the design, architecture, and implementation of ServiceNow Technology Service Operations Management solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining scalable IT Operations architectures, driving observability and AIOps initiatives, and enabling proactive operations through ServiceNow TSOM modules.
 



 This role requires strong technical leadership, hands\-on architectural expertise, and the ability to work with enterprise stakeholders to transform IT Operations using ServiceNow best practices.

 Architecture \& Solution Design

* Operational Intelligence

* CMDB data sources
* Third‑party observability platforms

 Technical Leadership

* Review and approve technical designs, configurations, and customizations
* Mentor developers, administrators, and consultants on TSOM architecture and standards
* Conduct technical workshops and design sessions with stakeholders



 AIOps \& Observability
 


* Design and implement AIOps\-driven event correlation and noise reduction
* Enable proactive operations through anomaly detection and predictive insights
* Optimize operational workflows using event rules, alerts, and automations



 Governance \& Optimization
 


* Define TSOM governance, standards, and architectural guardrails
* Drive performance optimization, stability, and scalability of ServiceNow platform
* Ensure alignment with ServiceNow best practices and upgrade strategies



 Stakeholder \& Client Engagement
 


* Partner with IT leadership, operations teams, and business stakeholders
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Support pre‑sales activities including solution design, estimations, and proposals



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 ServiceNow Expertise

* Strong expertise in:

 Soft Skills

* Strong problem‑solving and analytical mindset



 Certifications (Preferred / Mandatory)

 Nice to Have

8be0e5a3.title: Engineering Delivery Manager I
8be0e5a3.description:
**Delivery Manager**


Job Description \| Product Engineering Organization


**Overview**
------------


As a Delivery Manager, you hold program\-level execution accountable on a day\-to\-day basis within Deloitte's Product Engineering organization, one or more product teams operating against a shared set of intents.


Delivery in this organization operates inside an intent\-driven development model with three concurrent layers — governance, execution, and learning — that run simultaneously. Execution advances in evidence\-gated dashes, not sprints.


The activities that used to define this role — status compilation, schedule maintenance, risk\-log upkeep, and ceremony documentation — are increasingly AI\-assisted. What remains, and grows, is the judgment work: cross\-team coordination on initiatives larger than a single product team can self\-coordinate, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and the operational discipline that keeps evidence\-gated delivery.


**What You Will Own**
---------------------


* Program\-level coordination for one significant initiative or a set of related programs. Ensure dashes start when slices are ready and end when deployed evidence confirms the intended behavior shifted.
* Day\-to\-day stakeholder orchestration with internal Deloitte stakeholders at the program level, including reconciliation of AI\-drafted artifacts when stakeholders arrive with their own briefs.
* Drive cost\-efficient adoption of LLM, agentic AI, and cloud platforms through effective governance, FinOps practices, and consumption optimization.
* Operational integrity of the evidence\-gated cycle in your scope: proof signals being read, harm watches honored and exit gates respected before slices expand.


**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------


* **Outcome\-Driven Leadership:** Deliver the right customer and business outcomes by engaging product teams on structure, skills, leverage models, and measurement. Scope dashes against ready slices and observable evidence, so work advances when deployed evidence confirms the behavior shifted — not at a sprint boundary.
* **Delivery Leadership and Advocacy:** Champion fit\-for\-context delivery methodologies and work with Product Managers to drive priorities and execution. Form skilled teams, remove roadblocks, and set cadence to the rhythm the program needs. Surface coordination friction before it becomes a blocker, escalating to the Delivery Leader when it exceeds your authority.
* **Craft Mastery:** Foster delivery excellence through quality processes, program value delivery, and team growth — coaching junior professionals via pairing, observation, and feedback. Experiment with new tools like GenAI and support the AI Workflow Orchestrator on your program, knowing which workflows are AI\-driven and how exceptions route. Spread knowledge through community sessions.
* **Communication:** Inspire and influence stakeholders, serving as the contact for value achievement across product engineering teams. Communicate status accurately on the cadence the program needs. Hold the room when stakeholders disagree: surface trade\-offs, recommend a path, drive to decision. Facilitate co\-creation workshops.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work as a connected member of the program alongside the triad ensemble (Product, Engineering and Experience) and cross functional groups. Maintain a live picture of dependencies across the product teams and platform services you touch. Manage conflict, foster collaboration, and enable cross\-skilling.
* **Discovery \& Delivery Proficiency:** Apply deep SDLC expertise with continuous planning and refinement. Watch for drift between intent and execution and raise it early. Hold evidence\-gate discipline — proof signals read, harm watches honored, exits and expansions respected. Identify risks, adapt scope, and embed continuous improvement.
* **Customer\-Centric Delivery:** Drive lean solutions through rapid experimentation, engaging customers before, during, and after delivery to land the right solution effectively.
* **Operational Excellence:** Build inclusive, engaged teams; remove obstacles and coach; improve satisfaction and reduce attrition. Govern the intake of AI\-drafted artifacts so they become productive inputs, not noise. Report on financials, innovation, and engagement, and drive efficiency and productivity.
* **Engagement and Collaborative Co\-Creation:** Engage stakeholders at all levels and foster a culture of co\-creation. Hold the relationship with program sponsors and affected stakeholders, informing them in proportion to their stake, and reconcile conflicting AI\-generated artifacts on the same initiative. Align diverse perspectives to deliver quality solutions.
* **Domain Expertise:** Rapidly acquire domain\-specific knowledge and navigate enterprise functions to drive product value and organizational alignment.


**The Team**
------------


US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value and outcomes. It leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure across a four\-capability matrix: Product, Experience, Engineering, and Delivery. As Deloitte's primary product development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market.


**Qualifications**
------------------


### **Required Experience**

* 10\+ years of delivery management with direct experience leading a cross\-functional program or set of programs with meaningful dependencies and multiple stakeholders.
* Experience operating inside an Agile or Lean model and demonstrated readiness to operate inside intent\-driven, evidence\-gated delivery patterns.
* Experience working in a product\-staffed model where durable product teams stay with their products across build, deploy, operate, and evolve.
* Strong expertise in AI/Cloud FinOps, budget management, financial forecasting, vendor management, cost optimization, and data\-driven delivery governance.

### **Required Skills**

* Coordination at scale: Track record of managing dependencies, surfacing risks, and driving alignment across teams that do not naturally talk to each other.
* Engineering fluency: Able to follow technical conversations, ask useful questions, and challenge feasibility claims constructively. More than passive listening.
* Evidence orientation: Comfortable measuring delivery by outcome validation rather than velocity proxies. Able to hold the line on evidence gates.
* AI\-augmented working practice: Fluent with current GenAI assistants and agentic delivery tooling. Able to direct AI output for status, risk, and coordination tasks rather than only consume or produce it manually.
* Specification literacy: Able to read and reason about charter, persona, intent, constitution, and blueprint artifacts and understand how a program is governed through them.
* Communication: Writes clearly. Presents to senior stakeholders without over formatting. Tells the truth about status, including bad news, without varnish.


**How You Will Grow**
---------------------


At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities— including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team\-based learning, and eLearning.

**\#pxe**

  

**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**

Opening for Software Program Manager, Ahmedabad
 



 Urban Management Centre is looking for a passionate and driven professional to join us as Software Program Manager –based in Ahmedabad. In this role, you will work closely with the Management team to help turn policy into meaningful impact. If you believe in strengthening public systems, enjoy solving real urban challenges with committed teams, and are excited about working with government stakeholders to create change that matters—this role is for you. You will lead program implementation and support ongoing work across cities.
 



 About Urban Management Centre
 



 Urban Management Centre (UMC) is a mission\-driven non\-profit working to make Indian cities more inclusive, resilient, and well\-managed. For over 25 years, we have partnered with governments, communities, and sector experts to strengthen urban systems and improve the everyday lives of citizens.
 



 Our team of 60\+ professionals—spanning urban planning, public health, technology, finance, social development, design, and governance works hands\-on with National, State \& City government across India to solve real problems. From improving sanitation and water systems, enabling heritage conservation, and driving climate action, to enhancing public health, municipal finance, and community engagement, we bring practical solutions backed by research, innovation, and field experience.
 



 At our core, we believe cities thrive when people do and we are committed to building urban environments that offer dignity, safety, equitable access, and opportunity for all.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution and delivery of multiple software projects.
 



  Guide and mentor development teams and provide technical direction on architecture, implementation and engineering practices.
 



  Review technical solutions, project estimates, dependencies, risks and delivery plans.
 



  Manage development, testing, staging and production environments across on\- premise and cloud infrastructure.
 



  Oversee CI/CD, release management and deployment processes using GitHub, Jenkins and related automation.
 



  Coordinate application, database, infrastructure and DevOps teams for production deployments and issue resolution.
 



  Establish and monitor backup, Disaster Recovery, business continuity and restoration processes.
 



  Ensure appropriate technical documentation, coding/development standards, testing and production\-readiness practices.
 



  Manage projects using a hybrid Agile \+ Waterfall delivery approach.
 



  Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders and provide clear technical and management\-level reporting.
 



  Identify technical, operational and delivery risks proactively and drive them to resolution.
 



 Technology Environment
 



 The candidate should have substantial practical understanding of the following:
 



 Backend: PHP, Laravel, Python, Django Frontend: Django Templates, Laravel Blade Templates, React, Next.js, Angular Mobile: Flutter Databases: MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL Infrastructure: Ubuntu/Linux, Nginx, server architecture, Google Cloud DevOps: Git, GitHub, Jenkins, CI/CD, Bash/Shell scripting Data: ETL pipelines, data migration and system integration DR \& Operations: Backup, Rsync, disaster recovery, monitoring and production operations
 



 Our existing systems predominantly use Laravel \+ MySQL, while newer platforms are built around Django, Next.js, PostgreSQL and Flutter.
 



 Preferred Experience
 



  Experience managing multiple software products or technical programs.
 



  Strong hands\-on software engineering background combined with program/project management experience.
 



  Experience managing hybrid on\- premise \+ cloud environments.
 



  Experience with production systems, CI/CD and Disaster Recovery.
 



  Experience with Government / PSU / Municipal / Public Sector technology projects.
 



  Working knowledge of NIC infrastructure and government data systems will be an advantage.
 



 Qualifications
 



  Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or related field.
 



  10\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, technical project/program management or engineering leadership.
 



  Strong communication, problem\-solving, planning and team\-management skills.
 



 Urban Management Centre is an equal opportunity employer, and we strongly encourage individuals from diverse backgrounds and lived experiences to apply.
 



 If this role resonates with you, please send your application to jobs@umcasia.org, with a copy to shiva@umcasia.org, using the subject line: “Application –Software Program Manager”. Please include the following:
 



  Updated CV
 



  Cover letter describing your suitability for the position
 



  Proof of last drawn remuneration (any one of the following: last 3 months’ salary slips, bank statements showing salary deposits for the last 3 months, employment letter, or contract document)
 



  Contact details of three recent professional references who can speak to your experience and strengths.

6bbbc78c.title: Program Manager in EDA
6bbbc78c.description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
   

  

 Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
   

  

**Program Manager in EDA**
**The Role**
 As the Program Manager, you will have the opportunity to manage End\-to\-End ownership of overall solutions for innovative products. Solid program management of various software development teams, monitoring the quality of the resulting software deliverables and a strong partnership with the customer support teams are the key focus area of this role.
   

  

**The Person**
 The right candidate will have solid knowledge of program management, impeccable track record of delivering complex software programs, and experience with Device Drivers, Firmware, Graphics technology, SOC product development and customer facing experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Plan and execute programs focusing on quality and deadlines
* Drives completion of all required deliverables, with a focus on customer quality feedback and established deadlines
* Creates and maintains project management artifacts such as schedule, resource and resource forecast, risk and issues logs
* Cross\-Geography coordination to ensure all stakholders are aligned
* Chip Life\-cycle tracking all the way from planning to prototype to execution to production release
* Provides unique views of project status updates and facilitates cross development team dependencies and communications
* Identify action or mitigation plans for issues or risks that arise during the project lifecycle
* Collaborates with core teams and execution teams to identify areas that require special attention or escalations to identify corrective actions
* Collect, analyze, organize and publish work performance data via dashboards and recurring status reports
* Strong self\-motivator, with a sense of urgency when needed and strong crisis management skills


**Preferred Experience**
* Proven Project \& Program Management experience in dynamic and competitive industry, particularly within Software Development or Engineering based organizations
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Chip Life Cycle Tracking in rollout of devices in a Software Organization with relevant EDA industry experience is preferred
* Proven Cross\-Geography Coordination experience
* Horizontal leadership/Matrix management experience is required, People management is desirable
* Flexible working schedule to manage global program execution team (Asia and North America emphasis)
* PMP certification is required
* Agile development or certification is a bonus


**Academic Credentials**
* 8\+ Years of Program Management Experience in EDA or related compaines
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering is desired


*Benefits offered are described:* 
 AMD benefits at a glance.
   

  

*AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.*

deb50bd6.description:
Tezo is a new generation Digital \& AI solutions provider, with a history of creating remarkable outcomes for our customers. We bring exceptional experiences using cutting\-edge analytics, data proficiency, technology, and digital excellence. **Roles and Responsibilities**  

* Strong Data Consultant / Data Architect with experience in assessing and transforming complex data landscapes and enterprise data environments.
* Analyze existing data systems, applications, data flows, workflows, integrations, and reporting processes to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Define current\-state and target\-state data architecture, including data platforms, models, integrations, governance, and security.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, practical data architecture and technical solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with SQL, data modelling, ETL/ELT, APIs, cloud data platforms, and modern data technologies.

* Develop prototypes/POCs and provide technical guidance to development and implementation teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to bridge business needs and technical execution.

36416c86.title: Presales Consultant
36416c86.description:
Job Summary
 



 The Presales Consultant is responsible for understanding customer business requirements, positioning Warehouse Management System (WMS) and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions, preparing solution proposals, conducting product demonstrations, supporting RFP/RFQ responses, and assisting the sales team throughout the sales lifecycle.
 



 The role requires strong knowledge of warehouse operations, manufacturing processes, supply chain digitization, barcode/RFID technologies, and software solution architecture. The consultant acts as the technical and functional advisor to customers while ensuring that proposed solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.
 



  





 Required Skills
 


* 5–10 years in Presales, Solution Consulting, or Business Consulting.
* Experience with enterprise software solutions in Manufacturing or Supply Chain.
* Hands\-on exposure to WMS, MES, ERP integration, or Industrial Automation projects.
* Experience in customer\-facing consulting and solution presentations.
* Must be well versed with tools like Vision, Power point, Word, Excel, CRM.
* Exposure to Business Analytics will be added advantage.
* Candidates with ERP Integration and understanding of ERP system will be preferred.
* Hands on experience in optimization / managing manufacturing operations involving of machine Integration, Manpower optimization, material management \& process efficiencies.
* In depth knowledge of manufacturing operations, understanding of KPI’s, process optimization, best practices, processes, time \& motion study, quality and manpower.
* Must have analytical skills to apply knowledge in process management and optimization
* Analyzing business systems and best practices to do the gap analysis \& identify improvement opportunities and to determine required process re\-engineering.

3b7e1dd6.title: Lead - Solution Engineer
3b7e1dd6.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us***



**Job Description**

 Freshservice is expanding what “AI\-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.
   

  





 This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands\-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post\-sale. You'll be the AI subject\-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.
   

  





 You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.
   

  





**What You'll Do**



* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs\-of\-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent\-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal\-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof\-of\-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de\-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business\-case models that the wider SE team can self\-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one\-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go\-to expert.


**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**



* 8\+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands\-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM\-based solutions in a customer\-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG\-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production\-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one\-size\-fits\-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof\-of\-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX\-leader audience or down to a hands\-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.



**Nice to Have**



* Prior experience with Freddy AI, Agent Studio, or Freshworks products specifically.
* Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42\) and how it feeds AI\-driven automation.
* Exposure to AI governance conversations (data residency, model risk, responsible AI) in regulated industries.
* A builder's instinct — you'd rather stand up a working demo than a slide.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

ec622c3b.description:
**Position:** 
 Presales Engineer – IIoT and Industrial Automation Solutions
 



**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



**Role Overview:** 




 The Presales Engineer will support the sales and solutions team by providing strong technical expertise in IIoT, automation, and industrial systems. The role involves working closely with clients to understand their processes and pain points, conducting requirement analysis, designing suitable solutions, and ensuring technical clarity throughout the sales cycle. The individual will also contribute to project execution planning, documentation, vendor coordination, and continuous process improvement.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Technical Expertise** 



* Strong understanding of IIoT hardware components: sensors, transmitters, gateways, RTUs, Remote I/Os, and industrial controllers.
* Knowledge of industrial automation systems: PLCs, SCADA, Drives, Control Panels, Power Panels and basic programming exposure.
* Hands\-on understanding of digital/analog signals and process instrumentation (flow, pressure, temperature, level, etc.).
* Expertise in industrial and IoT communication protocols: Modbus, CAN, OPC\-UA, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, MQTT, CoAP, HTTP/REST, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi, BLE, Zigbee, Cellular networks.
* Understanding of IoT gateways, protocol converters, edge computing hardware (Raspberry Pi, Jetson, OpenWRT), and basic edge analytics/edge AI concepts.
* Knowledge of internal IoT product offerings.



**2\. Solution Design \& Sales Support** 



* Conduct end\-to\-end requirement study, process analysis, and identify pain points, bottlenecks, and measurable KPIs.
* Identify required data points/signals and evaluate feasibility of data collection.
* Design complete IIoT/industrial automation architectures tailored to client needs.
* Hardware selection with multiple OEM options; prepare SRS and solution blueprints.
* Develop PoCs, prototypes, and field trials in coordination with R\&D.
* Prepare proposals including problem statement, solution approach, BOM, costing, ROI, and implementation roadmap.
* Manage RFP submissions with accurate technical documentation.



**3\. Customer Engagement \& Relationship Management** 



* Engage with clients to understand challenges, process gaps, and objectives.
* Present solutions, conduct demos, and explain technical value clearly and effectively.
* Follow up on presales discussions to support business closures.
* Maintain long\-term client relationships and ensure satisfaction during and after deployment.



**4\. Vendor Coordination \& Partnership Development** 



* Coordinate with OEMs, technology partners, and vendors for solution components.
* Evaluate and identify suitable vendors/OEM partners for hardware/software integration.
* Maintain healthy vendor relationships to ensure seamless coordination during solution delivery.



**5\. Collaboration \& Process Improvement** 



* Work with R\&D/Product teams for product customization, improvements, and resolving technical gaps.
* Maintain structured technical documentation: case studies, manuals, system diagrams, and process flows.
* Provide inputs for marketing content, whitepapers, and technical collateral.
* Follow internal SOPs, maintain project logs, and ensure documentation accuracy.
* Participate in internal training, knowledge sharing, and contribute to innovation initiatives.



**6\. Project Rollout Support \& Value Creation** 



* Support creation of project execution plans, timelines, and resource allocation.
* Assist in on\-site installation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and validation activities when required.
* Assist in user training \& handover and provide post\-rollout support for AMC/SLA commitments.
* Demonstrate value creation through data\-driven insights and reports.



**Desired Candidate Profile** 



* **Qualification:** 
 B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical, or related field.
* **Experience:** 
 3–5 years in presales, solution design, IIoT projects, automation, or technical consulting.



**Skills:** 



* Strong understanding of IIoT, sensors, gateways, industrial protocols, and automation systems.
* Ability to create strong technical documentation, proposals, and presentations.
* Good analytical skills for requirement study and solution design.
* Strong communication and customer\-facing skills.
* Basic programming knowledge (Python/C/C\+\+), cloud IoT platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and database basics is an added advantage.

SailPoint makes it possible to automate and streamline the identity journey. We marry technical expertise with business acumen to deliver identity security that will drive business forward.

 SailPoint is looking for a talented, collaborative, determined, and motivated Senior Solution Engineer to join the India team. You will be a team member of SailPoint’s presales organisation working with our sales teams to support direct and indirect sales efforts, as well as work with our partners and
 
 customers.  Your
 
 thorough understanding of Identity, Governance, User Administration, Access Management and Cyber Security, coupled with your excellent communication skills will enable you to effectively articulate the value of SailPoint solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences.  Expertise in discovering customer requirements, aligning SailPoint solutions to address identity challenges and demonstrating product capabilities is essential to success in this role.
   

  





**The Path to Success**





 Becoming a successful Solution Engineer at SailPoint can be as simple as achieving 3 key milestones in 3 months – know SailPoint, know the platform, and demo the platform \- with some key steps in between. 
   

  







 Within the first month your goals will include:
 



* Complete Getting started Checklist, including Pre/Post Revenue Onboarding Coursework, attending HR onboarding Sessions, access Identity University, and complete role specific suggested courses.

 Leadership. (Schedule

* Listen in and shadow discovery calls, presentations, demos as much as you can
* Familiarise yourself with key administrative tasks and important metrics




 Within 3 months at SailPoint you will have: 
 



* Completed all assigned training to become ‘field ready’
* Present SailPoint, platform and demo to your manager
* Continued to have periodic meetings with your buddy
* Have regular scheduled meetings with your partnering Account Executives, Digital Sales, Customer Success and Delivery Services Team.
* Ready to execute as Lead Solution Engineer
* Know the RFx response process, tools and lead your first RFx response




 By the end of your first 12 months at SailPoint you will have:
 



* Completed your platform training and attained product certification
* Build and maintain a value driven, outcome base narrative
* Confidently engage with senior execs and articulate the business values of identity security
* Led the technical aspects of opportunities alongside your partnering Account Executives from discovery, to presentation, to demo, to evaluation and to close
* Contribute to customer success stories, white papers, blogs and social media posts that show our expertise in the Identity Security Market.
* Actively participate in internal meetings, knowledge sharing sessions and enablement
* Mentor and coach new sales and presales team members on SailPoint solution
* Be the Solution Engineering rock star you were born to be



**Requirements:**



* 5\+ years professional experience as a pre\-sales technical resource in an enterprise software company
* 3\+ years working with Identity, Governance and Access Management solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
* A working knowledge of technical infrastructure including application servers, databases, virtualization and directories is required.
* Familiarity with Java, XML, LDAP, SQL is desirable.
* Understanding of Cloud platforms like Azure, Google and AWS is desirable.
* Ensure proposed deals include technical solutions that accurately address customer needs, and appropriately supported by key customer technical decision\-makers.
* Lead and engage in technical conversations with customers.
* Work with Product team to improve roadmap based on technical experience with customers.
* Understand and ability to explain Identity Security processes, deployment models \& best practices.



**Location:**



* The role is based in Bangalore, India.
* Travel is expected.



 SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  
   

  





 Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

a5cb19d8.title: CyberSecurity Architect - IAM
a5cb19d8.description:
Job Summary
  
Drive the design and implementation of scalable identity and access management solutions in a hybrid work environment focusing on automation driven security controls for large enterprise systems. Collaborate with cross functional teams to strengthen cyber resilience ensure regulatory compliance and safeguard critical assets through modern IAM architectures and streamlined processes.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design and architect end to end identity and access management solutions that align with enterprise security strategies while supporting business agility and operational continuity in a hybrid work environment.
  
Lead the development of IAM reference architectures and standards for authentication authorization and identity lifecycle management to ensure consistent adoption across complex application and infrastructure landscapes.
  
Develop and optimize automation driven workflows for account provisioning deprovisioning and access reviews to reduce manual effort minimize errors and improve security posture for all user types.
  
Collaborate with application owners infrastructure teams and security operations to integrate IAM capabilities including single sign on and multifactor authentication into existing and new platforms in a seamless manner.
  
Define and implement role based and attribute based access models that accurately map to business functions thereby reducing excessive privileges and strengthening least privilege enforcement.
  
Evaluate and select IAM products and automation tools by conducting technical assessments proof of concepts and integration feasibility analysis to ensure scalability reliability and regulatory alignment.
  
Establish policies and processes for periodic access certification and segregation of duties checks using automated controls to detect and remediate risky access conditions in a timely way.
  
Create detailed solution design documents and technical guidelines that clearly describe integration patterns data flows security controls and operational procedures for IAM implementations.
  
Provide advanced technical guidance to engineering and operations teams on troubleshooting complex IAM issues ensuring timely resolution of incidents and continuous improvement of stability and performance.
  
Monitor and analyze security events and IAM metrics to identify anomalies policy violations and optimization opportunities and then implement targeted enhancements through automation and configuration tuning.
  
Engage with governance risk and compliance stakeholders to map IAM controls to regulatory and industry frameworks and demonstrate control effectiveness through evidence and reporting.
  
Coordinate with project and product teams to embed IAM requirements early in solution design life cycles ensuring that identity security risks are addressed before deployment and change activities.
  
Drive awareness of secure access practices across the organization by preparing technical runbooks reusable automation patterns and clear communication artifacts that promote standardized adoption.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Possess extensive hands on experience in architecting and implementing enterprise grade IAM solutions over at least twelve years with deep exposure to complex hybrid and cloud integrated environments.
  
Demonstrate strong proficiency in automation of IAM processes including workflow orchestration scripting and integration with IT service management and human resource systems for lifecycle events.
  
Show advanced understanding of authentication and authorization standards such as SAML OAuth and OpenID Connect implemented through secure and reliable integration with diverse applications and platforms.
  
Exhibit solid capability in designing and enforcing role based and attribute based access control models including definition of entitlements policies and guardrails that support business operations securely.
  
Apply in depth knowledge of identity governance concepts covering access certification segregation of duties and policy based remediation using modern tools and automated controls.
  
Display familiarity with hybrid work models and modern collaboration platforms ensuring IAM architectures support secure remote access without compromising user experience or system performance.
  
Demonstrate strong analytical and communication skills that enable effective collaboration with security engineering operations and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical IAM solutions.
  
  

Certifications Required
  
Certified Information Systems Security Professional and Certified Identity and Access Manager or equivalent IAM certification.

**Level** 
 : Lead Business Transformation Architect
   

  

 As a Lead Business Transformation Architect/ Specialist Master at Deloitte Consulting, you will drive the design, implementation, and delivery of cutting\-edge artificial intelligence solutions for our clients. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and exceptional client management skills. You will serve as a bridge between complex technical implementations and business objectives, leading development teams while effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 We are looking for a seasoned Five9 CCaaS Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise\-grade cloud contact center solutions built on the Five9 Intelligent CX Platform. This is a senior technical role that sits at the intersection of solution architecture, AI\-driven automation, and client advisory — equal parts strategist and builder.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on Five9 expertise, a strong grasp of modern CCaaS architecture patterns, and the communication fluency to translate complex technical decisions into clear business value for clients and stakeholders.
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead end\-to\-end CCaaS solution design — from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment, and rollout. Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure, and high\-performing Five9 architectures that align with client goals and industry best practices.

Implement identity and authentication frameworks including SSO, SAML, and OAuth.

Provide architectural guidance on deploying responsible, hallucination\-aware AI within the contact center environment. 9 10 Stay ahead of Five9's evolving Agentic CX roadmap and help clients position for next\-generation capabilities.

b247d0ac.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------


Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award\-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting\-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people\-first culture.


With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end\-to\-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile \& Digital Marketing \| Enterprise AI \| Customer Care AI \& Technology \| Enterprise Technology Modernization


From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in\-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi\-billion\-dollar parent company.

**Location \& Flexibility**
---------------------------

**India Hybrid: Noida, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram**
-------------------------------------------------------


This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Noida/Bengaluru (1 to 2 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in\-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


TELUS Digital is seeking an experienced SAP Technical lead to join our team. As an SAP Technical Lead , you will be responsible for performing SAP technical administration, monitoring, troubleshooting integration issues, controlling transport movements, overseeing quarterly technical upgrades, and overseeing identity and access management activities. You will leverage your strong skills in SAP Public Cloud, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), and deep technical knowledge to diagnose and resolve technical issues in the SAP system and integrated third\-party systems such as Salesforce, Replicon, and SAP SuccessFactors.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Perform SAP technical administration tasks, including system configuration, monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot integration issues between SAP and third\-party systems, such as Salesforce, Replicon, and SAP SuccessFactors.
* Monitor system interfaces and integration points, ensuring smooth data flow and resolving any data inconsistencies or errors.
* Control transport movements, including transporting SAP objects across different system landscapes and ensuring proper release management processes.
* Lead technical upgrades, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to plan and execute the upgrade activities.
* Perform system maintenance tasks, such as applying SAP notes, implementing support packs, and maintaining system documentation.
* Design and implement security measures, including role\-based access controls and user authorization setup.
* Collaborate with functional consultants and business stakeholders to understand technical requirements and propose appropriate solutions.
* Provide technical expertise and guidance to the project team, ensuring adherence to best practices and standards.
* Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues in the SAP system and integrated third\-party systems, using your deep technical knowledge in SAP Public Cloud and SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI).
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, integration setup, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest SAP technologies and advancements, identifying opportunities for system optimization and improvement.

**Skills**

* 7\+ years of experience as an SAP Technical Consultant or similar role.
* Strong skills in SAP technical administration, including system configuration, monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Deep technical knowledge in SAP Public Cloud and SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI).
* Experience troubleshooting integration issues between SAP and third\-party systems.
* Proven ability to control transport movements and manage release management processes.
* Experience leading technical upgrades and system patching activities.
* Proficient in SAP security and role setup, including role\-based access controls and user authorization.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Experience with integrated third\-party systems such as Salesforce.com, Replicon, and SAP SuccessFactors is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at various levels of the organization.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and deliver high\-quality results.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

**Role Description**
 Role Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a Presales Solution Architect with a strong Service Desk and Onsite Support delivery background to lead solutioning for managed Digital Workplace engagements.
   

  

 This role is designed for a professional who understands the operational mechanics of Service Desk environments and can translate them into commercially sound, experience\-led solutions.
   

  

 The architect will design and articulate scalable operating models across:
   

  

* Global / Regional Service Desk (L1 / L1\.5 / L2\)
* Onsite and Field Support
* Digital Employee Experience (DEX) enablement
* Automation and containment strategies
* ITSM\-led orchestration
* Contact centre integrated support environments


 The individual must be able to develop compelling solution documentation and executive\-grade presentations that clearly articulate value, feasibility, and differentiation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Service Desk \& Onsite Support Solutioning
* Design end\-to\-end Service Desk and Onsite Support operating models.
* Perform ticket analysis and demand modelling (volume, seasonality, channel mix).
* Conduct solution sizing including FTE modelling, skill pyramid design, shift planning, and span of control.
* Align workflows to ITIL v4 practices across Incident, Request, Knowledge, Major Incident, and Change interfaces.
* Define measurable outcomes including MTTR reduction, FCR improvement, digital containment targets, and tickets\-per\-user optimisation.
* Architect DEX\-informed proactive support constructs.
* Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Enablement
* Design solutions leveraging DEX platforms such as:
+ Nexthink
+ Lakeside Software
+ 1E

* Translate DEX telemetry into operational interventions.
* Define proactive remediation, automation triggers, and experience\-led governance.
* Incorporate DEX metrics into SLA/XLA constructs.
* Position DEX as an operational optimisation enabler rather than a tool discussion.
* Contact Centre–Integrated Support


 The candidate is not expected to be a telephony engineer, but must:
   

  

* Understand call routing concepts including IVR, skill\-based routing, and queue prioritisation.
* Understand omni\-channel support models (voice, chat, portal, virtual agent).
* Be familiar with leading platforms such as:
+ Genesys
+ Amazon Connect

* Understand how contact centre platforms integrate with ITSM systems for:
+ Ticket creation
+ Screen pop and contextual routing
+ Call\-to\-ticket linkage
+ Workforce optimisation insights


 The role requires architectural awareness of integration value, not deep platform configuration expertise.
   

  

* Automation \& Containment Strategy
* Define L0 containment strategies including chatbot and guided workflows.
* Align automation roadmap to measurable ticket reduction targets.
* Embed AI\-assisted triage and knowledge\-driven resolution concepts.
* Ensure automation is governed and operationally feasible.
* Presales \& Commercial Structuring
* Lead Service Desk–focused RFP/RFI responses.
* Conduct discovery workshops and requirements gathering sessions.
* Develop detailed solution documents including:
+ Operating model description
+ Governance model
+ Transition approach
+ Commercial construct explanation

* Build executive presentations that clearly link:
+ Client pain points
+ Proposed operating model
+ Business outcomes
+ Financial impact

* Develop pricing constructs including per\-user, per\-ticket, and outcome\-based models.
* Support solution defence and executive Q\&A sessions.
* Delivery Alignment \& Feasibility
* Validate proposed models with delivery leadership.
* Ensure sizing assumptions are realistic and defensible.
* Align SOW and transition plans with solution constructs.
* Support knowledge transfer into delivery teams post\-award.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

**We Are Seeking a Candidate Who**
* Has 8–15 years of experience in IT Services.
* Has strong Service Desk or Workplace Delivery experience prior to moving into presales.
* Understands operational realities including shift coverage, peak demand, and skill\-based routing.
* Is comfortable sizing and structuring managed service deals.
* Can independently author high\-quality solution documentation.
* Can create structured, executive\-ready presentations without heavy supervision.


 Technical \& Functional Competencies
   

  

* Strong understanding of:
+ ITIL v4 practices
+ Managed Service operating models
+ Workforce planning and capacity modelling
+ Knowledge lifecycle governance
+ DEX frameworks and proactive support constructs

* Conceptual understanding of contact centre routing and integration models.
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow preferred).
* Experience integrating automation into Service Desk environments.
* Strong written communication and structured documentation capability.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Executive\-level communication.
* Structured storytelling and business value articulation.
* Analytical and commercially aware.
* Comfortable operating in fast\-paced pursuit environments.
* Balanced operational depth with strategic positioning ability.
