b534119d.title: Engineering Delivery Manager I
b534119d.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Delivery Manager**
 Job Description \| Product Engineering Organization
   

  

**Overview**
 As a Delivery Manager, you hold program\-level execution accountable on a day\-to\-day basis within Deloitte's Product Engineering organization, one or more product teams operating against a shared set of intents.
   

  

 Delivery in this organization operates inside an intent\-driven development model with three concurrent layers — governance, execution, and learning — that run simultaneously. Execution advances in evidence\-gated dashes, not sprints.
   

  

 The activities that used to define this role — status compilation, schedule maintenance, risk\-log upkeep, and ceremony documentation — are increasingly AI\-assisted. What remains, and grows, is the judgment work: cross\-team coordination on initiatives larger than a single product team can self\-coordinate, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and the operational discipline that keeps evidence\-gated delivery.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Program\-level coordination for one significant initiative or a set of related programs. Ensure dashes start when slices are ready and end when deployed evidence confirms the intended behavior shifted.
* Day\-to\-day stakeholder orchestration with internal Deloitte stakeholders at the program level, including reconciliation of AI\-drafted artifacts when stakeholders arrive with their own briefs.
* Drive cost\-efficient adoption of LLM, agentic AI, and cloud platforms through effective governance, FinOps practices, and consumption optimization.
* Operational integrity of the evidence\-gated cycle in your scope: proof signals being read, harm watches honored and exit gates respected before slices expand.


**Core Responsibilities**
* Outcome\-Driven Leadership: Deliver the right customer and business outcomes by engaging product teams on structure, skills, leverage models, and measurement. Scope dashes against ready slices and observable evidence, so work advances when deployed evidence confirms the behavior shifted — not at a sprint boundary.
* Delivery Leadership and Advocacy: Champion fit\-for\-context delivery methodologies and work with Product Managers to drive priorities and execution. Form skilled teams, remove roadblocks, and set cadence to the rhythm the program needs. Surface coordination friction before it becomes a blocker, escalating to the Delivery Leader when it exceeds your authority.
* Craft Mastery: Foster delivery excellence through quality processes, program value delivery, and team growth — coaching junior professionals via pairing, observation, and feedback. Experiment with new tools like GenAI and support the AI Workflow Orchestrator on your program, knowing which workflows are AI\-driven and how exceptions route. Spread knowledge through community sessions.
* Communication: Inspire and influence stakeholders, serving as the contact for value achievement across product engineering teams. Communicate status accurately on the cadence the program needs. Hold the room when stakeholders disagree: surface trade\-offs, recommend a path, drive to decision. Facilitate co\-creation workshops.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work as a connected member of the program alongside the triad ensemble (Product, Engineering and Experience) and cross functional groups. Maintain a live picture of dependencies across the product teams and platform services you touch. Manage conflict, foster collaboration, and enable cross\-skilling.
* Discovery \& Delivery Proficiency: Apply deep SDLC expertise with continuous planning and refinement. Watch for drift between intent and execution and raise it early. Hold evidence\-gate discipline — proof signals read, harm watches honored, exits and expansions respected. Identify risks, adapt scope, and embed continuous improvement.
* Customer\-Centric Delivery: Drive lean solutions through rapid experimentation, engaging customers before, during, and after delivery to land the right solution effectively.
* Operational Excellence: Build inclusive, engaged teams; remove obstacles and coach; improve satisfaction and reduce attrition. Govern the intake of AI\-drafted artifacts so they become productive inputs, not noise. Report on financials, innovation, and engagement, and drive efficiency and productivity.
* Engagement and Collaborative Co\-Creation: Engage stakeholders at all levels and foster a culture of co\-creation. Hold the relationship with program sponsors and affected stakeholders, informing them in proportion to their stake, and reconcile conflicting AI\-generated artifacts on the same initiative. Align diverse perspectives to deliver quality solutions.
* Domain Expertise: Rapidly acquire domain\-specific knowledge and navigate enterprise functions to drive product value and organizational alignment.


**The Team**
 US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value and outcomes. It leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure across a four\-capability matrix: Product, Experience, Engineering, and Delivery. As Deloitte's primary product development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years of delivery management with direct experience leading a cross\-functional program or set of programs with meaningful dependencies and multiple stakeholders.
* Experience operating inside an Agile or Lean model and demonstrated readiness to operate inside intent\-driven, evidence\-gated delivery patterns.
* Experience working in a product\-staffed model where durable product teams stay with their products across build, deploy, operate, and evolve.
* Strong expertise in AI/Cloud FinOps, budget management, financial forecasting, vendor management, cost optimization, and data\-driven delivery governance.


**Required Skills**

da69e61f.title: Lead - Solution Engineer
da69e61f.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us***



**Job Description**

 Freshservice is expanding what “AI\-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.
   

  





 This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands\-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post\-sale. You'll be the AI subject\-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.
   

  





 You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.
   

  





**What You'll Do**



* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs\-of\-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent\-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal\-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof\-of\-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de\-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business\-case models that the wider SE team can self\-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one\-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go\-to expert.


**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**



* 8\+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands\-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM\-based solutions in a customer\-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG\-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production\-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one\-size\-fits\-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof\-of\-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX\-leader audience or down to a hands\-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.



**Nice to Have**



* Prior experience with Freddy AI, Agent Studio, or Freshworks products specifically.
* Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42\) and how it feeds AI\-driven automation.
* Exposure to AI governance conversations (data residency, model risk, responsible AI) in regulated industries.
* A builder's instinct — you'd rather stand up a working demo than a slide.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

7d881d35.description:
Cvent is an exciting, fast\-growing tech company that provides industry\-leading software to event professionals around the world. Our suite of services \- online event registration, venue selection, mobile apps, email marketing, web surveys, and targeted hotel advertising opportunities \- have positioned us a major player in the global meetings and events industry.
   

  

 One of our product offerings is iCapture. iCapture by Cvent allows organizations to capture and qualify conversations on the show floor, so Marketing can serve up sales\-ready leads to their team to action on and turn into revenue
   

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

**Disclaimer**
**Recruitment Scam Notice:** 
 Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email addresses. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.
   

  

 If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.
   

  

 For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Live Solutions Specialists serve as our clients’ primary point of contact while they are using Cvent’s software. In this role, you will be responsible for exercising an expert\-level of product knowledge to ensure our clients are able to realize the full benefits of Cvent’s software. Solutions Specialists spend 70 percent of the day assisting clients on the phone or via email, in addition to other special products and daily activities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have a passion for technology, creative thinking, and problem solving. They should be extremely motivated with excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, agile, fun work environment. As a Live Solutions Specialist, they will join a team of service delivery professionals committed to helping customers achieve the highest level of success. Solutions Specialists have an exemplary mastery of the Cvent Event Solutions platform and demonstrate product expertise by implementing, training, consulting, and troubleshooting customer needs.
   

  

* Onboard new iCapture clients through training, implementing their accounts and understanding their needs
* Demonstrate deep product knowledge and understanding of the mentioned solutions when assisting customers on scheduled phone calls
* Collaborate with team members to discuss the unique needs of customers internally in order to best facilitate calls and make recommendations
* Gather customer requests for future releases of the product and collaborate with the technology team on requirements
* Collaborate with content team to develop and enhance knowledge base articles, learning paths and customer\-facing documentation
* Participation in stretch responsibilities geared towards business improvements like, mentoring the newest members of the Solution Specialist team during the training process
* Demonstrate detailed product knowledge when assisting clients both on the phone and via email
* Collaborate with the sales team to introduce new features and opportunities to clients
* Experience required \- 2 to 5 years
* Bachelor’s degree with strong academic credentials preferred
* Strong business acumen, ethics and high integrity
* Comfort working with technical products, platforms, and tools to configure solutions that meet customer needs
* Passionate about customer success with a commitment to delivering exceptional service
* Should be extremely motivated with excellent communication skills (verbal and written) and possess the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, fun work environment
* Ability to collaborate with customers to identify their requirements and design tailored solutions
* A proactive attitude toward staying up\-to\-date on industry trends, technologies, and best practices
* Must be articulate, organized, detail\-oriented, and can multi\-task in a dynamic, fast\-changing entrepreneurial environment
* Strong interpersonal skills to build lasting relationships with customers and internal stakeholders
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple customer accounts simultaneously

**Cloud Engineer \- (Job Location \- Hyderabad)**
-------------------------------------------------


Johnson Controls is a global organization helping build smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will support cloud platforms and infrastructure that help teams deliver reliable, secure, and efficient technology services.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


We are looking for a Cloud Engineer with 6\+ years of experience to design, implement, support, and improve cloud infrastructure across modern environments. You will work closely with engineering, security, and operations teams to build scalable solutions, strengthen reliability, and automate day\-to\-day cloud operations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, implement, and support scalable cloud infrastructure solutions that meet business and technical requirements.
* Manage cloud\-based applications and infrastructure with a focus on availability, performance, security, and cost effectiveness.
* Build and maintain automation for deployment, configuration, and routine operational tasks.
* Monitor cloud environments, investigate issues, and support troubleshooting to restore services quickly.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure and efficient cloud services aligned with company policies and standards.
* Evaluate cloud technologies and recommend improvements that enhance reliability, operational efficiency, and maintainability.
* Document solutions, changes, and operational practices clearly for ongoing support and knowledge sharing.
* Support continuous improvement efforts across cloud operations, tooling, and engineering practices.

----------------------

* Own your work with accountability, attention to security, and a strong focus on dependable outcomes.
* Stay close to production needs, remove blockers quickly, and keep the customer impact in mind.
* Use automation and scripting to reduce manual effort and improve consistency across cloud operations.
* Apply clear, candid problem\-solving and look for ways to improve every day.
* Collaborate across development, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver solutions as one team.
* Use monitoring and troubleshooting practices to identify issues early and maintain high service quality.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, cloud infrastructure, or a closely related technical role.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong proficiency in automation tools and scripting languages.
* Experience supporting scalable cloud\-based applications and infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of cloud security, compliance, and access control practices.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional technical teams.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Experience with observability or monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog, AWS CloudWatch, or Azure Monitor.
* Technical leadership or mentoring experience.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure delivery workflows.

**Why Join Us**
---------------


At Johnson Controls, you will contribute to technology work that supports meaningful outcomes for customers and the business. You will join a collaborative environment where reliability, innovation, and continuous improvement matter, and where your cloud expertise can help shape smarter and more sustainable operations.


If this sounds like the right next step for you, we encourage you to apply.

Dyson Global IT

  

  

At Dyson, we demand the highest standard of performance from the technologies we engineer. Our people expect the same from the technology that supports them. We are a community that appreciates and advocates better engineering. A community of pioneers.

  

  

Dyson IT are mid\-transformation. Our aim, to create robust IT architecture, to manage data effectively and efficiently and continue to grow our world\-class team. A team who is strategic, enabling business acceleration, growth and success.

  

Workplace Platform team

  

The Workplace Platform Team act as a key technology partner for Microsoft 365 collaboration capabilities, productivity platforms, governance, adoption and secure digital solutions across the organisation:

* Lead and support Microsoft 365 collaboration, productivity, automation and employee experience use cases.

The Role

  

Reporting to the Head of IT \- Workplace, you will provide hands\-on architecture leadership for Microsoft 365 apps and collaboration services. The role will shape the design, governance, integration, adoption and support model for Microsoft 365 capabilities used across business productivity and digital collaboration services.


The successful candidate will be a senior technical specialist who can work with business stakeholders, architects, engineers and service teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable and supportable Microsoft 365 solutions. The role requires strong depth across Microsoft 365 apps, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Power Platform, Copilot/Copilot Studio, Purview, Defender and Entra ID.

  



About you

* 12\+ years of experience across Microsoft 365, digital workplace, collaboration platforms, application architecture or enterprise IT solutions.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online and Microsoft 365 administration, Power Platform Admin Centre concepts.
* Experience designing Power Platform solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Dataverse, including environment strategy and DLP governance.
* Good understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, knowledge grounding, permissions implications and AI governance considerations.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Purview, information protection, sensitivity labels, retention, audit, eDiscovery and data loss prevention controls.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, identity and access management, conditional access, MFA, app registrations and service principal governance.
* Ability to design secure, scalable and supportable solutions, documenting HLD/LLD, operational runbooks and decision records.
* Strong scripting and automation capability using PowerShell, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams, external vendors, security, architecture, product and application delivery teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.

  



Preferred qualifications / certifications

  



* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert or equivalent Microsoft 365 architecture/administration experience.
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or equivalent Power Platform solution design experience.
* TOGAF, ITIL, Agile delivery or product management certification is beneficial.

  

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

* Strong scripting and automation capability using PowerShell, Exchange Online PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure PowerShell or Azure CLI, with experience automating repeatable operational tasks.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams, external vendors, security, architecture, product and application delivery teams.

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The MC Success Architect is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) within our Marketing Cloud product portfolio. We are looking for a passionate technical expert who has significant experience in delivering Marketing Cloud solutions to large enterprise organizations. Success Architects (SAs) are some of our most senior technical experts who provide proactive and reactive Architecture as well as Product Technical expertise. SAs deliver advisory engagements to help maximize customer success and adoption, as well as minimize attrition risk. 40019895.title: Customer Experience Program Manager, Customer Recovery & Acceleration
40019895.description:
Job Title
   

  

 Customer Experience Program Manager, Customer Recovery \& Acceleration
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Customer Experience (CX) Program Manager is a strategic, customer\-facing leader within the Product Success Organization, responsible for stabilizing, recovering, and accelerating high\-risk or stalled customers.
   

  

 This role operates as a rapid\-response, outcome\-oriented engagement leader, partnering with customers who are blocked in adoption, at risk of churn, or struggling to realize value. The CX Program Manager orchestrates cross\-functional intervention plans to diagnose root causes, align stakeholders, and drive measurable turnaround outcomes.
   

  

 This role focuses on systemic adoption, value realization, and operational recovery. Engagements are structured as approximately 90\-day coordinated recovery cycles, primarily serving High Touch and Upper Growth customers. The position plays a critical role in protecting revenue, improving customer health, and building repeatable recovery playbooks across the customer base.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer Recovery \& Stabilization
   

  

* Lead targeted intervention engagements (approximately 90 days) for high\-risk, stalled, or underperforming customers
* Rapidly assess customer health across product usage, workflows, data quality, and organizational alignment
* Define and execute a structured Customer Recovery Plan with clear milestones and measurable success criteria


 Cross\-Functional Orchestration
   

  

* Mobilize and coordinate the right internal resources based on the customer’s specific recovery needs
* Ensure all teams are aligned to a single recovery strategy, timeline, and accountable owner
* Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain execution momentum across workstreams


 Executive Alignment \& Communication
   

  

* Engage customer executives and senior stakeholders to align on recovery goals, reset accountability, and communicate progress
* Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the duration of the ICU engagement
* Deliver structured updates and executive\-level summaries on a regular cadence


 Playbook Development \& Scaling
   

  

* Build and refine CX playbooks, intervention frameworks, and engagement models
* Partner with Product Success and Insights teams to scale learnings and improve early risk detection
* Contribute to the broader Customer Success strategy through repeatable, data\-backed recovery frameworks


 Data\-Driven Insights
   

  

* Leverage usage data, health scores, and engagement signals to diagnose issues and track recovery progress
* Identify leading indicators of churn risk and recovery success to improve future intervention models
* Validate success outcomes against customer\-defined goals at engagement close


 Cross\-Functional Partnerships
   

  

* Customer Success: Handoff coordination, health monitoring, and post\-ICU continuity
* Functional Experts: Subject matter depth and product best\-practice guidance
* Product \& Engineering: Issue escalation, roadmap alignment, and product gap feedback
* Data \& Analytics / Insights: Usage analysis, health scoring, and performance insights
* Services \& Implementation: Re\-implementation support, configuration guidance, and workflow redesign


 Success Measures
   

  

* Reduction in churn risk and improvement in health scores across ICU\-managed accounts
* Measurable increase in product adoption and depth of usage
* Increased retention confidence and renewal rates
* Scalable recovery playbooks and repeatable intervention patterns


**Qualifications Required**
* 5\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Program Management, Consulting, or Services within SaaS
* Proven ability to turn around at\-risk customer situations and drive measurable outcomes
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills
* Experience working with enterprise or high\-touch customers in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Excellent communication skills with demonstrated executive presence


**Preferred**
* Experience in renewal risk mitigation or churn prevention strategies
* Background in nonprofit, fundraising, or comparable mission\-driven verticals
* Familiarity with change management and adoption frameworks
* Experience leveraging data and product usage insights to drive decision\-making


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Outcome\-obsessed and relentlessly action\-oriented
* Strong problem\-solving and root cause analysis skills
* Ability to influence and lead without direct authority in complex environments
* Ability to simplify complexity into clear, executable plans


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 The ICU Program Manager serves as a critical safeguard for customer success and retention. By stepping in at pivotal moments of risk, this role ensures customers are not lost due to misalignment, stalled adoption, or unrealized value.
   

  

 Through structured recovery, cross\-functional coordination, and relentless focus on outcomes, the ICU Program Manager transforms vulnerable customers into stable, successful, and growing advocates—while strengthening the organization’s overall customer success strategy.
   

  

 This is not a support role. It is not a break/fix function. It is a high\-impact, outcomes\-driven leadership engagement that directly protects revenue, accelerates adoption, and builds the repeatable systems that make every future customer engagement stronger.

 *Intelligence for Good®*

 Deloitte is seeking a Senior Manager/AVP to support complex pursuits and solutioning efforts across technology\-led services. 9e68e160.title: Lead - Solution Engineer
9e68e160.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us***



**Job Description**

 Freshservice is expanding what “AI\-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.
   

  





 This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands\-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post\-sale. You'll be the AI subject\-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.
   

  





 You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.
   

  





**What You'll Do**



* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs\-of\-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent\-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal\-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof\-of\-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de\-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business\-case models that the wider SE team can self\-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one\-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go\-to expert.


**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**



* 8\+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands\-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM\-based solutions in a customer\-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG\-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production\-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one\-size\-fits\-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof\-of\-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX\-leader audience or down to a hands\-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.



**Nice to Have**



* Prior experience with Freddy AI, Agent Studio, or Freshworks products specifically.
* Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42\) and how it feeds AI\-driven automation.
* Exposure to AI governance conversations (data residency, model risk, responsible AI) in regulated industries.
* A builder's instinct — you'd rather stand up a working demo than a slide.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

987f6840.description:
**JOB PURPOSE** 




 \- To own end\-to\-end SAP solution architecture across the automotive component manufacturing landscape
 



 \- To design and govern scalable, secure, and well\-integrated SAP solutions aligned to business and manufacturing strategy
 



 \- To lead SAP S/4HANA architecture decisions, integration design, and the technology roadmap
 



 \- To ensure the SAP landscape supports plant operations, quality, and supply chain requirements with minimal disruption
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 Define and own the overall SAP solution architecture and roadmap across all modules and plants
 



 Lead architecture design for S/4HANA upgrades, and rollouts
 



 Finalize integration architecture between SAP and shop\-floor/MES, PLM, and third\-party systems
 



 Drive design of the core and extended SAP landscape ( S4, Fiori, BTP, EWM, etc.)
 



 Own technical governance: data architecture, security architecture, and interface design, ABAP development
 



 Review and approve functional/technical designs prepared by module leads and consultants
 



 Evaluate new SAP technologies (BTP, AI/ML in SAP, IoT, Industry 4\.0\) for adoption
 



 Drive SAP landscape strategy for scalability across new plants and business units
 



 Ensure architecture compliance with corporate IT and cybersecurity standards
 



 Provide architectural oversight to implementation partners and consulting teams
 



 Own risk assessment and mitigation for major SAP changes and releases
 



 Mentor and guide SAP functional and technical leads across modules
 



 Support business case development for new SAP initiatives (ROI, TCO)
 



 Lead vendor and partner evaluation for niche or extended SAP solutions
 



**REQUIRED COMPETENCIES** 




 Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA architecture, migration, and landscape design
 



 Strong knowledge of core SAP modules viz. FICO, MM, SD, PP, PM, QM, EWM
 



 Experience with automotive/manufacturing\-specific SAP processes (Kanban, Sub\-contracting, MRP, ASN, JIT/JIS)
 



 Hands\-on exposure to SAP Fiori, BTP, and SAP Analytics Cloud / Power BI
 



 Strong understanding of SAP Basis, Security, and integration technologies (PI/PO, CPI)
 



 Experience designing SAP interfaces with MES, PLM, and third\-party logistics/quality platforms
 



 Knowledge of IoT, Industry 4\.0, and digital manufacturing trends will be an added advantage
 



 Strong stakeholder management and ability to translate business needs into technical architecture
 



 Excellent communication, leadership, and presentation skills
 



 Ability to manage multiple SAP implementation partners and cross\-functional teams
 



**Education \& Experience** 




 BE / B.Tech. in CS/IT/Mech./Auto./Prod.; MBA preferred
 



 Minimum 10\-15 years of SAP experience with at least 4\-5 full\-cycle S/4HANA implementations
 



 Prior experience as SAP Solution/Enterprise Architect in a manufacturing/automotive environment
 



 Certification in SAP S/4HANA / TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification preferred
 



 Experience managing large, multi\-plant SAP landscapes in a Engineering/manufacturing set up preferred.

* Deep expertise in Oracle SCM modules such as Manufacturing, Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Bill of Material, and Costing, with a proven track record of delivering complex solutions.
* Advanced ability to define and document business requirements, lead fit\-gap analysis, architect business process designs, and oversee the configuration and integration of Oracle SCM applications.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with extensive experience partnering with clients to drive business process transformation and strategic enhancements. Demonstrated leadership in mentoring teams, managing cross\-functional initiatives, and contributing to best practices and organizational growth.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)


**Good To Have Skills**
* Extensive experience managing onsite\-offshore delivery models, with a proven ability to mentor and develop junior team members across global teams.
* Demonstrated leadership in overseeing complex, end\-to\-end business cycles such as order\-to\-cash and procure\-to\-pay, ensuring seamless integration and process optimization.
* Proven capability to lead multiple work streams within large\-scale Oracle SCM projects, driving successful outcomes and aligning with organizational objectives.
* Comprehensive understanding of supply chain, planning, and manufacturing processes across diverse industry domains, enabling strategic solution design and implementation.
* Advanced negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of resolving conflicting priorities and building consensus among senior client and internal stakeholders.

dd4fa7b0.title: Principal Architect | Agentic AI
dd4fa7b0.description:
**Company Description** **About NIQ:** NIQ is a leading global consumer intelligence company, helping clients understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what they should do next. Our data, technology, AI, and analytics capabilities power decision\-making for some of the world’s most important consumer, retail, and technology businesses.


AI is central to NIQ’s next stage of growth. We are building trusted, scalable, and high\-impact AI capabilities that transform how insights are created, delivered, and adopted across the business. This role will help shape the platforms, operating model, and leadership system needed to make that ambition real.

 **Job Description**  

Our NielsenIQ Technology teams are building and evolving Connect, a unified, global, open data ecosystem powered by cloud and on\-premises technologies. Clients around the world rely on NielsenIQ data and insights to innovate and grow. As a Principal Architect within the Enterprise Architecture team, you will define architecture for key components and capabilities across NIQ platforms, ensuring alignment with business strategy, product objectives, technology standards, and the long\-term platform vision. You will partner with architecture peers, Product and Operations leaders, engineering leaders, and development teams to take solutions from initial requirements through design, delivery, and production operation. A key focus of this role is shaping the responsible adoption of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and agentic AI across the enterprise. The successful candidate will combine broad enterprise architecture experience with practical knowledge of AI\-enabled systems and will grow into an end\-to\-end platform architect as their knowledge of NIQ's platforms expands.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the development of architecture designs for key products and capabilities across NIQ platforms, working closely with product stakeholders, engineering teams, and other architects.
* Define high\-level solution approaches and blueprints that guide component\-level design while maintaining an end\-to\-end view of platform integration, future products, and the technology roadmap.
* Create, maintain, and promote reference architectures, architecture principles, standards, patterns, and decision records for key areas of the platform.
* Shape enterprise architecture for AI, Generative AI, and agentic AI solutions, including model integration, retrieval\-augmented generation, orchestration, tool and API use, memory, workflow automation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Define reusable patterns for secure and scalable AI agents, including identity and access control, data grounding, context management, guardrails, evaluation, observability, auditability, failure handling, and cost management.
* Partner with security, privacy, legal, data governance, and Responsible AI stakeholders to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for confidentiality, intellectual property, regulatory compliance, transparency, and risk management.
* Assess emerging technologies and viable alternatives for front\-end applications, platform services, data pipelines, databases, AI platforms, foundation models, vector stores, and agentic frameworks, including build\-versus\-buy recommendations.
* Establish model and solution evaluation criteria covering quality, accuracy, groundedness, safety, latency, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership.
* Identify future\-state solutions and drive innovation through proofs of concept, technology migrations, controlled pilots, and productionization.
* Provide architecture leadership, coaching, and design governance, promoting pragmatic, high\-quality solutions and consistent engineering practices across teams.

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in application development, solution design, or software architecture, supported by a strong engineering background and experience with enterprise\-scale platforms.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, secure, highly available, and observable distributed systems in production.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data modelling, and high\-volume processing across relational and non\-relational data stores; experience with multi\-terabyte databases is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and interoperability standards, such as semantic orchestration frameworks, multi\-agent frameworks, and the Model Context Protocol.
* Experience defining Responsible AI governance, AI risk controls, threat modelling, red\-teaming, or security patterns for AI\-enabled applications.
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design for performance, scalability, availability, resilience, privacy, and security.
* Good knowledge of cloud architecture, preferably Microsoft Azure, including identity, networking, security, data, integration, monitoring, and platform services.
* Practical experience architecting or delivering AI or Generative AI solutions in production, with an understanding of large language models, embeddings, vector search, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.
* Understanding of agentic AI architecture patterns, including agent orchestration, planning and reasoning workflows, tool calling, state and memory management, multi\-agent coordination, human oversight, and safe execution boundaries.
* Ability to communicate complex architecture decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and to influence outcomes across organizational boundaries.

  

**Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)


NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job\-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles: https://nielseniq.com/global/en/info/niqs\-ai\-safety\-policies/


**About NIQ**


NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state\-of\-the\-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100\+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.


For more information, visit NIQ.com


Want to keep up with our latest updates?


Follow us on: LinkedIn \| Instagram \| Twitter \| Facebook


**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**


At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We invite individuals who share our dedication to inclusivity and equity to join us in making a meaningful impact. To learn more about our ongoing efforts in diversity and inclusion, please visit the https://nielseniq.com/global/en/news\-center/diversity\-inclusion

A pure play Salesforce and MuleSoft partner since 2021, Cloud Odyssey brings together the enthusiasm and innovation of a young company with the extensive experience and expertise of its people. With a global track record of over 100 successful projects, a consistent 5/5 customer satisfaction rating, and deep domain expertise across key industries, we’re quickly establishing ourselves as the go\-to partner for Salesforce and MuleSoft in Asia, Europe and North America.
  
  

To support our continuous growth, we are looking for Presales Consultant to join an amazing team of like\-minded professionals and help our customers transform the way they work and improve business performance.
  
  

**Role Description:**  

Drive and manage presales activities in CO Salesforce practice.
  
Develop the presales competencies and manage presales team.
  
Engage with prospective customers to understand requirements, respond to RFQs/RFPs, proposal preparation and presentation, solution demos and SOW preparations.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Drive and own the complete presales engagement and activities for Salesforce Practice
  
Develop and enhance the presales processes and proposal templates
  
Define, develop and optimize the project effort estimation processes and techniques
  
Engage with prospective customers to showcase practice capabilities and strengths
  
Review and respond to RFQs/RFPs and provide support on RFP requests
  
Prepare, Present and submit solution proposals and Demos
  
Engage with Sales team in customer discussions and negotiations on proposals
  
Prepare the Scope \& SoW documents
  
Manage smooth transition and handover of new projects to Delivery Teams at CO
  
Conduct solution demos and presentations at events
  
Build and enhance functional and technical knowledge on Salesforce Products and solutions
  
Drive and manage the Presales team and presales resources
  
Develop and maintain the required competencies and skills for Salesforce presales activities
  
  

**Prerequisites:**  

Excellent communications and presentation skills.
  
Experience of presenting to senior leaders and C\-level executives
  
Solid understanding of Salesforce products and solutions – at a minimum Sales, Service, Field Service, Einstein Analytics, Marketing, Vlocity focus is a must
  
Minimum 4 years of experience of managing Salesforce Presales activities and customer engagements in Enterprise customer segments / large deals
  
Project delivery experience of atleast 2 years and with minimum 2 end\-to\-end project implementations from project scoping to delivery
  
Total Experience of 5\-12 years with atleast 4 years of Salesforce experience
  
Must have Salesforce Certification(s)
  
Aware of the latest developments and releases of solutions
  
Team Player. Works collaboratively with sales, presales and delivery teams
  
  

**Desired Skills and Experience:**  

Experience of Velocity Clouds, Other major products lines at Salesforce is a must. DX is a good to have so as Commerce Cloud, Tableau, Data Cloud
  
Experience of working / integrating with other Salesforce products e.g. Einstein Analytics, Heroku, Tableau, Mulesoft
  
Experience of working and engaging with customers in India, Europe, ASEAN, USA, Middle East regions
  
Highly aware of the industry trends and latest developments on CRM solutions.
  
  

Why work with us?
  
  

**Innovative Culture:** Join a team that thrives on creativity and cutting\-edge technology. We encourage experimentation and support new ideas to keep our projects fresh and exciting.
  
**Career Growth:** We offer comprehensive training programs and mentorship opportunities to help you advance in your career. Your professional development is our priority.
  
**Flexible Work Environment:** Enjoy the freedom of hybrid work, flexible hours, and a results\-oriented culture that prioritizes work\-life balance.
  
**Impactful Work:** Contribute to projects that change the way people interact with technology, making a real difference in users’ lives.
  
**Inclusive Community:** We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard and valued.
  
**Job Category:** Business
  
**Job Type:** Full Time
  
**Job Location:** Mumbai

de8eee37.title: Junior Solution Architect
de8eee37.description:
Key responsibilities
 



 – Participate in client requirement\-gathering sessions with hyperscalers, neo clouds, BFSI, GCCs and AI\-native companies; capture and structure technical requirements.
 



 – Prepare rack layouts, space plans, single\-line concepts and capacity/phasing models under senior guidance, including high\-density GPU zones.
 



 – Support HPC/AI solution design work: GPU cluster bills of material, InfiniBand/Ethernet fabric cable schedules, and power/cooling load calculations for dense racks.
 



 – Build and maintain BOMs, solution templates and pricing inputs for proposals; draft sections of technical proposals and RFP/RFI responses.
 



 – Coordinate with the DC Infrastructure team on design feasibility, costing inputs and site data.
 



 – Maintain the solution engineering knowledge base: standard designs, density and cooling reference configurations, competitor benchmarks.
 



 – Support site visits, client walkthroughs and technical Q\&A.;
 



  





 Essential qualifications \& experience (must\-have)
 



 – 2–5 years in data centre design, MEP consulting, colocation operations engineering, or pre\-sales support for DC/IT infrastructure.
 



 – Working knowledge of DC fundamentals: power chains (UPS, PDU, redundancy concepts), cooling approaches (CRAC/CRAH, chilled water, awareness of liquid cooling), rack and space planning.
 



 – Foundational exposure to HPC/AI infrastructure: understanding of GPU server platforms and high\-performance networking concepts (InfiniBand vs Ethernet/RoCE), with genuine motivation to specialise in AI data centre solutioning.
 



 – Proficiency with AutoCAD/Revit or similar layout tools; strong Excel for capacity and BOM modelling.
 



 – Clear technical documentation and presentation skills (PowerPoint/Word); comfort in client\-facing settings.
 



 – Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics or related engineering discipline.

056d582a.title: R&D Modelling and Simulation Engineer (Edge Solutions, BESS) - IDC
056d582a.description:
**Location:**

Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
**Job ID:**

R0141157
**Date Posted:**

2026\-08\-26
**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
**Profession (Job Category):**

Engineering \& Science
**Job Schedule:**

Full time
**Remote:**

No
**Job Description:**

The Opportunity:
  

As a Modelling and Simulation Engineer, you provide product and solution\-oriented system level modelling expertise for Battery Energy Storage Systems within GPQSS.
  

The role focuses on integrating OEM provided models into standardized system level templates and on delivering validated BESS solution modelling packages from an application and grid integration perspective.
  

Your primary objective is to enable the organization by providing high quality, validated reference models, solution templates, and technical guidance, supporting tendering, execution, and local engineering teams. Project specific grid studies are typically performed by dedicated system study teams, with this role providing methodology, valida\-tion, and expert support where required.
  

The primary goal of this role is to deliver high quality, validated modelling packages and solution templates that act as kick starters for tendering and project execution.


**How You Will Make an Impact**

* Act as the system level modelling and simulation Subject Matter Expert for GPQSS Battery Energy Storage Systems.
* Provide independent technical judgment on model selection, fidelity, assumptions, and applicability to BESS solutions.
* Ensure modelling approaches correctly represent overall system behaviour, performance, and limitations from an application perspective.
* Serve as technical reference and escalation point for modelling related topics across GPQSS.
* Integrate OEM provided models (PCS, battery, control systems) into standardized GPQSS system level tem\-plates.
* Develop, maintain, and validate reference BESS models and solution packages for RMS and EMT simula\-tions.
* Execute solution validation studies to assess BESS performance, robustness, and compliance from an ap\-plication and grid interaction perspective.
* Complement OEM models with in house modelling where required to close gaps or increase simulation fi\-delity.
* Deliver validated modelling packages intended as kick starters for tendering and project execution.
* Provide methodology, validated models, and expert support to teams performing project specific grid and system studies.
* Technically steer and enable external consultants, Power Consultants, and project engineers to effectively use GPQSS modelling packages.
* Support tendering and feasibility phases through interpretation of simulation results and clarification of mod\-elling assumptions.
* Support grid code compliance assessments by providing reference models and validation frameworks, not by executing full project studies.
* Prepare and deliver training, documentation, and guidance on BESS modelling approaches, tools, and best practices.
* Capture and disseminate lessons learned to continuously improve modelling templates and solution pack\-ages.
* Contribute to cross disciplinary alignment with System Architect, AC BoS, Battery Technology, and Automa\-tion roles.

  

**Your background:**  

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or equivalent.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in power system modelling and simulation.
* Excellent knowledge of EMT and RMS simulation tools, with mandatory proficiency in PSCAD and DIg\-SILENT PowerFactory.
* Proven experience integrating OEM models into system\-level simulation environments.
* Proven ability to develop reusable modelling assets and support multiple stakeholders, beyond single pro\-ject execution.
* Solid understanding of power system dynamics, inverter\-based resources, and BESS grid integration.
* Ability to independently drive end\-to\-end modelling and simulation activities.
* Strong collaboration skills in multidisciplinary and international teams.
* Excellent communication skills in English.
* Experience with PSS®E for large\-scale transmission or regional power system studies.
* Experience with simulation automation or scripting (Python, MATLAB).
* Exposure to grid impact studies and grid\-code validation processes.
* Experience working with external consultants, utilities, or TSOs.
* Structured, analytical, and pragmatic engineering mindset

**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al\-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre\-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

10bcfd8c.title: Solutions Engineer (0–3 Years)
10bcfd8c.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 This role is purpose\-built for technically strong early\-career professionals who are ready to take their technical skills into a customer\-facing seat. Whether you have 0–3 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering, or a related technical field — or you are a recent graduate with strong internship experience — this is worth a serious look.
 



  





 As a Solution Engineer at Hevo, you will work directly with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs at companies evaluating Hevo across the
 ***US Market***
 . You will help them understand their data challenges, design the right data architecture, walk them through trade\-offs, and earn the technical trust that turns an evaluation into a long\-term partnership.
 



 You will do this independently — often as the technical voice on the call. You need to walk into a Zoom with a VP of Data Engineering at a US fintech or a Head of Analytics at a European e\-commerce company, understand their requirements, explain technical concepts clearly, and build confidence throughout the engagement.
 



 Your technical foundation does not go away. It gets applied to a wider set of problems, a larger audience, and a genuinely global stage.
 



 Hevo runs real\-time data pipelines from 150\+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies worldwide — including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goals.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH YOUR CONSIDERATION** 




**A. You move from building solutions to shaping data strategy** 




 In most engineering roles, you build what is specified. In this role, you sit with senior data leaders and help them understand what to build — across the full modern data stack. Your technical foundation in SQL, databases, data pipelines, cloud technologies, and engineering becomes the foundation for higher\-leverage, higher\-visibility work.
 



**B. You get global exposure early in your career** 




 You will be in regular technical conversations with Heads of Data and CTOs at fast\-growing companies across North America, Europe, and beyond. You will run discovery, learn to defend architecture choices, and present in rooms where real decisions get made. This kind of exposure early in your career is uncommon anywhere — and almost unheard of from Bengaluru.
 



**C. Your technical depth stays central** 




 This is not a pivot away from engineering. Everything you know about Postgres, SQL, CDC, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, and data pipelines gets used every day. The difference is that your technical knowledge helps shape the customer's architecture — instead of living inside a Jira ticket.
 



**D. The career path is real** 




 Strong performers in this role can grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the SE function, or move into product, customer success leadership, solutions architecture, or other technical customer\-facing positions. The optionality this role builds is significant.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 




 Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations — primarily with customers in North America and Europe — and you will learn to own them end to end.
 



 Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo integrates into the customer's existing data stack (e.g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4, Snowflake, dbt).
 



 Deliver live product demos tailored to each customer's environment. These are not scripted walkthroughs — you will read the room, adapt in real time, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.
 



 Support the technical evaluation from first conversation through to closed deal — addressing technical questions and building trust with engineering teams.
 



 Build proof\-of\-concept pipelines by configuring real connections from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.
 



 Develop deep expertise across the data integration landscape — including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (Glue, Data Factory, Dataflow) — and articulate Hevo's technical advantages in a way that resonates with both technical and non\-technical buyers.
 



 Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins, and work closely with Customer Success to ensure smooth, high\-quality handoffs post\-deal.
 



 Feed customer insights and recurring patterns back to Product and Engineering to meaningfully influence the roadmap.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Must\-Haves** 




**0–3 years of experience** 
 in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, or a related technical field.
 *Recent graduates with strong technical projects, internships, or relevant hands\-on experience are also encouraged to apply.* 




 Strong SQL fundamentals and working knowledge of databases and data engineering concepts.
 



 Working knowledge of at least one cloud data warehouse — Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift — through professional, internship, academic, or project experience.
 



 Exposure to at least one orchestration or transformation tool such as Airflow, dbt, or similar is preferred.
 



  





**Exceptional communication and presentation skills — this is non\-negotiable.** 
 You will be the face of Hevo's technical capability to a global customer base. Specifically:
 



 Your spoken English is clear, confident, and accessible to an international audience.
 



 You are comfortable presenting technical concepts to groups and communicating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders over video calls.
 



 You can structure a technical narrative — not just answer questions, but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion.
 



 You have presented or demo'd something technical to an audience before — whether in academic projects, internships, internal reviews, client calls, meetups, hackathons, or conferences.
 



 Genuine interest in working directly with customers and solving their problems — even if you have not done so formally before.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 Experience building data pipelines or ETL/ELT workflows through professional, internship, academic, or personal projects.
 



 Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms — cloud\-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) or third\-party pipeline tools.
 



 Exposure to multiple source system types — CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.
 



 Public technical writing, conference talks, hackathons, or open\-source contributions.
 



 Prior exposure to customer conversations — even informally, such as presenting to internal stakeholders, analytics teams, or collaborating with international teams across time zones.
 



  





**ABOUT HEVO** 




 Hevo is the data integration platform powering 1,000\+ data\-driven companies — including DoorDash, Shopify, Gartner, and IcelandAir. Headquartered in San Francisco with a strong engineering base in Bengaluru, Hevo is Series B with $42M raised from Sequoia, Chiratae, and Qualgro.
 



 We have built one of the most loved data pipeline products in the modern data stack, and we are now scaling our go\-to\-market function. This role sits at the center of that next phase.
