5fea132a.title: Principal Solutions Architect - Data & APIs
5fea132a.description:
NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state\-of\-the\-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100\+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 NIQ Media is building a config\-driven, reproducible media measurement platform spanning audience weighting, cross\-media reach \& frequency, sales\-lift/MME modelling and brand\-lift analysis, delivered on a modern cloud\-native stack (Angular, Java Spring Boot microservices, AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, Python/PySpark data and AI/ML engines).
   

  





 The Technical Solution Architect owns the end\-to\-end technical architecture of the platform: the domain/data\-contract model, service and API design, cloud infrastructure, and the boundary between the product/ops shell and the underlying data\-science engines. This person is the final technical authority on build\-vs\-buy and platform decisions, sets engineering standards across all pods, and ensures the architecture scales from a single reference study to multi\-tenant, multi\-market operation without core code changes.
   

  





 This is a hands\-on architecture role: the person is expected to prototype, review code, and pair with engineering leads, not just produce diagrams.
   

  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :**




 Architecture \& Design
   

  




* Define and own the overall solution architecture across the Angular UI, Java Spring Boot / microservices backend, and Python/PySpark data \& AI engines running on AWS and Azure.


* Design the canonical domain and data\-contract model (identity, study, media, exposure, outcome, governance/lineage) and the versioning/compatibility policy for it.


* Define the plugin/extension SDK so new markets, channels and analysis modules can be added by configuration, not core code changes.


* Own key technical decision gates (e.g. orchestration engine choice, build\-vs\-buy for core algorithmic components, deployment topology) and document them as accepted architecture decisions.



 Platform, Cloud \& Delivery
   

  




* Design the Kubernetes\-based deployment topology across AWS and Azure, including environment strategy, secrets management, scaling and multi\-tenant isolation.


* Define the CI/CD architecture (GitHub / GitHub Actions) and the code\-quality and security gates (e.g. SonarQube, Cycode) enforced across all repositories.


* Guide integration of AI\-assisted development practices and AI/ML capabilities into the platform and into the engineering team's day\-to\-day workflow.


* Review designs and code from backend, frontend, data engineering and DevOps pods; act as final escalation point on cross\-cutting technical issues.



 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Translate business and analytics requirements from the SME/Business Analyst into technical designs and work\-package breakdowns.


* Partner with the Technology/Delivery Manager on estimation, sequencing and dependency management across the backlog.


* Communicate architectural trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership and external partners.


* Mentor engineers across disciplines and raise the technical bar of the team.


**Qualifications**

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**



* 9\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years in a solution/technical architect role for cloud\-native, data\-intensive platforms.


* Proven hands\-on experience designing microservice architectures with Java / Spring Boot, and modern SPA frontends (Angular preferred).


* Strong working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure, containerisation and orchestration with Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent).


* Practical experience with Python\-based data engineering and/or data science pipelines (e.g. PySpark, big\-data processing) and how they integrate with service\-based platforms.


* Experience designing multi\-tenant, config\-driven platforms (as opposed to per\-customer custom builds).


* Demonstrated experience embedding code quality and security tooling (e.g. SonarQube, Cycode or equivalents) into engineering workflows.


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting architecture decisions to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.



**PREFERRED / NICE\-TO\-HAVE**



* Experience in media measurement, market research, advertising analytics, or adtech domains.


* Familiarity with statistical/ML modelling concepts (e.g. regression\-based lift models, weighting/raking methods) even if not personally building them.


* Experience integrating AI copilots / AI\-assisted development tooling into a professional engineering practice.


* Prior experience leading offshore/distributed engineering teams through onboarding and ramp\-up.


* Relevant certifications (AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, CKA, TOGAF or similar).



**CORE SKILLS**



* Solution \& enterprise architecture, API and microservices design, event\-driven and batch data architectures.


* Java / Spring Boot, Angular/TypeScript, Python (working proficiency, not necessarily daily coding).


* AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure\-as\-Code.


* GitHub, GitHub Actions, SonarQube, Cycode (or comparable code quality/security tooling).


* Strong systems thinking, documentation discipline, and stakeholder communication.


**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**



* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)



 NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job\-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles: https://nielseniq.com/global/en/info/niqs\-ai\-safety\-policies/

 NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state\-of\-the\-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™.  Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting\-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
   

  

 Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Discover the Excitement at Availity \- Shaping the Future of Healthcare from Bengaluru, India!
   

  

 Welcome to Availity, where we transcend the conventional to redefine the landscape of healthcare technology. Headquartered in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, with a buzzing office right in the heart of Bengaluru, India, and a dynamic remote workforce spread across the United States, we are a global force bound by an impactful mission.
   

  

**Why Availity Excites**
 At the forefront of healthcare technology, we are not just a company; we are trailblazers reshaping the future of healthcare. Our mission? To refocus attention on what truly matters \- patient care. As the primary healthcare engagement platform, we are the pulsating heartbeat of an industry that touches millions of lives. With a network of over 2 million healthcare providers connected to health plans and processing a staggering 12 billion transactions annually, our influence is on a constant and expansive rise.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
 We are seeking a seasoned Solution Architect to provide technical leadership and architectural direction across Epro's strategic engineering initiatives. This role will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and cloud\-native solutions while driving platform modernisation, engineering excellence, and alignment with business objectives. The architect will serve as a key technical partner to Engineering Managers, Product Owners, Principal Engineers, and delivery teams, ensuring sustainable architecture decisions and successful execution of high\-impact programs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive architecture strategy for enterprise\-scale healthcare platforms and services.

* Establish architecture standards, reusable reference patterns, and engineering best practices across teams.
* Partner with engineering leadership to support platform modernisation, cloud adoption, and technology transformation initiatives.
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, reliability, security, compliance, and operational excellence requirements.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to balance business priorities with long\-term architectural sustainability.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Principal Engineers, Senior Engineers, and development teams.
* Drive architecture reviews, design governance, and technology evaluation processes.
* Support engineering teams in performance optimisation, observability, resiliency, and cost\-efficient cloud operations.
* Work closely with Security and Compliance teams to ensure HIPAA, PHI, and PII requirements are incorporated into solution design.


 Desired Experience
   

  

* 12\+ years of engineering experience with significant experience in enterprise architecture and distributed systems.
* Strong expertise in AWS/Azure cloud platforms, microservices, event\-driven architectures, APIs, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience leading architecture for large\-scale SaaS platforms.
* Proven track record of driving cloud migration, platform modernisation, and engineering transformation initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams.


**Eligibility**
**Availity Culture And Benefits**

* Availity is a culture of continuous learning. We have many resources and experts in our tech stack that can help get you there too!
* Don’t feel like wearing business attire? Cool, you can wear jeans – we are a casual place.

We offer 24 days of paid time off to all our fulltime associates \+ 12 paid holidays.

* Want to work for an organization that gives back to the community? You’re at the right place! Availity partners with organizations to extend various CSR services.


**Availity Perks For Remote, Hybrid And Office\-based Associates**

* We’ve got you (office\-based associates) covered with free coffee and tea anytime you want and subsidized food (lunch / dinner).


**Video Camera Usage**

If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*

61986d6f.title: Principal Software Architect
61986d6f.description:
**Job Title\-Principal Software Architect** 




  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Principal Software Architect is the senior technical authority for application and software architecture across Vistra's global technology estate. This role defines the architectural vision, design standards, and engineering patterns that underpin Vistra's enterprise platforms, digital products, and client\-facing services — ensuring they are scalable, resilient, secure, and aligned to Vistra's platform\-led, AI\-enabled operating model.
 



  





 Reporting to the EVP, IT Architecture \& Engineering, this role bridges strategy and execution: translating enterprise architecture direction into actionable software design decisions, reference architectures, and engineering guardrails that accelerate delivery teams while maintaining architectural integrity. The Principal Software Architect is expected to be hands\-on — leading by example through design authority, code\-level credibility, and deep technical engagement with engineering teams across regions.
 



  





 This is not a people\-management role by default; it is a principal\-level individual contributor with significant influence over technical direction, engineering culture, and platform outcomes across the enterprise.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**1\. Software Architecture \& Design Leadership** 



* Define and own Vistra's global software architecture strategy, standards, and design principles across enterprise platforms, digital products, and integration layers.
* Develop and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and architectural blueprints for core domains including entity management, fund administration, financial accounting, and client portals.
* Lead architectural decision\-making for major programmes and platform investments, producing high\-quality High\-Level Designs (HLDs) and Solution Architecture Documents (SADs).
* Establish and govern architecture decision records (ADRs), ensuring traceability and consistency of technical decisions across teams and regions.
* Drive adoption of domain\-driven design (DDD), event\-driven architecture, and microservices patterns where appropriate, while pragmatically managing legacy modernisation.
* Evaluate and recommend technology choices (languages, frameworks, platforms) based on fitness for purpose, total cost of ownership, and long\-term maintainability.
* Act as the final technical escalation point for complex design challenges, trade\-offs, and architectural disputes.



  





**2\. Cloud\-Native \& Platform Architecture** 



* Define cloud\-native application architecture standards across AWS, Azure, or GCP — including compute, serverless, containerisation (Kubernetes/ECS), and managed services.
* Design platform\-centric architectures that enable multi\-tenancy, configurability, and service reuse across Vistra's business lines (VFS and VGS).
* Establish patterns for resilience, observability, and fault tolerance — including circuit breakers, retry policies, health checks, and distributed tracing.
* Drive infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) standards and ensure application architectures are deployment\-pipeline friendly (CI/CD native).



  





**3\. API Strategy \& Integration Architecture** 



* Own and evolve Vistra's enterprise API strategy — defining standards for API design, versioning, governance, security, and lifecycle management.
* Design integration architectures spanning synchronous (REST/GraphQL), asynchronous (event\-driven, message queues), and batch processing patterns.
* Establish API gateway patterns, rate limiting, throttling, and consumer management standards.
* Drive the decomposition of monolithic systems into well\-bounded services with clear contracts and minimal coupling.



  





**4\. Engineering Excellence \& Technical Debt Reduction** 



* Define and champion software engineering standards including code quality, testing strategies (unit, integration, contract, performance), and peer review practices.
* Lead technical debt identification, quantification, and structured remediation planning — making debt visible and actionable for leadership.
* Drive modernisation of legacy systems through strangler\-fig patterns, progressive decomposition, and pragmatic re\-platforming approaches.
* Establish non\-functional requirements (NFR) frameworks covering performance, scalability, security, accessibility, and maintainability.



  





**5\. AI \& Automation Readiness** 



* Ensure application architectures are AI\-ready: API\-first, data\-rich, event\-driven, and observable — enabling intelligent automation and ML integration.
* Define architectural patterns for AI/ML model serving, feature stores, prompt management, and AI agent integration within business applications.
* Partner with Data \& AI leadership to ensure platforms can consume and operationalise AI capabilities without architectural rework.
* Establish guardrails and patterns for responsible AI integration — including data isolation, auditability, and human\-in\-the\-loop design.
* Drive automation of repetitive engineering tasks through tooling, templates, and platform engineering approaches.



  





**6\. Governance, Assurance \& Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Participate in and contribute to enterprise architecture governance — including design reviews, architecture boards, and investment assurance processes.
* Provide architectural assurance for major delivery programmes, ensuring solutions align with enterprise standards and long\-term direction.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant narratives for senior leadership and non\-technical stakeholders.



  





**Jobs To Be Done (JTBD)** 




 The Principal Software Architect is accountable for delivering the following critical outcomes on behalf of Vistra:
 



  





**1\. Make Vistra's Platforms Scalable, Modular \& Future\-Ready** 



* Ensure Vistra's core platforms can scale across regions and service lines without linear growth in complexity or cost.
* Deliver architectures that are modular enough to adapt to new business models, acquisitions, and regulatory requirements without wholesale rebuilds.



  





**2\. Accelerate Delivery Through Architectural Clarity** 



* Provide engineering teams with clear reference architectures, design patterns, and decision frameworks that reduce ambiguity and speed up delivery.
* Shift architecture from a bottleneck to an accelerator — enabling teams to move fast within well\-defined guardrails.



  





**3\. Reduce Technical Debt and Eliminate Fragmentation** 



* Make technical debt visible, quantified, and systematically addressed — preventing it from silently eroding velocity and increasing risk.
* Drive convergence from fragmented, region\-specific solutions toward standardised, enterprise\-grade platforms.



  





**4\. Enable AI and Automation at the Application Layer** 



* Ensure Vistra's application estate is architecturally ready to embed AI, automation, and intelligent workflows without requiring foundational rework.
* Create the conditions for non\-linear productivity gains through platform\-level intelligence.



  





**5\. Ensure Resilience, Security \& Compliance by Design** 



* Ensure application architectures meet Vistra's resilience, security, and regulatory requirements across all jurisdictions from inception — not as retrofit.
* Partner with Security Architecture to embed zero\-trust, data protection, and compliance controls into application design patterns.



  





**6\. Elevate Engineering Culture and Technical Maturity** 



* Raise the bar on engineering practices, design rigour, and architectural thinking across Vistra's global development teams.
* Build a culture where good architecture is everyone's responsibility — not a centralised function's gatekeeping activity.



  





**Skills, Experience \& Qualifications** 




**Required**



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, with progressive movement into architecture roles.
* 5\+ years in principal, staff, or senior architect roles with enterprise\-wide scope and multi\-region influence.
* Proven experience designing and delivering large\-scale, distributed systems in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) with the ability to create both high level and low level technology blueprint designs
* Deep expertise in modern software architecture patterns: microservices, event\-driven architecture, domain\-driven design, CQRS, and API\-first design.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in at least two of: Java/Kotlin, C\#/.NET, Python, TypeScript/Node.js — with breadth across the stack.
* Demonstrated experience with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless architectures, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns, API management platforms, and middleware technologies.
* Strong understanding of data architecture principles, including event sourcing, data mesh concepts, and analytics enablement.



  





**Preferred**



* Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent.
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, professional services, fund administration, or corporate services).
* Experience architecting multi\-tenant SaaS platforms or platform\-as\-a\-product models.
* Familiarity with AI/ML integration patterns, LLM orchestration, and intelligent automation architectures.
* Experience leading architecture in organisations undergoing large\-scale ERP or platform transformation programmes.
* Experience with Big Data solutions such as; Databricks, Snowflake, Google Big Query an advantage
* Experience in visualisation tools an advantage
* Contributions to open\-source projects, technical publications, or architecture community leadership.

You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager, you will act as a key strategic leader driving complex, high\-impact initiatives. You will lead multiple horizontal programs across SVT Sports. You will be responsible for bringing structure to ambiguous, long\-term programs, starting from conceptual phase all the way to global launch.
   

  

 The Sports landscape at Google is highly horizontal, requiring deep coordination across an ecosystem of engineering, product, UX, and partnership teams. You will navigate cross\-functional and cross\-organization dependencies, manage downstream change management, and drive consensus among senior stakeholders across disparate groups globally.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive strategy, planning, and execution of complex Sports initiatives from conception to global launch.
* Structure ambiguous, multi\-quarter programs into clear objectives and manageable engineering work streams.
* Build consensus and align senior leaders across disparate groups and global sites.
* Map horizontal dependencies, proactively mitigate program risks, and manage escalations to unblock delivery.
* Translate business goals to technical designs, representing program health and helping evaluate scale and design trade\-offs. Establish metrics and data\-driven feedback loops to identify and implement process improvements across the organization.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Modern Device Management (MDM) is how commercial customers deploy, configure, secure, and operate Windows at scale, and is a key partner surface for Intune and the broader Microsoft 365 management ecosystem.
   

  

 As the
 **Senior Technical Program Manage** 
 r for Windows Manageability / MDM, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Windows MDM platform and device provisioning stack in partnership with Intune, which owns the first\-party management cloud service. The platform also supports third\-party MDM services and OEM device provisioning via local provisioning packages. You will engage directly with enterprise IT admins and IT leadership, and translate customer needs into roadmap and feature decisions spanning the Windows client, services, and cloud control plane.
   

  

 This is an individual\-contributor role based in Bangalore alongside the broader ENS IDC team.
   

  

 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Engage directly with enterprise IT admins, IT leadership, and field teams; communicate the Windows manageability value proposition (security, compliance, cost reduction, modern management) and run customer feedback loops into product requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement of platform fundamentals \-\- security, performance, automation, quality, and validation \-\- including investments that improve Intune service scalability.
* Define success criteria, ship plans, and data\-informed metrics (policy success rates, deployment friction, usage) for cross\-functional projects, and ensure alignment across organizations.
* Partner with support, field, and engineering teams on customer issues and feedback, and represent Windows manageability in cross\-team and partner forums.

* Bachelor's Degree AND 4\+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development.
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 2\+ years of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.

+ OR product development.
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 6\+ years of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows MDM, Group Policy, provisioning, update/compliance flows, Autopilot, or Intune (or an equivalent MDM platform).

8b7f2f6a.title: Technical Program Manager (EG), Manufacturing
8b7f2f6a.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
   

  

 At Fictiv, we’re building a company that is developing the operating system for sourcing custom mechanical parts. We already enjoy manufacturing and delivering highly complex, high quality parts for our Fortune 500 customers who are building the future with products like autonomous electric vehicles, surgical systems, and industrial robots. As we scale our business, we are looking to expand our growth within India.
   

  

 In your role as Technical Program Manager, you will be working directly with our MPs, you’ll be using your engineering background, manufacturing process knowledge and management experience, to develop and implement effective and efficient program plans to ensure we’re executing programs within scope, budget and timing; while meeting or exceeding our customer’s expectations. You will also be the customer’s point of contact; you will drive scope clarity (internally and externally), issue resolution, stakeholder management and program success. You will be responsible for overseeing multiple programs across multiple regions, proactively managing risk, addressing any customer requests and coordinating across corresponding regional operations teams to keep programs on track and provide the corresponding program updates/status reports.
   

  

 As an experienced member of the team, you will be following our defined processes and driving their use in a new region with new manufacturing partners. Additionally, you will actively identify areas for improvement in your workflow and in the systems used by the Technical Program Management team, and will drive those improvements through cross functional projects. You will also be working cross functionally to support the development of robust processes which will ensure the successful introduction of new service offerings that Fictiv launches to the public.
   

  

 You will report on\-site to the Program Management Lead in our office in Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 This is a high\-impact role where you’ll help shape the future of hardware manufacturing through smart program leadership. If you thrive in fast\-paced environments, enjoy building processes, and are excited about working on cutting\-edge programs with global stakeholders, we’d love to meet you
   

  

**Program Execution \& Oversight**
 Lead end\-to\-end project execution, ensuring adherence to defined scope, budget, and timelines.
   

  

 Oversee cross\-functional coordination and execution across engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and quality.
   

  

**Program Planning \& Risk Management**
 Develop comprehensive and realistic project/program plans.
   

  

 Identify and proactively manage program risks and mitigation strategies, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

 Stakeholder \& Partner Management
   

  

 Engage regularly with internal teams, customers, and manufacturing partners to ensure alignment.
   

  

 Build strong working relationships with stakeholders to facilitate quick decision\-making and issue resolution.
   

  

**Customer \& Fulfillment Alignment**
 Understand and define customer requirements and fulfillment needs.
   

  

 Drive resolution of open gaps to ensure program success and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**Change Management**
 Own the evaluation and execution of post\-sale change requests.
   

  

 Balance scope, risk, and cost implications while maintaining overall program objectives.
   

  

**Program Monitoring \& Communication**
 Track and report on program performance using defined metrics (cost, time, quality, risk).
   

  

 Escalate issues as necessary and keep leadership informed with timely updates and clear documentation.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement**
 Identify areas for improvement across the program lifecycle and TPM workflow.
   

  

 Drive both tactical and strategic improvements to enhance operational effectiveness and program quality.
   

  

 Sitting and working at a computer for extended periods of time.
   

  

 Travel 0\- 10%
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
   

  

 Minimum 7\+ years of experience in a technical project or program management role within fast\-paced manufacturing environments.
   

  

 Proven track record managing programs through NPD (New Product Development) and Mass Manufacturing.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience managing suppliers/manufacturers and external stakeholders
   

  

**Technical \& Domain Knowledge**
 Must\-Have: Deep experience with CNC Machining.
   

  

 Good to Have: Familiarity with Composite and Sheet Metal Fabrication processes.
   

  

 Solid understanding of quality systems, PPAP, and supply chain management (SCM).
   

  

 Knowledge of logistics, sourcing, and finance related to project execution.
   

  

**Soft Skills \& Work Style**
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Fluent in English and any other Local Language
   

  

 Strong interpersonal skills with a team\-first mindset.
   

  

 Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and drive results in ambiguous environments.
   

  

 Gritty, adaptable, and able to operate in under\-defined or evolving processes.
   

  

 Data\-driven decision maker with a methodical and detail\-oriented approach.
   

  

 A systems thinker: capable of developing repeatable, flexible, and reliable processes.
   

  

 We’re actively seeking teammates who:
   

  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates


 We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

faec3831.title: Presales Engineer
faec3831.description:
**Organization and Background** 




 Established in 1996, Esri India Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Esri India), the market leader in geographic information system (GIS) software, location intelligence, and mapping solutions in India, helps customers unlock the maximum potential of their data to improve operational and business decisions. It has delivered pioneering enterprise GIS technology, powered by ArcGIS, to more than 6,500 organizations in government, private, academia, and non\-profit sectors. The company also offers Indo ArcGIS, a unique GIS technology, solution products, and data offering suited for government organizations.
 



 Esri India collaborates with a rich ecosystem of partner organizations to deliver GIS and location intelligence\-based solutions. Headquartered in Noida (Delhi NCR), the company serves close to 1\.5 million users nationwide and is distinguished by a diverse workforce, with women comprising more than 40% of its employees.
 



  





 Website: www.esri.in
 



  





**Role Overview:** 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Presales professional who can help us in growing our revenue and customer base in the Commercial Segment. Technical Consultant focus is responsible for leveraging Esri technologies and spatial analysis to help customers solve business problems and maximize the value of their geospatial investments.
 



  





**Location** 
 \- Mumbai/Noida
 



  





**Core Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Engaging with clients, delivering tailored geospatial solutions, and ensuring successful adoption through strong analytical, technical, and communication skills.
* Analyze client business requirements and translate them into scalable, technology\-driven solutions, including data architecture, geospatial workflows, and enterprise IT integrations.
* Provide guidance on data needs, solution design, and expected analytical outcomes.
* Interpret complex geospatial and business datasets using data analytics techniques, visualization tools, and spatial modelling, delivering actionable insights to support strategic decision\-making.
* Provide consultative support to clients, ensuring effective utilization and adoption of ArcGIS platforms (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise).
* Interpret and analyze geospatial and business data, delivering meaningful outputs to support decision\-making.
* Act as a trusted advisor, managing customer relationships, handling queries, and ensuring high customer satisfaction.



  





**Desired Skillset:** 



* Strong understanding of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Remote Sensing concepts, with the ability to apply them in real\-world business and enterprise IT scenarios.
* Hands\-on experience with product suite, including: ArcGIS ProArcGIS Online and/or ArcGIS EnterpriseProgramming language (e.g. Python / R / ArcPy)
* Proven ability to engage with customers, understand their business challenges, and translate them into effective Business geospatial\-based solutions.
* Familiarity with data management, database systems, and cloud\-based environments for statistical analytics and data processing.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the capability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills to drive customer success and adoption of geospatial solutions.
* Demonstrated customer\-handling and stakeholder management skills, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with Esri Model Builder for workflow automation and geoprocessing tasks.
* Hands\-on experience in creating web applications using ArcGIS platforms (e.g., Web AppBuilder, Experience Builder).
* Proficiency in publishing and managing geospatial layers/services (from various data formats) on ArcGIS Online (AGOL) and/or ArcGIS Server/Enterprise.

f535573f.title: Architectural Assistant
f535573f.description:
**Why Join Nexfore?**

At Nexfore Design \& Build PMC, you won't be limited to preparing drawings for a project.

You will become part of our **core project delivery team** and get the opportunity to:

* Work across **multiple industrial, commercial and design \& build projects**.
* Take part in projects from **concept and planning through design coordination and site execution**.
* Work directly with **clients, senior management, consultants and project teams**.
* Take genuine **ownership of architectural design and project deliverables**.
* Gain practical exposure to **PMC, Design \& Build and construction execution**.
* Work with modern design and documentation tools including **AutoCAD, Revit/BIM and 3D visualisation**.
* Contribute to developing **Nexfore's architectural standards, systems and processes**.
* Build a career with increasing responsibility across our growing project portfolio.
* Receive performance\-based recognition as your responsibility and contribution grow.

**Build Projects. Build Expertise. Build Your Career.**

If you want to move beyond simply preparing drawings and become a **Project Architect who understands design, coordination and execution**, Nexfore could be the right place for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and coordinate **architectural designs, layouts, elevations, sections and working drawings**.
* Understand client requirements and convert them into practical, functional and economical design solutions.
* Coordinate with **structural, MEP, fire, HVAC and other consultants**.
* Prepare and review architectural drawings using **AutoCAD** and preferably **Revit/BIM**.
* Coordinate with clients, project managers, consultants, contractors and vendors.
* Conduct site visits and resolve architectural/design\-related site issues.
* Manage drawing revisions, documentation and project deliverables.
* Support multiple projects based on Nexfore's project requirements.
* Contribute to improving **Nexfore's architectural standards, templates and design processes**.
* Support value engineering and ensure designs are practical and construction\-friendly.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Must Have:**

* B.Arch degree.
* 3–6 years of relevant architectural experience.
* Strong AutoCAD skills.
* Good knowledge of architectural planning and working drawings.
* Practical understanding of construction and site execution.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to independently handle architectural assignments.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in **industrial, manufacturing, warehouse, commercial or large\-scale projects**.
* Revit/BIM knowledge.
* Experience in consultant coordination and PMC/Design \& Build projects.
* Council of Architecture registration.

**The Right Candidate**

You will be a strong fit if you are:

**Design\-oriented \+ technically strong \+ fast in execution \+ comfortable on site \+ good at coordination \+ willing to take ownership.**

This is an opportunity to become part of **Nexfore's core project team** and work across different projects rather than being restricted to a single project.

**Apply if you want to build projects, not just drawings.**

**Benefits:**

· Life Insurance

· PF

· Bonus

· Paid leave

· Leave Encashment

· Travel, food, stay allowance

· Performance incentive

· Training

· Flexible working

* Joining bonus

**Key Skills**

Project Architect \| Architectural Design \| Architectural Planning \| AutoCAD \| Revit \| BIM \| Working Drawings \| Industrial Architecture \| Commercial Architecture \| Construction Drawings \| Site Coordination \| Consultant Coordination \| PMC \| Design \& Build \| Project Coordination \| 3D Visualization \| Architectural Detailing

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

9d09901f.title: R&D Modelling and Simulation Engineer (Edge Solutions, BESS) - IDC
9d09901f.description:
**Location:**

Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
**Job ID:**

R0141157
**Date Posted:**

2026\-08\-26
**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
**Profession (Job Category):**

Engineering \& Science
**Job Schedule:**

Full time
**Remote:**

No
**Job Description:**

The Opportunity:
  

As a Modelling and Simulation Engineer, you provide product and solution\-oriented system level modelling expertise for Battery Energy Storage Systems within GPQSS.
  

The role focuses on integrating OEM provided models into standardized system level templates and on delivering validated BESS solution modelling packages from an application and grid integration perspective.
  

Your primary objective is to enable the organization by providing high quality, validated reference models, solution templates, and technical guidance, supporting tendering, execution, and local engineering teams. Project specific grid studies are typically performed by dedicated system study teams, with this role providing methodology, valida\-tion, and expert support where required.
  

The primary goal of this role is to deliver high quality, validated modelling packages and solution templates that act as kick starters for tendering and project execution.


**How You Will Make an Impact**

* Act as the system level modelling and simulation Subject Matter Expert for GPQSS Battery Energy Storage Systems.
* Provide independent technical judgment on model selection, fidelity, assumptions, and applicability to BESS solutions.
* Ensure modelling approaches correctly represent overall system behaviour, performance, and limitations from an application perspective.
* Serve as technical reference and escalation point for modelling related topics across GPQSS.
* Integrate OEM provided models (PCS, battery, control systems) into standardized GPQSS system level tem\-plates.
* Develop, maintain, and validate reference BESS models and solution packages for RMS and EMT simula\-tions.
* Execute solution validation studies to assess BESS performance, robustness, and compliance from an ap\-plication and grid interaction perspective.
* Complement OEM models with in house modelling where required to close gaps or increase simulation fi\-delity.
* Deliver validated modelling packages intended as kick starters for tendering and project execution.
* Provide methodology, validated models, and expert support to teams performing project specific grid and system studies.
* Technically steer and enable external consultants, Power Consultants, and project engineers to effectively use GPQSS modelling packages.
* Support tendering and feasibility phases through interpretation of simulation results and clarification of mod\-elling assumptions.
* Support grid code compliance assessments by providing reference models and validation frameworks, not by executing full project studies.
* Prepare and deliver training, documentation, and guidance on BESS modelling approaches, tools, and best practices.
* Capture and disseminate lessons learned to continuously improve modelling templates and solution pack\-ages.
* Contribute to cross disciplinary alignment with System Architect, AC BoS, Battery Technology, and Automa\-tion roles.

  

**Your background:**  

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or equivalent.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in power system modelling and simulation.
* Excellent knowledge of EMT and RMS simulation tools, with mandatory proficiency in PSCAD and DIg\-SILENT PowerFactory.
* Proven experience integrating OEM models into system\-level simulation environments.
* Proven ability to develop reusable modelling assets and support multiple stakeholders, beyond single pro\-ject execution.
* Solid understanding of power system dynamics, inverter\-based resources, and BESS grid integration.
* Ability to independently drive end\-to\-end modelling and simulation activities.
* Strong collaboration skills in multidisciplinary and international teams.
* Excellent communication skills in English.
* Experience with PSS®E for large\-scale transmission or regional power system studies.
* Experience with simulation automation or scripting (Python, MATLAB).
* Exposure to grid impact studies and grid\-code validation processes.
* Experience working with external consultants, utilities, or TSOs.
* Structured, analytical, and pragmatic engineering mindset

**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 1984fe21.title: Client Delivery Lead for AWS Cloud & AI Projects
1984fe21.description:
**Position Overview**

We are an AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner helping organizations modernize applications, data platforms, and enterprise AI on AWS. We specialize in cloud migration, data warehouse modernization, AI agents, generative AI, intelligent automation, and AIOps. Through our consulting\-on\-demand offering available via AWS Marketplace, we accelerate delivery with AWS\-native architectures, AI\-driven execution, and proven modernization frameworks. Our team partners with organizations across financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, media, public sector, and technology to deliver secure, production\-ready solutions with measurable business outcomes.

You'll be the day\-to\-day face of our client engagements, serving as the person clients trust, engineers take direction from, and leadership relies on to keep delivery on track.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own client communication and relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead technical discovery calls and solution discussions with US\-based enterprise customers.
* Coordinate offshore engineering teams to ensure clear requirements and on\-time delivery.
* Take complete ownership of deliverable milestones and effectively manage milestone\-based timesheets.
* Track scope, risks, timelines, and proactively flag/resolve delivery blockers before they become client issues.
* Ensure all deliverables meet quality, security, and technical standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* You must have delivered AWS\-based projects end\-to\-end and be able to hold confident technical conversations with enterprise clients about how cloud, data, and AI solutions are built and delivered.
* We need someone coming from a company doing exactly what you will be doing for us. You must be stepping directly from a comparable agency/consulting role into this one.
* Proven technical leadership background, evidenced by previous roles such as Solution Architect, Lead Engineer, or Lead Technical Delivery Lead.
* Mandatory prior experience working in an agency or consulting environment (freelance\-only backgrounds are not a fit for this role).
* 5 to 7 years of hands\-on experience in the database world.
* Hands\-on delivery of projects using core AWS services: S3, EC2/ECS, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch.
* Data pipeline, Data Lakes, and ETL project delivery (Glue, Athena, Redshift, or similar).
* AI/ML, GenAI, and AI Agents project delivery (SageMaker, Bedrock, or similar).
* CI/CD, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Available and responsive during US working hours.
* Fluent in English with strong professional communication, both written and verbal.
* Someone our enterprise clients would immediately trust and enjoy working with.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS certification is a plus, not a requirement.

**To Apply**

Please include in your proposal:

* A specific project you delivered (cloud, AI, data, or SaaS).
* Which AWS services were involved.
* How you managed the client relationship, including your role, any challenges, and how you handled them.

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

04d351a9.title: Staff Technical Program Manager — Multi-Entity Account Scale & Access Lifecycle
04d351a9.description:
**Overview**
------------


Intuit's Identity organization is seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to focus on how our platform scales for large and complex customers. Our Identity Platform is the primary gateway for millions of customers across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp — a durable strategic lever that ensures personalized experiences are delivered with world\-class security and compliance.


This role sits at the center of one of Intuit's largest growth bets: serving customers whose organizations look nothing like a single\-owner small business. Accounting firms managing hundreds of clients. Multi\-entity businesses running dozens of legal entities across currencies and locations. Mid\-market companies with real hierarchies, real headcount, and real governance requirements. The users you build for are the people your customers employ — the staff, contractors, and accountants they invite into their own Intuit account — and the platform they administer today was designed for a much smaller shape of customer.


You will own two initiatives end to end. **Scale** is the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands, delivering bulk and group\-level administration, and standing up an API\-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time. **Access automation** is the work of making the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it — collapsing onboarding that takes weeks and eliminating access that outlives the person who held it.

  

We need an AI Native, results\-oriented and empathetic technical leader who can navigate complex system architectures, establish order in ambiguity, and drive technical excellence in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment. This role is based in Bengaluru India and partners daily with the engineering and product teams driving both initiatives.

 **Responsibilities**

* **Drive Technical Excellence:** Own and drive two critical identity programs — multi\-entity account scale and automated access lifecycle — from scope definition through launch and adoption. Navigate complex microservice architectures, multi\-tenant account and permission models, and intricate system dependencies to deliver capabilities that are secure, performant, and reliable at scale.
* **Own the Scale Initiative:** Drive the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands — hierarchies, groups, bulk administration, and an API\-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time. Dive deep into the technical subject matter and re\-emerge with an end\-to\-end blueprint the delivery teams can execute against.
* **Own the Access Automation Initiative:** Drive the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle to automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it. Partner with engineering on the provisioning architecture and with product on the administrative experience that sits on top of it.
* **Connect Strategy to Execution:** Synthesize business strategy, customer signals, and delivery realities to prioritize across both initiatives and keep teams focused on the highest\-impact outcomes. Lead the tradeoff discussions, recommend the execution path, and ensure follow\-through with stakeholders.
* **Execute with Rigor:** Partner across teams to define program outcomes, build the end\-to\-end delivery plan, and establish the governance model for both initiatives. Develop and drive the operating rhythm — planning, reviews, cutline sessions, and decision forums — that sets direction and instills accountability.
* **Own Risks and Dependencies:** Both initiatives carry committed dependencies from product teams across Intuit. Uncover risks and dependencies before they materialize, proactively escalate blockers, determine the optimal path to green, and hold partner teams to dated commitments.
* **Identity Architecture Partnership:** Work with Identity Architects and engineering leaders to ensure account hierarchy, provisioning, and access patterns scale consistently across the Intuit ecosystem, and that both initiatives compose cleanly with the authorization and governance work running alongside them.
* **Lead Change Through Migration and Adoption:** Own the path from the current account model to the new one — not just the capability, but how existing customers get there without disruption. Identify the impact of key changes, develop the change plan, and exhibit extreme ownership driving from plan to sustained adoption, tracking that customers actually move rather than that the feature shipped.
* **Enable Scale and Velocity:** Build the frameworks, tooling, and instrumentation that make identity program delivery repeatable — and apply AI agent tools to accelerate program analysis, delivery, and stakeholder communication, evaluating AI\-generated program artifacts with the same rigor applied to human\-generated output.

 **Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 8\+ years in technical program management within platform organizations or high\-scale software development environments, including demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple engineering organizations.
* **Education:** BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent technical degree.
* **Identity Platform Depth:** Direct experience delivering customer identity and access management (CIAM) capabilities — authentication, authorization, account and organization modeling, or user provisioning and administration — in a product\-facing platform serving external customers at scale.
* **Access Model Fluency:** Working knowledge of role\- and attribute\-based access control (RBAC/ABAC/PBAC), permission and entitlement models, delegated administration, and the failure modes that come with them — over\-permissioning, role sprawl, and orphaned access.
* **Multi\-Tenant Hierarchy Modeling:** Experience with systems that represent a customer's own organizational structure — parent/child entities, groups, delegated admins, cross\-organization access — and the design tradeoffs between flexibility and comprehensibility at scale.
* **Technical Domain Expertise:** Strong grasp of SDLC methodologies, microservices architecture, and platform design, with the systems thinking to form an end\-to\-end blueprint in an unfamiliar problem area and the credibility to be treated as a thought partner by technical stakeholders. Fluency with API\-first delivery, including developer\-facing surfaces and programmatic administration.
* **Scale Judgment:** Demonstrated experience taking a platform capability from a small\-customer design point to a large\-customer design point, including the migration path for customers already on the old model.
* **AI\-Native Delivery:** Demonstrated use of AI agents and tools in your own program work to accelerate analysis, structure delivery, and sharpen stakeholder communication — with firsthand judgment about where AI accelerates delivery and where it introduces risk.
* **Leadership Style:** Proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority, at a scope where you define the program rather than inherit it. Credibility as a boundaryless change leader who drives from plan to sustained adoption. You are a self\-starter who values "Leadership as a Coach" and supports the growth of those around you.
* **Communication:** Excellent articulate and warm communication skills, with strong written fluency. You can compress a complex program into a page an executive can act on, and simplify technical problems into actionable insight for engineers and leaders alike.
* **Problem Solving:** Demonstrated ability to establish order in ambiguous situations and use rapid experimentation to learn fast and pivot when necessary.
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong data\-driven mindset with the ability to track and report on program health, delivery velocity, and customer impact metrics.
* **Preferred:** Experience with identity standards and protocols (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, ReBAC/ABAC engines such as OPA); B2B or B2B2C SaaS serving mid\-market or larger customers; experience delivering through partner, reseller, or professional\-services channels.

  

Footer
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

c9223472.title: Client Solutions Manager, Meta
c9223472.description:
**About The Nimble Labs** 




 The Nimble Labs sits between international advertisers and the platforms where their revenue is made: TikTok, Meta and Google. We give brands and performance advertisers access, terms and support that a standard agency relationship doesn't offer. Our Client Solutions team turns commercial commitments into delivered results, working hand in hand with Client Partners to protect and grow every account's spend.
 



  





**About the job** 




 Can you keep an account scaling when the platform keeps moving underneath it?
 



 Meta is where our clients spend most consistently. Facebook and Instagram remain the backbone of performance advertising for most of the businesses we work with, and keeping those accounts healthy takes someone who stays close to the detail. Our clients operate in fast\-moving categories and scale quickly. We make sure the operational side keeps pace.
 



 You will be the single operational owner of our Meta market, working alongside its Client Partner. The revenue the CP signs is only real once you deliver it: you own the operational health, campaign performance and growth of our Meta portfolio.
 



  





**What You Will Be Doing** 



* Own the day\-to\-day relationship with a portfolio of international Meta advertisers.
* Manage onboarding: Business Manager setup, asset access, verification and everything required before spend goes live.
* Monitor performance and spend, identify risks early, and act before the client has to ask.
* Protect and grow each account's revenue: optimize what's live, and bring the client a clear, numbers\-backed case whenever spend should go up.
* Make clients better at the platform than they were last quarter, because sharper accounts spend more, for longer.
* Handle the harder operational conversations: account issues, measurement gaps, attribution questions.
* Work with our Meta partner contacts on support and escalations, and feed platform insights back to the team.
* Lead client reporting and performance reviews, providing actionable insight through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
* Keep account records, assets, data and reporting clean enough that any revenue conversation can start from them.
* Partner closely with your Client Partner counterpart so delivery matches what was agreed.



  





**What Will Make You Successful In This Role** 



* **Meta Certified professional status (Meta Blueprint, e.g., Certified Media Buying Professional) is required.** 
 Candidates without current certification will be expected to obtain it within their first 60 days; we sponsor the process.
* Minimum 3\+ years in client success, account management, partnerships or another client\-facing role in digital advertising.
* Solid working knowledge of Meta Business Manager and the platform's advertising products.
* You can stand behind performance numbers in front of a client's growth or finance lead.
* You can run complex, multi\-stakeholder client relationships, work through disagreement, and land decisions that unlock spend.
* Proactive, organised, and comfortable holding several accounts at different stages at once.
* Excellent communication skills in English across regions and time zones.
* Experience with lead generation, e\-commerce or subscription advertisers is an advantage. Familiarity with attribution tools and MMPs is a plus.



  





**Life at The Nimble Labs** 




**We are a small, senior team spread across markets and time zones, and we run on four things:** 



* **Ownership, not oversight.** 
 You run your own book. Nobody checks in for permission, and your results are visible: to clients, to the team, and to you.
* **Directness.** 
 We say what we mean, we answer quickly, and we'd rather have a hard conversation early than a polite one too late.
* **Move when the market moves.** 
 This industry changes faster than most people can keep up with. We treat that as the interesting part, and the people who spot the shift first are the ones who win the budget.
* **One number, two owners.** 
 Every market has a CP and a CSM behind the same revenue line. We back each other, because neither of us hits the number alone.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A defined platform market that is yours to build: one owner, full accountability
* Direct access to platform partner teams at TikTok, Meta and Google
* Certification and training support: we fund and expect continuous platform accreditation
* Growth opportunities through mentorship and hands\-on exposure to global markets
* Flexible hybrid working from Mumbai, Bengaluru, New Delhi or Hyderabad
* Flat structure, fast decisions, and impact you can see within your first quarter



  





 If you want your work to be visible rather than absorbed into a structure, come and talk to us.
 



  





**Setup** 




 Hybrid, based in Mumbai, Bengaluru, New Delhi or Hyderabad. Working hours flexible to cover international clients.

3537b3f8.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* 5 years of experience designing, constructing, or managing infrastructure projects.
* Experience creating infrastructure designs (e.g., telecom, electrical, mechanical), drawing sets for builds, and remodels of data center networking spaces.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience partnering with Data Science teams or directly leveraging machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting models, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Experience in network capacity planning, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, or supply\-demand matching.
* Proficiency in data modeling, trend analysis, statistics, and data tools (e.g., SQL, spreadsheet software) to synthesize complex capacity metrics and performance loops.
* Strong foundational knowledge of network infrastructure concepts, including network routing, peering, cache infrastructure (CDN), or capacity placement.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 As a Network Capacity Planner, you will ensure Google Cloud’s growth by guaranteeing network capacity is delivered efficiently and on time to support products and customers. Operating across critical planning and execution horizons, you will blend a deep understanding of network fundamentals with machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting, automate anomaly detection, and simulate complex capacity scenarios.
   

  

 Acting as a key technical collaborator alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers, you will navigate customer requirements, mitigate supply stockouts, and manage inventory buffers. Your work will directly balance resource efficiency with high availability, safeguarding infrastructure performance and driving strategic demand attainment across the global network fleet.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leverage deep knowledge of network fundamentals to understand critical paths, skillfully navigate complex customer requirements, and co\-develop tailored solutions alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers.
* Own the execution window, capturing large agreement requirements and navigating network lead times.
* Build forecasting models leveraging machine learning and AI to improve predictive accuracy, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Mitigate supplies shortages, maintain optimal inventory levels, manage policy\-based buffers, and plan for major peak traffic events.
* Collaborate to build AI\-assisted automation for ordering and resource fulfillment while designing metrics to track fleet efficiency and demand attainment.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. ffbf3e6c.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Benchmarking
ffbf3e6c.description:
Title: Technical Program Manager, AI Benchmarking
   

  

 Location: New Delhi, India
   

  

 Work Authorization: Current and ongoing work authorization in India
   

  

 Position: Full\-time
   

  

 Application deadline: September 18, 2026, 6 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
   

  

**Role Overview**
 PxD is looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery of a national initiative benchmarking Indian AI models for agricultural advisory. Government advisory platforms are increasingly powered by large language models, and a growing set of Indian foundational models, fine\-tuned variants, and voice\-based systems have emerged as potential alternatives — but little rigorous evidence exists on how they perform inside live advisory workflows. You will run a multi\-partner benchmarking program that produces decision\-ready evidence for the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare on which models can be safely and effectively integrated into existing advisory systems.
   

  

 PxD will co\-design the benchmark framework and act as consortium facilitator and government coordination partner for this work, convening government agencies, academic technical evaluators, benchmark partners, and model providers. You will be the person who holds that consortium together day to day: setting the benchmarking architecture with government, contracting and managing academic and technical partners, overseeing the evidence pipeline from technical testing through farmer\-facing user research, and turning the results into recommendations a ministry can act on. This position is based in New Delhi, with travel to partner institutions and project states.
   

  

**About PxD**
 PxD is a rapidly scaling global non\-profit that harnesses the power of technology, data science, and behavioral economics to provide targeted information to farmers in low\- and middle\-income countries. Providing the right information to the right people, in the right way and at the right time, increases incomes, protects the environment, and improves well\-being. We are evidence\-based: we test our interventions with randomized controlled trials to prove our impact and cost\-effectiveness, to simultaneously learn from and improve our service, and to demonstrate our value to funders and partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Government \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Serve as PxD's day\-to\-day point of contact for the benchmarking program, working through PxD's embedded PMU team to align the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare on priority use cases, target languages and geographies, candidate models, benchmarking baselines, and approval pathways.
* Establish the governance framework for the consortium — partner roles, decision rights, steering cadence, and escalation routes — and keep it functioning as the program moves through its stages.
* Negotiate system and data access, including access to government advisory environments for substitution testing, and maintain a permissions tracker across government, academic, and advisory data sources.
* Facilitate workshops and consultations with government counterparts, model providers, and domain experts; manage the funder relationship and reporting.


 Benchmarking Design \& Technical Delivery
   

  

* Own the benchmarking framework end to end: advisory use cases, benchmark tasks, datasets, human\-rating rubrics, safety and language criteria, tool\-use and source\-grounding assessments, cost comparison templates, and decision thresholds.
* Work with existing benchmark initiatives to adapt and localise established assets rather than building a parallel benchmark.
* Coordinate technical benchmarking across three layers — standalone model evaluation, substitution testing within the live government advisory stack, and a neutral benchmarking harness where direct system access is unavailable — alongside assessment of speech recognition, translation, text\-to\-speech, and multilingual performance.
* Manage latency, reliability, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership analysis, and oversee the cloud compute, GPU, and API resources that represent the single largest cost line in the program.
* Safeguard the independence and neutrality of the benchmarking by maintaining clear separation between benchmark development, model evaluation, and model development roles of partner organisations, with transparent disclosure of potential conflicts of interest.


 Evidence Generation \& Synthesis
   

  

* Oversee pre\-deployment user evidence generation with agronomists, extension personnel, and compensated farmer participant testers, assessing whether advisory outputs are comprehensible, actionable, trustworthy, and usable in local languages.
* Manage IRB submission and third\-party field vendor selection and oversight for user testing.
* Consolidate findings across technical performance, user evidence, safety, operational readiness, and cost into a single decision framework, and translate them into recommendations a non\-technical government audience can act on.
* Author the final evidence synthesis and decision report identifying models ready for pilot deployment, models requiring further optimization, and key implementation risks.


 Grants, Contracts \& Partner Management
   

  

* Contract and manage academic and technical partners, sandbox and compute hosts, domain\-expert consultants, and field vendors, monitoring performance against agreed deliverables.
* Ensure contractual and donor compliance throughout implementation, including data\-processing agreements and dataset licenses.
* Coordinate with finance and operations teams on budgets, procurement, and financial reporting against grant milestones.


 Team \& Knowledge Management
   

  

* Work alongside research and field staff supporting the program, providing technical direction and day\-to\-day coordination.
* Document benchmarking tools, protocols, and methodology so future evaluations across agricultural and other public\-sector advisory systems can build on this work.
* Contribute to PxD's institutional knowledge management and cross\-country learning on AI advisory.


**Required**
 What You'll Bring:
   

  

* Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Public Policy, Economics, Agriculture, Development Studies, Management, or another relevant field.
* 5–8 years of progressively responsible experience managing complex technical programs or projects.
* Working fluency with modern AI systems — LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompting, model evaluation, and the practical trade\-offs between accuracy, latency, safety, and cost.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-stakeholder projects involving government agencies, academic institutions, and external technical partners.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to run parallel workstreams against fixed donor milestones.
* Ability to translate technical evidence into clear, decision\-oriented recommendations for non\-technical senior audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building abilities.
* Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.


**Preferred**
* Demonstrated experience with AI model evaluation (academic/ personal/ work projects).
* Direct experience designing or running model evaluations, benchmarks, or structured A/B testing of AI systems.
* Experience with Indian\-language NLP, speech technology (ASR/TTS), or multilingual model performance.
* Experience working with state or national government programs, or with digital public infrastructure.
* Background in agriculture, climate, technology, or international development.
* Familiarity with causal inference and experimental design.
* Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and limited existing infrastructure, having built or launched a new program from scratch.
* Proficiency in one or more Indian languages.


**How To Apply**
 To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the application deadline of Sep 18, 2026, 6 pm IST.
   

  

 PxD is committed to building an inclusive and diverse organisation. We don’t make decisions based on gender, gender identity, class, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or any other personal characteristics that are unrelated to the role. We understand that everyone has different lifestyles and we accommodate flexible working to make sure you are as productive and happy as you can be.
   

  

 We will use any personal data you provide for recruitment purposes only.

Experience in Manufacturing execution systems is an advantage. Gather requirements and collaborate with functional partners for prioritizations to drive the business outcome.
