* Demonstrate ability to influence functional and development partners through credible knowledge and experience, persuasion and influencing skills.
* Lead the research and evaluation of emerging technology, including Agentic and Generative AI, industry and market trends to assist in project development for the Enterprise Solutions team.
* Organize project teams comprising from internal and external technical and functional experts. Manage program execution of multiple interdependent projects by working directly with global technical teams.
* Provide active participation in lean improvements across the whole landscape and balance execution of requirements with landscape simplification.
* Partner with local colleagues as we transition multiple manufacturing sites to SAP


**What You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with 8 to 12 years of experience.
* Significant technical experience along with established leadership credentials across disciplines and functions within IT program/product areas.
* Prior SAP ERP implementation experience
* Bring good understanding of SAP S/4HANA concepts, process simplifications, and future\-state capabilities

ebb5aa17.title: Head Assessment Content & Solutions
ebb5aa17.description:
**Job Description – Head / Lead, Assessment Content \& Solutions**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Assessment Content \& Solutions Leader** to lead the design, development, innovation, and delivery of technology\-based assessments for our online assessment platform.

The role owns the development of **MCQs, coding assessments, hands\-on exercises, projects, and auto\-graded assessments across IT skills**, while driving innovation in assessment methodologies, AI\-enabled content development, auto\-grading, and assessment\-platform capabilities.

The role works closely with **Content, Product, Engineering, SMEs, Sales/Pre\-Sales, and enterprise clients** to translate complex skill\-assessment requirements into scalable content, product, and solution capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Assessment Content \& Team Leadership**

* Lead development of MCQs, coding questions, hands\-on assessments, projects, and other technical assessment formats.
* Define assessment standards, quality frameworks, review processes, proficiency models, and content governance.
* Ensure assessments are technically accurate, industry relevant, appropriately challenging, and aligned with defined skills.
* Build and manage internal teams and external SMEs across established and emerging technologies.
* Drive productivity, quality, scalability, and continuous improvement across the assessment lifecycle.

**2\. Auto\-Grading, AI \& Technical Innovation**

* Lead **PoCs, R\&D, and experimentation** to expand automated assessment and auto\-grading capabilities.
* Define evaluation logic, validation rules, test cases, scoring methodologies, and technical requirements for coding, database, cloud, DevOps, AI/ML, cybersecurity, API, full\-stack, and other technology assessments.
* Partner with Engineering to convert successful concepts into scalable platform features.
* Drive practical adoption of **Generative AI and LLMs** for question generation, content validation, skill tagging, blueprinting, rubric creation, feedback, and automated evaluation.
* Establish effective human\-review and quality\-control mechanisms for AI\-generated content and evaluations.

**3\. Assessment Platform \& Product Ownership**

* Act as a **domain expert and business/product owner** for assessment\-engine capabilities.
* Identify platform gaps, new assessment use cases, and opportunities for product enhancement.
* Define business requirements, functional specifications, workflows, use cases, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering on capabilities covering authoring, coding assessments, project evaluation, auto\-grading, analytics, reporting, AI\-assisted assessment creation, and content management.
* Validate new features from functional, usability, assessment\-quality, and enterprise\-use\-case perspectives.
* Contribute assessment\-domain expertise to product roadmap discussions.

**4\. Assessment Solutioning \& Client Consulting**

* Translate complex enterprise requirements into practical and scalable assessment solutions.
* Design assessment strategies combining **MCQs, coding, hands\-on labs, projects, case\-based assessments, and automated evaluation**.
* Define skill frameworks, assessment blueprints, proficiency levels, difficulty distribution, scoring approaches, and evaluation methodologies.
* Support use cases including hiring, learning \& development, skill benchmarking, certification, internal mobility, and workforce transformation.
* Partner with Sales and Pre\-Sales teams on strategic opportunities, requirement discovery, solution workshops, presentations, and client proposals.
* Act as a senior assessment consultant for client discussions, solution design, escalations, and technical assessment queries.

**5\. Documentation, Governance \& Market Intelligence**

* Establish documentation and knowledge\-management standards across the assessment function.
* Own assessment frameworks, authoring guidelines, SOPs, technical specifications, product requirements, solution documents, skill taxonomies, PoC documentation, and quality processes.
* Ensure version control, traceability, review, approval, and lifecycle management of assessment content.
* Track trends across **EdTech, technical hiring, learning, skill\-management, certification, and assessment platforms**.
* Benchmark competitors across coding assessments, hands\-on labs, auto\-grading, AI, proctoring, analytics, adaptive assessments, and enterprise capabilities.
* Recommend product and assessment innovations based on market trends and evolving technology skills.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Significant experience in **EdTech, online assessment, technical skilling, learning technology, or technology\-enabled talent assessment**.
* Strong experience developing or managing **MCQs, coding assessments, hands\-on labs, projects, and automated evaluations**.
* Broad technical understanding across areas such as:
* Java, .NET, Python, JavaScript and Full\-Stack Development
* SQL, Databases, APIs and Microservices
* AWS, Azure and GCP
* DevOps, CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes
* Data Engineering and Analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI
* Cybersecurity
* Software Testing and Automation
* Strong understanding of **auto\-grading, evaluation logic, scoring, assessment quality, skill mapping, and proficiency frameworks**.
* Practical knowledge of **Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI\-assisted content/evaluation workflows**.
* Experience working with Product and Engineering teams on technology\-product requirements, validation, and enhancement.
* Strong capability in requirement analysis, documentation, structured problem solving, and solution design.
* Strong client\-facing, presentation, stakeholder\-management, and communication skills.
* Experience leading assessment, technical\-content, SME, or solution teams.

**Preferred Profile**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**.
* Approximately **10–15\+ years of overall experience**, including significant exposure to technical assessments, EdTech, content development, assessment product development, or technology solutioning.
* Experience with coding platforms, online assessment platforms, LMS/LXP systems, skill\-management platforms, or certification ecosystems.
* Experience managing cross\-functional collaboration across **Content, SMEs, Product, Engineering, QA, Sales, and Client Solutions**.

**Key Competencies**

**Assessment \& Technical Expertise:** Strong understanding of assessment design, technical skills, coding/hands\-on evaluation, proficiency frameworks, scoring, and quality standards.

**Product \& Innovation Mindset:** Ability to identify platform gaps, define requirements, validate features, and drive innovation in assessment and auto\-grading capabilities.

**AI Orientation:** Ability to apply AI/Generative AI effectively across assessment creation, quality assurance, evaluation, and feedback.

**Solutioning \& Consulting:** Ability to convert complex enterprise requirements into scalable assessment frameworks and solutions.

**Leadership \& Communication:** Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and effectively engage senior internal stakeholders, SMEs, engineering teams, and enterprise clients.

**Role Success Measures**

Success will be measured through **assessment quality and scalability, expansion of auto\-grading capabilities, successful delivery of assessment\-platform enhancements, adoption of AI\-enabled assessment practices, effectiveness of enterprise solutions, strength of content governance and documentation, team performance, and client satisfaction**.

d9dbe988.title: Global Copilot Architect
d9dbe988.description:
We are looking for a Copilot \& Copilot Studio Architect, reporting to the Head of Global Collaboration Services.
 



 The role is responsible for designing scalable, secure and compliant solutions that improve productivity, automate business processes, and support innovation across the organization.
 



 The architect will work closely with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Security, DPO, Data, local IT and business teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Architecture and solution design
 


* Help define target architecture principles for M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents.
* Design reusable patterns for agents, connectors, knowledge sources, actions, orchestration, authentication and data access.
* Assess business requirements and translate them into secure, maintainable and scalable technical designs.
* Review solution designs to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, data governance and operational standards.
* Maintain technical architecture documents (TADs), design decisions, implementation guides and operational runbooks.



  





 Copilot Studio and Power Platform governance
 


* Establish governance guardrails for Copilot Studio environments, makers, connectors, agent lifecycle, deployment pipelines and support models.
* Work with the PowerPlatform team to apply current governance and help design a target governance.
* Define approval, review and escalation processes for business\-critical or sensitive agent use cases.
* Support the design of monitoring, analytics and service quality indicators for deployed agents and automation scenarios.



  





 M365, security and compliance integration
 


* Work with Security and Compliance teams on identity, access, sensitivity, data loss prevention, information protection, auditability and responsible AI requirements.
* Guide teams on secure use of enterprise data sources, Microsoft Graph, connectors and external system integrations.
* Contribute to risk assessments, security reviews and privacy\-by\-design evaluations for Copilot and agent scenarios.



  





 Delivery enablement and continuous improvement
 


* Support local IT teams, product teams and delivery partners in implementing, operating and improving Copilot and Copilot Studio services.
* Act as a senior technical reference for complex incidents, design questions, platform evolutions and adoption blockers.
* Conduct technology watch on Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, agents and Microsoft AI roadmap changes.
* Identify opportunities to industrialize successful use cases and promote reusable assets, templates and best practices.
* Prepare clear technical and executive\-level communication materials, decision notes and recommendations.



  





**Required Profile** 




  





**10\-12 years of experience** 




  





 Technical expertise
 


* Strong expertise in Copilot, Copilot Studio and enterprise agent design, including knowledge grounding, actions, connectors and deployment constraints.
* Good understanding of M365 administration and architecture, especially SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive and M365 governance.
* Good understanding of Power Platform architecture: Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, environment strategy, DLP, connectors, licensing and ALM.
* Good knowledge of identity, security, compliance and data governance topics such as Entra ID, Purview, sensitivity labels, DLP, audit, eDiscovery and privileged access.
* Ability to understand integration patterns involving Microsoft Graph, APIs, Azure services and enterprise applications.



  





 Experience and seniority
 


* Significant experience in designing and delivering enterprise\-grade M365, Power Platform or AI\-enabled collaboration solutions.
* Proven ability to operate in a global, complex and regulated enterprise environment with multiple stakeholders and governance bodies.
* Ability to challenge solution choices constructively and balance innovation, user experience, security, compliance and operational sustainability.
* Comfortable producing architecture documentation, governance frameworks, technical operational guides and executive summaries.
* Experience working with offshore teams, local IT teams, business representatives, security, legal, privacy and enterprise architecture communities.



  





 Soft skills
 


* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to understand business needs before proposing a technical solution.
* High level of autonomy, structured thinking and ability to drive topics from ambiguity to decision.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and build trust with senior stakeholders.
* Curiosity for AI innovation combined with pragmatic risk management and enterprise delivery discipline.



  





 Additional Qualifications
 


* Microsoft certifications in Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Security, Azure or AI are a plus.
* Experience with Copilot Studio solution lifecycle management, agent monitoring and production support models is a plus..
* Experience with change management, adoption programs or training enablement is a plus.



  





 Languages
 



 Fluent English is required, both written and spoken. French and Spanish are a plus.

* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud security strategy, identity‑centric security models, and risk mitigation.
* Lead security architecture design across Azure and hybrid environments, ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
* Establish architectural standards for identity, access, network security, and workload protection.
* Lead design and modernization of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and hybrid Active Directory architectures.
* Define identity governance, authentication, authorization, and conditional access strategies.
* Drive implementation of SSO, MFA, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and identity lifecycle management.

* Ensure integration with enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and hybrid/cloud workloads.
* Define and govern secure enterprise networking architectures across cloud, on‑prem, and hybrid environments.
* Drive adoption of Azure networking services including VNet design, NSGs, Application Gateway, Azure Firewall, Load Balancer, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, and private endpoints.
* Architect secure connectivity patterns between cloud platforms, data centres, SaaS providers, and partner ecosystems.
* Promote network segmentation, secure ingress/egress, and resilient network design.
* Define security governance frameworks covering policies, standards, controls, and operational processes.
* Oversee implementation of security monitoring, logging, and threat detection using Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, and native security tooling.
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations and enterprise risk frameworks, particularly in regulated industries (FS, public sector).
* Guide clients on incident readiness, audit preparation, and continuous security improvement.
* Provide security and network architecture leadership across large‑scale cloud and platform transformation programs.
* Partner with cloud, data, integration, and application teams to ensure security is embedded by design.
* Review and assure solution designs, mitigating risks while enabling business agility.
* Lead, mentor, and develop security, identity, and networking architects/engineers.
* Serve as a senior security advisor to executive stakeholders and client leadership teams.
* Contribute to pre‑sales, solutioning, proposals, and thought leadership in cloud security and identity.
* Drive internal capability development, reusable security patterns, accelerators, and best practices.
* Stay current with emerging security threats, identity innovations, and cloud networking trends.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep understanding of cloud security architecture and identity‑driven security models.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, hybrid identity, and access governance.
* Experience with conditional access, MFA, RBAC, PIM, identity federation, and directory synchronization.
* Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals including routing, DNS, firewalls, VPNs, and network protocols.
* Hands‑on experience designing secure Azure networking architectures, ExpressRoute, VPN, and private access models.
* Experience implementing network segmentation and Zero Trust networking patterns.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender, Azure security services, logging, monitoring, and SIEM/SOAR concepts.
* Understanding of security posture management, vulnerability management, and threat modeling.
* Proven ability to lead complex security and cloud programs in enterprise environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with technical and executive audiences.
* Analytical and problem‑solving mindset with ability to balance risk and business enablement.
* Passion for continuous learning and developing high‑performing security teams.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator / Azure Security Engineer / Security Solutions Architect (preferred).
* 8–10\+ years’ experience in security architecture, identity, or enterprise networking roles.
* Experience operating in regulated, security‑sensitive environments.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust, defence‑in‑depth, and compliance frameworks.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues.
* Agile Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies.


**Education:**
**Degree:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
   

  

**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

8eaaeb24.description:
### **Oracle Utilities Managed Services Manager**


You’ll lead the delivery of production support and managed services for Oracle Utilities applications, serving as the key link between customers, business teams, technical teams, and offshore support resources. Your success will be measured by service stability, SLA performance, effective issue resolution, and your ability to continuously improve how support is delivered.


This is a hands\-on service leadership role. You’ll need to balance customer expectations, production priorities, technical dependencies, and distributed teams—particularly when critical incidents or releases require quick, well\-informed decisions.


#### **What you’ll do**


* Own the delivery of Oracle Utilities managed services, ensuring reliable production support and consistent achievement of agreed SLAs and KPIs.
* Lead the response to critical incidents, recurring problems, changes, and releases, bringing the right business and technical teams together to restore service and reduce repeat issues.
* Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders and serve as the primary point of contact for service performance, priorities, escalations, and operational concerns.
* Lead and coordinate offshore and distributed support teams, setting clear priorities and ensuring issues are owned through resolution.
* Use incident trends, root\-cause analysis, and service data to identify recurring problems and drive preventive actions, automation, and process improvements.
* Lead operational governance and service reviews, providing clear reporting on performance, risks, open issues, improvement actions, and upcoming releases or maintenance activities.
* Support the transition of new projects and enhancements into managed services through structured knowledge transfer, readiness planning, and post\-production stabilization.

#### **What you’ll need**


##### **Must\-haves**


* 7\-10 years of experience in Managed Services.
* Strong hands\-on experience supporting **Oracle Utilities applications** in production environments.
* Experience leading production support or managed services teams with responsibility for service delivery, SLAs, and customer escalations.
* Working knowledge of **ITIL\-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management** processes.
* Strong customer and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to communicate clearly during high\-priority production issues.
* Good understanding of Oracle Utilities application architecture, integrations, and production support dependencies.

##### **Nice\-to\-haves**


* Experience leading geographically distributed or offshore support teams.
* Experience with service transition, production releases, and stabilization of new implementations or major enhancements.
* Experience using automation, monitoring, or service analytics to improve operational efficiency and application reliability.

#### **About Abjayon**


Abjayon is an enterprise solutions and services provider specializing in the engineering and implementation of technology solutions across industries including Utilities, Healthcare, and Hospitality.


We are a team of highly experienced and driven technology professionals who take pride in solving complex problems and approaching every task and challenge with resilience, ownership, and a strong engineering mindset.


Our leadership and core engineering teams bring decades of combined experience in designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions. This deep engineering expertise enables us to help organizations create innovative customer experiences, adapt products and technologies for new markets, integrate emerging technologies, accelerate time to market, and build a sustainable competitive advantage.


#### **How to apply**


Please submit your resume along with a brief summary of your Oracle Utilities experience, including the applications you have supported and your experience managing production support or managed services teams.


Learn more about Abjayon at abjayon.com or through the Abjayon page.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\) Enterprise AI Execution \& Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end\-to\-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. **2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

**6\) Governance \& Responsible AI:** Ensure adherence to enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. Operationalize responsible AI practices (e.g., transparency, fairness, controls). Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

**7\) Matrix Team Leadership:** Lead through influence and build strong execution capability and accountability across a broad cross\-functional team. Create consistency in delivery methodologies and standards. Foster a high\-performance, results\-oriented environment; drive clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

49770518.title: Architect - Infra
49770518.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
   

  

 Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood. 
   

  

 Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
   

  

 Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
   

  

 Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.  
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. 
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities. 
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.
   

  

 Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings. Differentiates Microsoft's solutions in customer/partner conversations to influence the industry\-wide direction for specific architecture(s).
   

  

 Thought Leadership
   

  

 Leads virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.
   

  

 Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.
   

  

**Other**
 Embody our culture and values
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) relevant to Information Technology, Computer Science/Engineering.
   

  

 At least 12\-14\+ years related IT experience with Solution Architecture having experience in enterprise\-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, database migrations, and technology management.
   

  

 Work experience should involve pre\-sales support on large deals in technical consulting, solution design of complex solutions, project envisioning, planning, development, deployment, and Team management.
   

  

 Must have a proven record of delivering business value and proven trust\-relationships with CxO, ITDM, BDM
   

  

 The job may require travel.
   

  

 Fluent English verbal and written communications skills are a must.

abae69e2.title: Technical Architect
abae69e2.description:
Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

HCLTech is seeking an experienced Finance Lead (Solution Architect) with 8–10 years of SAP implementation experience to lead SAP Finance transformation initiatives across Greenfield, Brownfield and SAP S/4HANA programs for steel manufacturing clients. The role will own solution architecture, business process transformation, governance and end\-to\-end delivery of Finance solutions.
  
  

Job Details
  
  

**Experience:** 8–10 Years
  
**Location:** India
  
**Domain:** Steel Manufacturing
  
**Role:** Finance Lead / Solution Architect
  
**Technology:** SAP ECC \& SAP S/4HANA Finance
  
  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead SAP Finance solution architecture for enterprise transformation programs.
* Drive business blueprinting, process harmonization and target operating model definition.
* Design end\-to\-end solutions across GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Treasury, FSCM, Product Costing, Material Ledger, COPA and Group Reporting.
* Lead Greenfield and Brownfield implementation projects including assessment, design, build, testing, cutover and hypercare.
* Define finance integration architecture with MM, SD, PP, PM, QM, PS and SuccessFactors.
* Conduct executive workshops and provide strategic recommendations.
* Govern data migration, reconciliation and financial controls.
* Lead solution reviews, quality assurance and architecture governance.
* Manage offshore/onshore teams and mentor consultants.


Steel Industry Expertise
  
  

* Deep understanding of steel manufacturing value chain including raw materials, coke ovens, blast furnaces, steel melting shops, rolling mills, dispatch and distribution.
* Experience in production costing, by\-product accounting, inventory valuation and profitability analysis.
* Knowledge of integrated steel plant operations and finance reporting requirements.


Technical Competencies
  
  

* SAP S/4HANA Finance Architecture.
* Universal Journal (ACDOCA), Central Finance and Group Reporting.
* Material Ledger and Actual Costing.
* Product Costing and COPA.
* FSCM, Treasury and Cash Management.
* Financial Closing Cockpit and reporting solutions.
* SAP Activate methodology and Agile delivery.

94dfaa41.title: Solution Architect Manager
94dfaa41.description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

 **Responsibilities**  

People Management  



  

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

  

Model \- Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.

  

Coach \- Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.

  

Care \- Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

  

Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment

  

Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business goals. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.

  

Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.

  

Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.

  

Architecture Design and Deployment

  

Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.

  

Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.

  

Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.

  

Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the Architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.

  

Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long\-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.

  

Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies patterns in blockers across business areas or a territory. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.  



  

Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.

  

Practice Development

  

Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.

  

Trusted Advisor

  

Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.

  

Coaches team to use evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed and guides team in doing so.

  

Provides their team with a holistic perspective of customer/partner challenges, industry trends, and competitor architectures to allow team members to engage with customers/partners, demonstrate Microsoft's value, and develop counter strategy.

  

Thought Leadership

  

Fosters community sharing of stories and leveraging of pre\-existing resources by encouraging and empowering team to share learnings and by establishing a cadence (e.g., internal technical brainstorming calls, presenting latest challenges in staff meetings) to calibrate on challenges and trends that impact the team across the subsidiary level. Holds teams accountable for sharing insights with v\-team members to inform the direction they take with customers/partners.

  

Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.

  

Other

  

Embody our culture and values

 **Qualifications**  

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR equivalent experience.

  

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

  

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR equivalent experience.

  

6\+ years technical sales experience.

  

6\+ years project management experience.  



  

2\+ years managing multiple projects or portfolios.

  

1\+ year(s) experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams.

  

3\+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers.

  

Technical or Professional Certification in Domain (e.g., Security).

  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

bcdf47f4.title: Solutions Architect
bcdf47f4.description:
At Shakudo, we're building the world's first operating system for data and AI. We use the term "operating system" in the truest sense: just like iOS, Windows, or Linux, Shakudo's end\-to\-end OS provides ever\-evolving, fully automated, best\-in\-class open\-source components tailored to each business's unique needs.
 



  





 We are seeking a Solution Architect to join our Stack team and serve as the technical anchor for our customers — understanding their data and AI infrastructure challenges, architecting solutions on the Shakudo platform, and driving ongoing account growth. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role for someone who bridges deep technical expertise with strong relationship skills and can move between Kubernetes, Helm, and cloud infrastructure and strategic customer conversations.
 



  





 In this role, you will own the technical relationship with assigned accounts: architecting production\-ready solutions, integrating the Shakudo platform into customer environments, and expanding Shakudo's footprint by connecting customer needs to platform capabilities. This is not a pure pre\-sales or post\-sales role — it is an outcome\-driven engineering and advisory role where success is measured by customer adoption, solution quality, and account growth.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Design and deliver end\-to\-end technical solutions on the Shakudo platform that address real\-world data and AI challenges for enterprise customers
* Integrate open\-source and proprietary components seamlessly with the Shakudo platform using Kubernetes, Helm Charts, and infrastructure\-as\-code
* Build elegant, production\-ready solutions — not just proof\-of\-concepts — that customers rely on in production
* Contribute to architectural decisions and establish design patterns for platform development with high autonomy
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for assigned accounts — understand their infrastructure, roadmap, and pain points deeply
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues customers face in their data and AI stack, from Kubernetes orchestration to pipeline performance
* Identify opportunities to expand Shakudo's footprint within existing accounts by connecting customer needs to platform capabilities
* Navigate customer organizations effectively — from individual contributors to engineering leaders and C\-suite decision\-makers
* Champion customer needs internally, influencing product direction and Stack team priorities
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to translate customer requirements into scalable, robust systems
* Collaborate with Customer Engineering to ensure smooth hand\-offs and consistent solution quality
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases, solution patterns, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the team



  





**Qualifications** 



* 4–8 years of experience in solution engineering, solution architecture, or a senior engineering role with significant client\-facing responsibility
* Strong Kubernetes and Helm Chart development and deployment experience
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code
* Backend and frontend experience (e.g., Python, React, TypeScript) — enough to be hands\-on when needed
* Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships, solve complex technical problems under pressure, and drive account growth
* Excellent communication skills — you can explain deep technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into architecture
* A hands\-on, solutions\-first mindset and a passion for fast, high\-quality delivery
* A Plus
* Experience in data engineering, MLOps, or AI infrastructure
* Prior experience in a Solutions Architect or Solutions Engineer role at a B2B infrastructure or platform company
* Familiarity with the open\-source data and AI ecosystem (dbt, Airflow, MLflow, etc.)



  





 Please note that this role requires working hours between
 **5:00 PM and 2:00 AM IST** 




  





**Why Shakudo Stands Out** 




  




* Work with cutting\-edge technologies in machine learning and high\-performance computing
* Contribute to a platform that transforms how organizations leverage data and AI
* Join a dynamic team that values innovation, efficiency, and diversity



  





 Shakudo is an equal opportunity employer and encourages candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We foster diversity and inclusivity and welcome applications from a broad range of backgrounds and experiences.

c478716e.title: Solution Engineer Senior (Azure + AI)
c478716e.description:
**Job Summary**
 Responsible for analyzing and gathering business and technical requirements to design and document fit\-for\-purpose solutions. Contributes to solution development, design, integration and testing, and configuration of technology solutions ensuring that delivered solutions adhere to defined architecture and security standards. Works closely with with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and business partners to ensure smooth execution and continuous improvement in solution performance and quality. Ensure seamless solution implementation and effective issue resolution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Supports the design of fit\-for\-purpose solutions by collaborating with stakeholders to identify integration points and ensure alignment with business processes and goals. Supports technical analysis, design and customization of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial\-off\-the\-shelf products versus custom built solution. Develops and maintains technical design documents, workflows, and architecture diagrams. Assists in defining and executing the test strategy and validating solutions against business objectives. Ensures smooth interoperability by validating integrations and documenting configuration steps. Identifies and communicates potential technical dependencies and risks. Works with vendors and IT service providers to address technical issues, evaluate and improve product functionality and ensure proper configuration according to design specifications. Designs and implements data migration solutions to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Develops, designs, tests, maintains and configures solutions and systems as needed. Serves as subject matter expert and point of contact on content, processes, procedures and functionality associated with assigned applications for projects and application support (as needed). Documents recommendations to enhance business process efficiency and increase adoption of standard application features and capabilities, aligning solutions with enterprise standards. Supports continuous improvement initiatives by following established design standards and learning to identify potential enhancements in solution design or workflow efficiency. Assists technical and infrastructure groups in understanding the solution design and specifications. Works closely with IT technical service providers to ensure outsourced work packages are delivered to specifications, meeting key parameters of quality, schedule, cost, data privacy, security, performance, and scalability. Participates in formal design reviews, cybersecurity reviews and code reviews (where applicable) to ensure the detailed design specifications have been understood and coding standards and cybersecurity regulations have been adhered to by the development team(s).
   

  

 Competencies: Security \& Compliance Principles \- Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.
   

  

 Programming Principles \- Applies programming languages, frameworks, and patterns to design, write, configure, test, and maintain software/solutions/systems that are efficient, secure, scalable, and reliable.
   

  

 Data Principles \- Governs, models, secures, implements, and observes data flows to ensure integrity, quality, and compliance—enabling trusted, scalable, cost\-conscious data use.
   

  

 Modern Development Practices \- Applies modern engineering practices and tools—such as Agile/DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure as code—to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and reduce risk across the SDLC.
   

  

 Solution Design \- Translate business requirements into integrated designs, architectures, patterns, and system interactions that deliver customer value and align with enterprise standards and subject\-matter platforms.
   

  

 Demonstrating Mastery \- Maintains essential knowledge and proficiency in relevant domains, tools, technologies, methodologies, or frameworks through targeted credentials and rigorous proficiency, future\-proofing organizational skills against strategic needs.
   

  

 Strategic and Innovative Thinking \- Evaluates business and technology trends, anticipates future needs, develops creative approaches, and frames innovations to shape strategy and create durable value with cost\-aware innovation.
   

  

 Technical Passion \& Drive \- Models curiosity and excitement for technology by self\-initiating continuous development, experimenting with emerging technologies, and identifying insertion opportunities that accelerate business performance.
   

  

 Driving Effective Outcomes \- Takes ownership, acts with urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions, guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum and deliver consistent results.
   

  

 Engaging with Impact \- Communicates with clarity and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes.
   

  

 Values Differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

 Ensuring Customer Success \- Embraces a customer\-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust.

7912ca5c.title: Cloud Solution Architect - Dynamics 365
7912ca5c.description:
**Overview**  

The Cloud Solution Architect for Dynamics 365 and Copilot is a senior customer\-facing technical leadership role for professionals with 8\+ years of experience in business applications, cloud solution architecture, consulting, customer success, and AI\-enabled transformation. The role helps customers and partners accelerate business value through Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Dataverse, Azure, and agentic AI solutions.


This role acts as a trusted advisor to business and technical decision makers, translating customer priorities into scalable, secure, resilient, and outcome\-driven solution architectures. The architect drives adoption, usage, and value realization by guiding customers through solution strategy, implementation readiness, technical validation, governance, operational excellence, change management, and long\-term organizational adoption.


The role requires deep expertise in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot capabilities, agent development, enterprise integration, business process transformation, customer success practices, and the ability to influence executive stakeholders, partners, product teams, and internal technical communities.

 **Responsibilities**  

**Customer and Partner Success with Business Impact**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Drive customer and partner success by aligning Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Copilot solutions to business outcomes, transformation priorities, and measurable value.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers and partners, engaging with business decision makers, technical decision makers, CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, and other senior stakeholders.
* Translate customer and partner challenges into scalable industry and business application solutions using Microsoft technologies and proven architecture patterns.
* Guide customers on implementation strategy, architecture design, governance, operational readiness, adoption planning, and change management.
* Identify, escalate, and remove blockers that impact go\-live, adoption, consumption, usage growth, or business value realization.
* Support customers in building secure, resilient, AI\-enabled, cost\-effective, and performance\-optimized business application architectures.

**Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Copilot Architecture**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Provide technical and functional guidance across Dynamics 365 applications such as Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Finance, Supply Chain, Project Operations, and Customer Insights.
* Design and advise on Copilot and agent\-based solutions using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Dataverse, connectors, AI Builder, Azure AI, and Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility.
* Define integration patterns across Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Azure, third\-party enterprise applications, APIs, and enterprise data platforms.
* Advise on Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security, data loss prevention, lifecycle management, ALM, DevOps, and Center of Excellence practices.
* Deliver architecture reviews, technical validations, proof of concepts, pilots, solution assessments, and implementation advisory engagements.
* Promote reuse of Microsoft best practices, reference architectures, implementation patterns, repeatable intellectual property, and scalable industry solution assets.

**Consumption, Adoption and Growth**
------------------------------------

* Identify opportunities to increase usage, adoption, consumption, and business value from Microsoft Business Applications and Copilot investments.
* Work with sales, customer success, partner, engineering, and product teams to support strategic opportunities and customer transformation initiatives.
* Help customers and partners understand Microsoft value propositions across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot, Azure, and Microsoft 365\.
* Support partners in building repeatable solutions, industry offerings, implementation practices, and scalable delivery models around Dynamics 365 and Copilot.
* Capture customer insights, adoption blockers, product feedback, technical gaps, and success stories to influence product teams and internal communities.

**Technical Leadership**
------------------------

* Lead technical discussions, architecture workshops, solution reviews, and executive\-level conversations with customers and partners.
* Share proven practices across internal teams, technical communities, partner forums, and customer\-facing events.
* Contribute to technical readiness, internal enablement, reusable assets, demos, reference implementations, and solution accelerators.
* Stay current on Microsoft Business Applications, Copilot, generative AI, agentic AI, Power Platform, Azure, security, compliance, and industry trends.


Mentor peers and contribute to capability building across the organization through readiness sessions, technical coaching, and community leadership.

 **Qualifications**  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **8\+ years of experience** in technology solutions, consulting, architecture, implementation, customer success, practice development, or technical advisory roles.
* Strong experience with Dynamics 365 or comparable enterprise business application platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or ServiceNow.
* Experience working in customer\-facing roles with business decision makers, technical decision makers, IT leaders, implementation partners, and executive stakeholders.
* Experience delivering technical projects involving business applications, low\-code platforms, integrations, automation, governance, or AI\-enabled solutions.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and adoption\-ready technology architectures.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* 10\+ years of overall experience in cloud technologies, business applications, enterprise architecture, consulting, or practice development.
* Hands\-on experience with Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio, and agent development.
* Experience designing Copilot, conversational AI, generative AI, autonomous agent, or AI\-first business process automation solutions.
* Knowledge of Azure services, Microsoft 365, identity, security, compliance, data integration, APIs, and enterprise architecture patterns.
* Experience with solution governance, ALM, DevOps, environment strategy, platform administration, and operational excellence.
* Microsoft certifications such as Dynamics 365 Solution Architect, Power Platform Solution Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, Copilot Studio, or AI\-related certifications.
* Strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, executive engagement, technical leadership, and partner collaboration skills.

**Key Skills**
==============

* Dynamics 365 solution architecture and implementation advisory
* Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, and agent development
* Power Platform architecture, governance, security, and Center of Excellence
* Customer success, value realization, adoption, and consumption growth
* Business process transformation and industry solution design
* Technical advisory, architecture design, and executive stakeholder engagement
* AI\-enabled business applications, generative AI, and agentic AI scenarios
* Security, compliance, resiliency, performance, and operational excellence
* Partner enablement, technical leadership, mentoring, and community contribution

  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. 27561cbf.description:

--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking an IT Operations Readiness Solution Architect to ensure new services, applications, infrastructure changes and technology transformations are ready for production deployment, acting as a key connection point between Project, Engineering, Development, Vendor and Operations teams.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Lead Operational Readiness Reviews and define Operational Acceptance Criteria.
* Coordinate go\-live readiness, Go/No\-Go meetings, hypercare planning and exit criteria.
* Define support models, RACI, escalation paths, SLAs, KPIs and governance reviews.
* Ensure monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards and service health visibility are in place.
* Validate incident, problem, change, recovery, runbook and knowledge management readiness.
* Review capacity, performance, resilience, DR, BCP and scalability requirements.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experienced in IT Operations, Service Management, SRE or Application Support.
* Skilled in Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Transition processes.
* Confident managing production go\-lives and large\-scale transformations.
* Knowledgeable in ITIL, operational governance, risk management and stakeholder communication.
* Familiar with tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana or AppDynamics.
* Experience in telecom OSS/BSS, Managed Services, Oracle, CRM, Middleware, Cloud or Digital platforms would be an advantage.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to contribute to reliable production deployments and smooth service transitions.
* Exposure to cross\-functional delivery across technology, operations, engineering and vendor teams.
* Ability to influence operational governance, service reliability and launch readiness practices.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced operational readiness and service transition governance.
* Hypercare management, production go\-live planning and risk mitigation.
* Practical experience with observability, resilience, support models and ITIL\-aligned operations.
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------



Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

\#JDEnhancedByTARA

* Ability to understand Methodologies (Activate, Agile, SDLC, SCRUM) and other industry business fundamentals and ability to showcase a quick learning curve.

* Worked on implementation RFPs as a solution architect responsible for designing solutions end to end


**What We Look For**
* Prior BD experience (at least 2 Year, overall, 11\-14 years) with exposure to SAP Delivery.
* A strong understanding of SAP and integration with other applications/systems in an IT landscape


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

 our team and help shape the future of global commerce.

 Architect and design AI/ML solutions using GCP services (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, etc.).
   

  

 Lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI projects: requirements gathering, solution design, prototyping, development, deployment, and monitoring.
   

  

 Develop scalable data pipelines and model training workflows on GCP.
   

  

 Advise on best practices for data governance, security, and compliance in cloud\-based AI systems.
   

  

 Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.

 You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor to state, local, education, and water/wastewater organizations, helping them address complex IT, OT, and ICS security challenges.
   

  

 Working closely with sales teams and partners, you’ll translate customer requirements into compelling technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

 The role also involves navigating public\-sector procurement, regulatory requirements, and complex customer environments.

* Working knowledge of OT, ICS, and SCADA environments, including the operational considerations associated with industrial infrastructure.
